ability.make.wizard-specialist-buy.Name: Buy Wizard Specialist Make
ability.make.wizard-specialist-buy.Effect: Buy an additional Wizard Specialist make option.

ability.auric-colour.Name: Auric Colour
ability.auric-colour.Effect: This allows the user to recognise the colour of the mental aura of one target within range. In game terms, this means that those of Goodly alignment are seen to have a White aura, those of Neutral a Grey aura, and Evil a Black aura. Targets immune to neuronic informational effects, or all neuronics, or that simply have no mind, such as inanimate objects, have no aura at all. It is possible by training to conceal the colour of one’s aura so that only a clear aura can be seen – this is not the same as having no aura.

ability.1st-weapon-mastery-o.Name: 1st Weapon Mastery (O)
ability.1st-weapon-mastery-o.Effect: By means of training and practice the Warrior may become more skilled with one specific weapon e.g. Dagger, Broadsword, Hand Mace, Battle Axe, Bastard Sword, Spear etc. This Mastery means that one extra grade of damage is added to the normal base damage done by a weapon of this type. Any one-handed weapon may be chosen.

ability.1st-weapon-mastery-h.Name: 1st Weapon Mastery (H)
ability.1st-weapon-mastery-h.Effect: By means of training and practice the Warrior may become more skilled with one specific weapon e.g. Dagger, Broadsword, Hand Mace, Battle Axe, Bastard Sword, Spear etc. This Mastery means that one extra grade of damage is added to the normal base damage done by a weapon of this type. Any thrown weapon may be chosen.

ability.hedge-wizardry.Name: Hedge Wizardry
ability.hedge-wizardry.Effect:
Hedge Wizards are those Barony Humans who practise their magicks outside the protection of the Circle, and are actively hunted by Circle members when found. Hedge Wizards are normally followers of Earthpower, as the Circle does not regard such close tampering with the structure of Primus as a good thing, but can include many other professions as well. These renegades are normally self-taught and often quite well meaning in their actions, simply independent of the Circle.
Hedge Wizards are well advised to keep either their nationality or profession quiet depending on where they are adventuring, as members of the Circle are duty bound to bring them in to their masters. Such captured Hedge Wizards are never seen again, though there are strange and unfounded rumours that some Hedge Wizards are not simply burnt at the stake or hanged.
A Baronies Human who is not a member of the circle and uses mystical powers has the word "Hedge" prefixed to their class name. e.g. Hedge Mystic, Hedge Rogue etc. Hedge Wizards are a little different to their Labyrinthian counterparts due to their self-taught nature.
Hedge gain power as a normal character (this is a change from previous rules).
A Hedge Wizard gains the scout standard skill of Disguise.
A Hedge Wizard gains Immunity to Informational Effects of their own primary power-base (not their own), and a cumulative resistance level to their own primary power-base, except when cast by themselves.
This natural survival trait meant that the Vochstelen never found them when young to take to the Circle.
Due to the Hedge Wizard's hazardous life style, a Hedge Wizard gains an extra level of life, cumulative with other levels of life.
A Hedge Wizard cannot join any organisation which specifically requires them to be a Barony Human, as they would be apprehended, and they may not join professional guilds. However they may freely join political guilds unlike other Baronial characters.
Hedge Wizards, rather surprisingly, are not bitter people driven by the fear of capture into slaying those of the Circle, but quiet revolutionaries, seeking alliances, and trying to draw members of the Circle into their own secret cults.
Matters in the south are seldom clear-cut, black and white, and few Hedge Wizards wish the attention of a hunt for the killer of a member of the Circle by the massed might of the local Waldgraf, or a determined band of Vochstelen.
Hedge characters are Ostracised within the Baronies, so may be killed freely.

ability.circle-membership.Name: Circle Membership
ability.circle-membership.Effect:
Because of their history the use of power in the southern Baronies is carefully monitored and controlled by a group called The Circle. Fearful of the bad old days when power used frivolously or maliciously smashed its way around the Baronies, the Circle recognises that such regulating of use is very important.
In addition the Circle offers an excellent range of tuition and political support within the Baronies, and as such the following modifiers are accrued by a character who is a Circle Wizard or a Circle Hermit Priest or similar.
Circle Unholy Champions are not outlawed as they normally would be. 
If a Circle member casts a magical spell, the casting damage for that spell is reduced by1pt if the spell consumes at least one power point and is normally one point of TBLP damage. This does not help in the casting of cantrips or innate spells which cause casting damage as no power points are consumed.
If a Circle member uses a Neuronic power, they are assumed to have two more Neural Foci than normal, and take no life points at all when casting neuronics that would otherwise cost only l life point.
If a Circle member casts a miracle which is level based, then by doubling the casting damage taken in its casting, the miracle affects targets of l level higher than normal. If no damage is normally taken then normal casting damage is taken (if no damage casting was owned twice then this could be reduced to 0).
Censure.
Should a member of the Circle perform a mystic event which is in breach of the ethos of the Circle, then the above benefits are reversed until the end of the adventure. For example level based miracles have one less level of effect unless double casting damage is taken. Such acts would include acting against the Circle, drawing power from a God.
Inquisidore.
A Circle member should attempt to capture any Baronies Human who is a Hedge Wizard as detailed below. Only Barony Humans can qualify as this as Labyrinthian Humans, even those who are travelling through the Southern Baronies, are normally granted honorary Circle membership by default. Once captured they should be taken to a Commissionaire of the Circle, one of these centres of the Circle exists in Takalia.
Circle members are expected to give absolute loyalty to the Circle - they are not permitted to be members of any other professional organisation, be it a guild, church or similar.
Members of the Circle vary dramatically in moral and political outlook but all, when it comes down to it, support the basic political principles of the Southern Baronies.
Circle members often find it simple to gain appointments as advisors to lords of manors both north in the Empire or south in the Baronies, but sometimes feel the need not to identify their nature to a Labyrinthian lord, too many years of bad feelings have left them concerned over what kinds of treatment they may receive, what bias or bigotry might be unleashed upon them.
Members of the Circle in full regalia, when displaying their post in the order of things publicly, often wear the symbol of the Circle (rather unsurprisingly a Circle) upon their garb. Often the colouration, size and pattern of the circle says a lot about the wearer a loud and boisterous magician might wear a gold scaled circle proudly upon his tabard, whilst a quieter Mystic might have a simple ivory badge an inch across over his breast.

ability.hedge-informational-immunity-by-.Name: Immunity to informational effects (class powerbase)
ability.hedge-informational-immunity-by-.Effect: Gain immunity to informational effects of your class powerbase. This maps to one of Neuronic, Physical, Magical, or Spiritual. If no class powerbase is present, it maps to Physical.

ability.hedge-plus1-resistance-by-class-.Name: +1 level of resistance (class powerbase)
ability.hedge-plus1-resistance-by-class-.Effect: Gain +1 level of resistance against effects of your class powerbase. This maps to one of Neuronic, Physical, Magical, or Spiritual. If no class powerbase is present, it maps to Physical.

ability.hedge-immunity-to-neuronic-infor.Name: Immunity to Neuronic informational effects
ability.hedge-immunity-to-neuronic-infor.Effect: Gain immunity to neuronic informational effects.

ability.hedge-immunity-to-physical-infor.Name: Immunity to Physical informational effects
ability.hedge-immunity-to-physical-infor.Effect: Gain immunity to physical informational effects.

ability.hedge-immunity-to-magical-inform.Name: Immunity to Magical informational effects
ability.hedge-immunity-to-magical-inform.Effect: Gain immunity to magical informational effects.

ability.hedge-immunity-to-spiritual-info.Name: Immunity to Spiritual informational effects
ability.hedge-immunity-to-spiritual-info.Effect: Gain immunity to spiritual informational effects.

ability.hedge-1-level-resistance-neuroni.Name: +1 level of resistance vs Neuronic
ability.hedge-1-level-resistance-neuroni.Effect: Gain +1 level of resistance versus neuronic effects.

ability.hedge-1-level-resistance-physica.Name: +1 level of resistance vs Physical
ability.hedge-1-level-resistance-physica.Effect: Gain +1 level of resistance versus physical effects.

ability.hedge-1-level-resistance-magical.Name: +1 level of resistance vs Magical
ability.hedge-1-level-resistance-magical.Effect: Gain +1 level of resistance versus magical effects.

ability.hedge-1-level-resistance-spiritu.Name: +1 level of resistance vs Spiritual
ability.hedge-1-level-resistance-spiritu.Effect: Gain +1 level of resistance versus spiritual effects.

ability.casting-tuition.Name: Casting Tuition
ability.casting-tuition.Effect: Any spell cast which costs power has the life cost reduced by 1pt.

ability.insightful-caster.Name: Insightful Caster
ability.insightful-caster.Effect: If a Circle member uses a Neuronic power, they are assumed to have two more Neural Foci than normal, and take no life points at all when casting neuronics that would otherwise cost only l life point.

ability.faithless-casting.Name: Faithless Casting
ability.faithless-casting.Effect: If a Circle member casts a miracle which is level based, then by doubling the casting damage taken in its casting, the miracle affects targets of l level higher than normal. If no damage is normally taken then normal casting damage is taken (if no damage casting was owned twice then this could be reduced to 0).

ability.survival.Name: Survival
ability.survival.Effect: Can find food, water and shelter in the wilderness. In practical terms this means that on extended length adventures the player may supply their own provisions, which may be kept in an Out-Of-Character location until foraged for

ability.ishmaic-clan-support.Name: Ishmaic Clan Support
ability.ishmaic-clan-support.Effect:
Ishmaic Human characters (bar Rainfinders) may carry a Glaive (a short sword-like weapon) and, if they are allowed sharp weapon use by their class restrictions, this may be used as a weapon. Even Wizards may carry such a weapon, though this counts as their whole metal allowance.
All Ishmaic characters are well supported by their Clan. To this end they are supplied with normal weapons and armour as appropriate to their class. Ishmaic humans will normally be at least cordial to any Rainfinder.

ability.ishmaic-political-guild-restrict.Name: Ishmaic Political Guild Restriction
ability.ishmaic-political-guild-restrict.Effect: Ishmaic humans may freely join professional and social guilds but they may not belong to political guilds unless they are specifically for Ishmaics.

ability.illiterate.Name: Illiterate
ability.illiterate.Effect: Unless Read Languages is owned, this character cannot read. Even if able, will not trust anything unless it is written by their Shaman

ability.seven-winds-adept.Name: Seven Winds Adept
ability.seven-winds-adept.Effect: The Rain are adepts of the Seven Winds. To this end they always count as being two levels higher than they actually are for the calculation of damage taken from using magic.

ability.invoke-ancestor-rhagrimm.Name: Invoke Ancestor (Rhagrimm)
ability.invoke-ancestor-rhagrimm.Effect: Invoking Duke Rhagrimm grants the descendant +2 resistance levels against magical effects, and 1 point of MAC for every 2 levels possessed (1st to 8th only, not multi-classes). These benefits last 5 minutes.

ability.invoke-ancestor-issalania.Name: Invoke Ancestor (Issalania)
ability.invoke-ancestor-issalania.Effect: Invoking Issalania allows the descendant to trigger turbulent and opposing emotions in one target within 20'. This is considered a magical and spiritual effect. At the user's choice the target is filled either with love or terror of them, either being Beguiled or struck with Fear at unlimited levels of effect. However, this influence lasts only five minutes, after which time the target is filled with hatred for the user, and gains a 25% rage against them if the target chooses to attack them.

ability.invoke-ancestor-ulio.Name: Invoke Ancestor (Ulio)
ability.invoke-ancestor-ulio.Effect: Invoking Ulio makes the descendant shimmer and disappear, albeit briefly. For 10 seconds the user becomes entirely invisible to any form of sight. However this invisibility is broken should they strike a blow, cast a spell, or use other innate abilities. The sensations involved in being clouded from men's gaze by Ulio are unpleasant, and the user suffers a -2 dexterity AC penalty for 5 minutes afterwards (cannot reduce dexterity below 0).

ability.invoke-ancestor-eva.Name: Invoke Ancestor (Eva)
ability.invoke-ancestor-eva.Effect: Invoking Duchess Eva fills the user with potent power, albeit temporarily, this grants them + 1 strength above normal maximums, and + 1 max damage vs. one chosen target. This lasts for a maximum of 1 minute.

ability.galahbhad-political-guild-allowa.Name: Galahbhad Political Guild Allowance
ability.galahbhad-political-guild-allowa.Effect: Galahbhad characters are able to reach the Empire and have regular contact with that nation. To this end they are able to join a single political guild so long as that guild is in no way hostile to the Ishmaic Confederacy or demands loyalty to the Empire (for example, they could not be a member of Department of Recoveries and Collections).

ability.conditioned-heartstop.Name: Conditioned Heartstop
ability.conditioned-heartstop.Effect: If ever reveals information regarding the Buladajn Clan, their heart stops immediately and permanently. This has no immunity.

ability.psi-scan.Name: Psi-Scan
ability.psi-scan.Effect: Tells the user the surface thoughts of one target at time of use. The creature must be within sight.

ability.disarm-traps.Name: Disarm Traps
ability.disarm-traps.Effect:
Interestingly, there's no official text for this anywhere. Scouts can't do it. You now officially have a skill that does nothing.
Unofficially, your skill lets you disarm traps (though this is at the real-world skill level of the one using the skill)

ability.trap-wary-8.Name: Trap-Wary (8)
ability.trap-wary-8.Effect:
May use a Jump innate that requires no verbal to leap out of the area of an area-effect attack, if the Jump has sufficient range to leave the area of effect. If the effect was damaging, only half damage is taken – if non-damaging, it does not affect the user.
and may choose Tomb Robber as a tendency for 0 points rather than normal cost, if the character enters the scout bracket as a second class, they may acquire Tomb Robber tendency on table 9 for 80 points 
Unofficially, you gain this at first level. Levels in it don't change anything.

ability.benhai-scout-aptitude.Name: Benhai Scout Aptitude
ability.benhai-scout-aptitude.Effect: If the character is a scout class they gain the standard scout skill Trap Wary at 1st level and may choose Tomb Robber as a tendency for 0 points rather than normal cost. If the character enters the scout bracket as a second class, they may acquire Tomb Robber tendency on table 9 for 80 points.

ability.buladajn-change-appearance.Name: Buladajn Change Appearance
ability.buladajn-change-appearance.Effect: If the character is a Spy then their first-level Disguise gains Change Appearance: when used on self, a disguise worn cannot be penetrated by Penetrate Disguise.

ability.buladajn-pathfinder-post-8th-ste.Name: Buladajn Pathfinder Post 8th
ability.buladajn-pathfinder-post-8th-ste.Effect: At 8th level, Buladajn Pathfinder post-8th abilities that enable the character to pass more easily unseen are available 4 tables lower (for example, stealth).

ability.see-through-darkness.Name: See through Darkness
ability.see-through-darkness.Effect: See through all forms of supernatural darkness

ability.salahmen-post-8th-immunity-disco.Name: Salahmen Post 8th Immunity Discount
ability.salahmen-post-8th-immunity-disco.Effect: Post 8th immunities that act against effects that are normally stackable magical runes (such as Sleep/Catalepsy) are half normal price.

ability.harazaen-spirit-affinity.Name: Harazaen Spirit Affinity
ability.harazaen-spirit-affinity.Effect: Harazaen are well adapted to the Land of the Seven Winds and the transfer of supernatural power through them is easily achieved. To represent this, spirit-using classes do not have to pay the increased cost for spiritual immunities that others of their nation do.

ability.spiritual-discern-insanity.Name: Spiritual Discern Insanity
ability.spiritual-discern-insanity.Effect: Touch Range will reveal if the target with a spirit is Insane YES / NO

ability.detect-lie.Name: Detect Lie
ability.detect-lie.Effect: For the next 5 minutes, the user is aware whether any statements he hears the target make are lies.

ability.ward-pact-undead.Name: Ward Pact (Undead)
ability.ward-pact-undead.Effect:
An Ancient Folk gains certain ‘pacts’ with other-worldly creatures as they gain levels. These pacts are gained at second, fourth, six and eighth level. They are gained at no cost, and once a player has chosen a level’s pact it may never be changed.
For a pact to work against a specific creature the Ancient Folk must announce their pact clearly within hearing of that creature. They must loudly state their name, ancestry, and what they have a pact with.
If an Ancient Folk betrays a pact, by announcing it and then attacking that creature (except in purest self-defence), that pact is lost forever. The exact effect of a ward pact depends on the relative levels of the Ancient Folk and the creature. Pacts only fully affect creatures of the same or lower level than the user.
Creatures fully affected by an Ancient Folk’s ward pact may not choose to attack the Ancient Folk, except in purest self-defence. They may be forced to do so if controlled by another, such as a controlled undead or elemental, but will be reluctant and attempt to choose other targets where possible. In the situation where an affected creature strikes the Ancient Folk by mistake, it should be considered that at the last minute the creature realised the nature of his target, due to supernatural forces, and pulled back so inflicting no damage.
Creatures of too high a level to be fully affected by a pact will still be aware of the nature of the pact, and will generally act in a friendlier manner towards the Ancient Folk - the exact actions taken dependent on the creature in question. This is only a ‘role-play’ effect, but should usually make a noticeable difference in attitude.
The ward pacts standardly available to Ancient Folk are listed below. It is possible for individuals to seek to forge other pacts, though these are individual and handled with points requests. The exception to this is the Pact with Glass as detailed in the post 8th tables later on. 

• Undead- This works on all forms of undead. 
• Elemental - There are six different pacts, Salamanders, Shades, Sprites, Sylphs, Gnomes, and Undines. Each pact only affects elementals of that element. 
• Supernatural Power - The Ancient Folk may select a specific deity. The pact works against supernatural minions of that deity. If a pact is taken with a Magical Dragon or Drake this does not grant a pact with elves or elementals of that colour. For example, a pact with the Lady of the Stars would not influence priests of the Lady of the Stars, but would affect her angels.
• Elvenkind - May be any one of fire, air, earth, water, light, dark, drowe, winter, twilight or wood elves. 
• Faeries may not be pacted, nor may Seasonal, Onyx or Jade Elves

The exact effect of a ward pact depends on the relative levels of the Ancient Folk and the creature. Pacts only fully affect creatures of the same or lower level than the user.

They may be forced to do so if controlled by another, such as a controlled undead or elemental, but will be reluctant and attempt to choose other targets where possible. In the situation where an affected creature strikes the Ancient Folk by mistake, it should be considered that at the last minute the creature realised the nature of his target, due to supernatural forces, and pulled back so inflicting no damage.
Creatures of too high a level to be fully affected by a pact will still be aware of the nature of the pact, and will generally act in a friendlier manner towards the Ancient Folk - the exact actions taken dependent on the creature in question. This is only a ‘role-play’ effect, but should usually make a noticeable difference in attitude.
The ward pacts standardly available to Ancient Folk are listed below. It is possible for individuals to seek to forge other pacts, though these are individual and handled with points requests. The exception to this is the Pact with Glass as detailed in the post 8th tables later on. 

• Undead- This works on all forms of undead. 
• Elemental - There are six different pacts, Salamanders, Shades, Sprites, Sylphs, Gnomes, and Undines. Each pact only affects elementals of that element. 
• Supernatural Power - The Ancient Folk may select a specific deity. The pact works against supernatural minions of that deity. If a pact is taken with a Magical Dragon or Drake this does not grant a pact with elves or elementals of that colour. For example, a pact with the Lady of the Stars would not influence priests of the Lady of the Stars, but would affect her angels.
• Elvenkind - May be any one of fire, air, earth, water, light, dark, drowe, winter, twilight or wood elves. 
• Faeries may not be pacted, nor may Seasonal, Onyx or Jade Elves

ability.ward-pact-glass.Name: Ward Pact (Glass)
ability.ward-pact-glass.Effect:
An Ancient Folk gains certain ‘pacts’ with other-worldly creatures as they gain levels. These pacts are gained at second, fourth, six and eighth level. They are gained at no cost, and once a player has chosen a level’s pact it may never be changed.
For a pact to work against a specific creature the Ancient Folk must announce their pact clearly within hearing of that creature. They must loudly state their name, ancestry, and what they have a pact with.
If an Ancient Folk betrays a pact, by announcing it and then attacking that creature (except in purest self-defence), that pact is lost forever. The exact effect of a ward pact depends on the relative levels of the Ancient Folk and the creature. Pacts only fully affect creatures of the same or lower level than the user.

They may be forced to do so if controlled by another, such as a controlled undead or elemental, but will be reluctant and attempt to choose other targets where possible. This is only a ‘role-play’ effect, but should usually make a noticeable difference in attitude.

• Undead- This works on all forms of undead. 
• Elemental - There are six different pacts, Salamanders, Shades, Sprites, Sylphs, Gnomes, and Undines. Each pact only affects elementals of that element. 
• Supernatural Power - The Ancient Folk may select a specific deity. The pact works against supernatural minions of that deity. If a pact is taken with a Magical Dragon or Drake this does not grant a pact with elves or elementals of that colour. For example, a pact with the Lady of the Stars would not influence priests of the Lady of the Stars, but would affect her angels.
• Elvenkind - May be any one of fire, air, earth, water, light, dark, drowe, winter, twilight or wood elves. 
• Faeries may not be pacted, nor may Seasonal, Onyx or Jade Elves

ability.acute-hearing.Name: Acute Hearing
ability.acute-hearing.Effect: Allows the user to hear the movements of any creature within 60’. Effectively this means that when the character uses the ability by declaring ‘Acute Hearing’ all creatures within hearing should indicate their broad race category (e.g. elven) and location. At ref’s discretion some creatures may not make sounds, and things walking within walls are generally silent as the walls muffle their noises.

ability.perfect-human-disguise.Name: Perfect Human disguise
ability.perfect-human-disguise.Effect: May assume a human like appearance as a disguise which may not be penetrated by either physical or mystical means. Once this form is assumed (and the choice to do so must be done at the beginning of the adventure) they look and smell human in all ways, and no method will disprove this concealment. This mystical protection also extends to their choice of name for the adventure, their alignment and their profession. e.g. Hillis the Altunhust Horstval Druid of neutral good alignment takes a human form at the beginning of the adventure. To all means of detection he chooses to be Trewin, the Human Warrior and to appear to be Lawful Neutral in alignment. All spells, miracles and other powers as well as physical training will indicate this is the case. At the start of another adventure he could be completely different.

ability.lvl-2-spell.Name: Lvl 2 Spell
ability.lvl-2-spell.Effect: From third level, they can cast any one standard 2nd level spell once per two levels. At sixth level they may cast a standard 3rd level spell once per 2 levels. These spells cannot be of the same colour, nor may they be of opposite colours.

ability.lvl-3-spell.Name: Lvl 3 Spell
ability.lvl-3-spell.Effect: From third level, they can cast any one standard 2nd level spell once per two levels. At sixth level they may cast a standard 3rd level spell once per 2 levels. These spells cannot be of the same colour, nor may they be of opposite colours.

ability.detect-lie-atwill.Name: Detect Lie (At Will)
ability.detect-lie-atwill.Effect: For the next 5 minutes, the user is aware whether any statements he hears the target make are lies.

ability.dac.Name: DAC
ability.dac.Effect: Grants Dexterity Armour Class equal to the Count value.

ability.mac.Name: MAC
ability.mac.Effect: Grants Magical Armour Class equal to the Count value.

ability.druid.chosen-field.Name: Chosen Field
ability.druid.chosen-field.Effect: Choose an evocation field for effects that refer to your Chosen Field.

ability.druid.advocate-of-field.Name: Advocate of (Field)
ability.druid.advocate-of-field.Effect: Choose an evocation field for effects that refer to Advocate of (Field).

ability.defend-the-master.Name: Defend the Master
ability.defend-the-master.Effect: Negates one listed magical stopping effect and grants immunity to that effect for the following five minutes x 1/day. There must be another member of the Circle on the adventure for this to work.

ability.discern-bless-curse.Name: Discern Bless/Curse
ability.discern-bless-curse.Effect: This ability allows the priest to ascertain whether an object of person has been cursed (or blessed). This reveals also whether the Bless or Curse is beneficial or detrimental to the target, and at ref’s discretion may reveal further details dependent on the nature of the Bless or Curse.

ability.discern-disease.Name: Discern Disease
ability.discern-disease.Effect: This ability enables a priest to diagnose if any spiritual or physical disease is currently afflicting a person's spirit. The range of this ability is one inch. It will reveal details as to the nature of the disease at the ref’s discretion, always revealing a standard standard Cause Disease miracle.

ability.discern-nature-of-undead.Name: Discern Nature of Undead
ability.discern-nature-of-undead.Effect: This can be the ability to discern the aura of a foreign spirit in a body (if there is one). By looking at a person or creature, a priest can identify which type of undead - if any - are present. The priest can ascertain the dismiss level of the undead, even if the type is unknown. The range of this ability is line of sight, i.e. if you can see the target then you can use this ability. The standard seven types of undead are recognised by the priest, other types of undead will reveal their dismiss level with type `Unknown`.

ability.discern-nature-of-wounds.Name: Discern Nature of Wounds
ability.discern-nature-of-wounds.Effect:
This ability enables a priest to see how serious a particular wound is and how much damage has been done to a particular location of a wounded person. It is a spiritual ability so it does not work on elves etc. This ability has a range of one inch. By using it the priest is told any and all wounds a spiritual target is suffering from. If there is no spirit present with wounds, the only answer received is ‘No Wounds’ or ‘Unwounded’ – this answer is the same whether discerning on an uninjured human or a spiritless stone, as neither has a wounded spirit.
This ability is not able to reveal what the target’s remaining ‘uninjured’ life points are, or what percentage of the total their injuries are, or similar. However it does inform the user if a target has a location below 0 life points.

ability.discern-spiritual-mastery.Name: Discern Spiritual Mastery
ability.discern-spiritual-mastery.Effect: This ability allows the priest to determine whether an individual is under the influence of a Spiritual Mastery miracle. It does not reveal the influence of non-spiritual dominations, nor other miracles such as Voice of Power or Beguile – only Spiritual Mastery and Possession are identified. At ref’s discretion if the miracle in action is non-standard and very similar to Spiritual Mastery there may be some information yielded.

ability.evil-stairway.Name: Evil stairway
ability.evil-stairway.Effect:
This skill allows the Unholy Champion to create a list of evil spiritual innates for his own use.
It will typically follow the ethos of the evil church to which he is aligned, thus an Unholy Champion aligned to a church that likes to raise Undead will have a list which facilitates that, whereas if in a church with a large amount of evil spiritual causing on its miracle list, the Unholy Champion will need to have a predominantly ‘causing’ based list.
1. The total number of innates cannot exceed 40 spirits. It is the spirit cost used, rather than miracle level.
2. It is not possible to have a list with a greater number of higher level innates than lower level ones.
3. It should build up like a pyramid.
4. It is not possible to have a list which contains a particular innate if you do not have at least one innate of each miracle which precedes it on that list (i.e. you can’t have an innate cause serious unless your stairway includes at least one innate Cause Wound).
5. The innates should build up/follow a miracle tree [see Words from Above for further details].
6. It is not possible to have a miracle of a higher level than the level it is gained at when constructing the Stairway.
7. It is possible to have miracles that are traditionally neutral, as long as their purpose is for evil – much like the use of neutral miracles by pathed characters. Thus it would be possible to have ‘protection from goodly spirits’ on the list if used to summon a Wraith.
8. It is only possible to have miracles on the list that are on the miracle list of the Church to which the Champion is aligned.
9. Unaligned Champions do not have to follow rule 8 – they may instead have any standard evil miracle on their list.
10. Aligned Champions may have advanced miracles on their list if they are on the Church’s miracle list, however advanced miracles count as twice their normal spirit level to have on the UC’s list. EG.: Soul’s Hunger would cost 1 spirit x 2 = 2 against the 40 spirit total. Again it is necessary for this religious miracle to make sense to the rest of your list.
11. It is not possible to have miracles running at 1/3 levels.

ability.neutral-stairway-list.Name: Neutral stairway list
ability.neutral-stairway-list.Effect:
This skill allows the Grey Knight to create a list of neutral spiritual innates for his own use.
It will typically follow the ethos of the neutral church to which he is aligned, thus a Grey Knight aligned to a church that focuses on balance or mediation may have a list which facilitates that, whereas if in a church with a large amount of neutral spiritual effects on its miracle list, the Grey Knight will need to have a predominantly utility or balance-based list.
1. The total number of innates cannot exceed 40 spirits. It is the spirit cost used, rather than miracle level.
2. It is not possible to have a list with a greater number of higher level innates than lower level ones.
3. It should build up like a pyramid.
4. It is not possible to have a list which contains a particular innate if you do not have at least one innate of each miracle which precedes it on that list (i.e. you can’t have an innate Cause Serious unless your stairway includes at least one innate Cause Wound).
5. The innates should build up/follow a miracle tree [see Words from Above for further details].
6. It is not possible to have a miracle of a higher level than the level it is gained at when constructing the Stairway.
7. It is possible to have miracles that are traditionally neutral, as long as their purpose fits the ethos of neutrality – much like the use of neutral miracles by pathed characters.
8. It is only possible to have miracles on the list that are on the miracle list of the Church to which the Grey Knight is aligned.
9. Grey Knights do not have to follow rule 8 – they may instead have any standard neutral miracle on their list.
10. Grey Knights may have advanced miracles on their list if they are on the Church’s miracle list, however advanced miracles count as twice their normal spirit level to have on the Grey Knight’s list. EG.: a miracle that normally costs 1 spirit would cost 2 against the 40 spirit total. Again it is necessary for this religious miracle to make sense with the rest of your list.
11. It is not possible to have miracles running at 1/3 levels.

ability.precognition.Name: Precognition
ability.precognition.Effect:
Allows the user to seek confirmation of three facts, gaining Yes / No answers to three separate questions. Questions asked about things which are specifically immune to neuronics (as opposed to merely being mindless) cannot be confirmed, and things with no physical or neuronic aspect to them (such as purely spiritual creatures) will only have questions answered if a creature with a mind knows the answers. 
It takes 30 seconds of uninterrupted concentration to activate, during which time user must sit quietly and take no action. The questions are considered to be asked and answered instantly at the end of the concentration period.

ability.probe.Name: Probe
ability.probe.Effect: The user may ask one question of the target’s mind. The creature is not aware that they are being probed, and the question will be answered truthfully. Only simple answers can be gained from this ability – single facts, for example e.g. “Under the cloth”, “Black”, “I did it”. Before an answer is obtained the user must concentrate in sight of the target for a full 30 seconds.

ability.psychic-cage.Name: Psychic Cage
ability.psychic-cage.Effect: One target within sight is prevented from transporting themselves using mental powers. Each time the target attempts to use such a power (e.g. Neuro-Synaptic Jump, Neuro-Planar Vortex) the user takes 12 tblp (reduced as normal by neural foci) but the target’s ability does not function – effectively the target is instantly returned to the spot which they are attempting to leave. This ability may be released early by the user, and only functions while the target is in sight of the user – in other words, it will not prevent a shift being used if the user cannot see the target.

ability.psychic-guide.Name: Psychic Guide
ability.psychic-guide.Effect: While active, the user is aware of faint traces left on objects and the air itself by the passage of beings with minds, fading with time. This allows the user to track individual minds by following the trail they leave, and also to judge how many minds have been in an area, and how recently. Traces usually fade completely after around 24 hours, though in a heavily used area they may be obscured by newer traces. The traces left behind are unique, so the user may track a specific mind; and if the user has previously seen a mind's aura, such as by the use of Auric Colour, they will recognise it again in the future. It is also possible to distinguish animals and similarly unintelligent minds from those of thinking beings. However, while this ability is active the constant traces left all around make it difficult to focus on the real world - the user may not use dexterity AC during this time.

ability.reactions.Name: Reactions
ability.reactions.Effect: The user gains 3 extra points of DAC for the duration. This ability cannot stack with itself.

ability.read-runes.Name: Read Runes
ability.read-runes.Effect: This skill allows the character to read spiritual runes with the proficiency of a priest. They may fully utilise spiritual scrolls of their alignment with this skill, but not scrolls of any other alignment.

ability.recognise-goodly-spirit.Name: Recognise Goodly Spirit
ability.recognise-goodly-spirit.Effect:
This ability can identify whether the target has a good spirit or not. There is a YES / NO answer.
Range:12 feet
Verbal: Spirit art thou good?

ability.recognise-evil-spirit.Name: Recognise evil spirit
ability.recognise-evil-spirit.Effect:
This ability can identify whether the target has an evil spirit or not. There is a YES / NO answer.
Range:12 feet
Verbal: Spirit art thou evil?

ability.release-own-miracle.Name: Release own miracle
ability.release-own-miracle.Effect:
This ability enables a priest to remove the effects of some of his own miracles from a victim if he so wishes. Whilst the priest points at the person to be freed. The range of this ability is 20’ (roughly 7 paces).
Only certain miracles are affected by this ability – in general these are all miracles with a duration which is not instant, unless the miracle specifically notes in its description that it is not releasable. It should be noted that if a priest dies ALL his releasable miracles are freed, regardless of range!
This does not apply to any scrolls, spirit items etc he may have made. Basically during his death trauma, his involuntary screaming rends the link he has forged between the real and the spiritual planes, and thus his final cry reverberates through /around the spiritual universe!
Verbal: Spirit! I release thee!

ability.repel-evil.Name: Repel Evil
ability.repel-evil.Effect:
This power will work on any Evil creature with a spirit within 20’. An Evil spirit so affected is instantly repelled away from the Paladin up to 20’, or until a solid object is met.
Verbal: Spirits of Evil I repel thee!

ability.repel-good.Name: Repel Good
ability.repel-good.Effect:
This power will work on any goodly creature with a spirit within 20’. A goodly spirit so affected is instantly repelled away from the Unholy Champion up to 20’, or until a solid object is met.
 Any Unholy Champion may sacrifice this ability in order to gain a permanent beneficial Curse (signed on card). This operates in the same manner as a Paladin’s Permanent Bless being irremovable as long as the Unholy Champion is an Unholy Champion. If the Unholy Champion becomes immune to Handbook Curses (as per the table 3 post 8th ability), then he remains cursed and retains the A/C benefit. If however he becomes immune to non-handbook curses (for example via the table 10 immunity), then they lose the A/C benefit from their curse.

ability.unholy-champion-devotion.repel-g.Name: Repel Good
ability.unholy-champion-devotion.repel-g.Effect:
This power will work on any goodly creature with a spirit within 20â€™. A goodly spirit so affected is instantly repelled away from the Unholy Champion up to 20â€™, or until a solid object is met.
Any Unholy Champion may sacrifice this ability in order to gain a permanent beneficial Curse (signed on card). This operates in the same manner as a Paladinâ€™s Permanent Bless being irremovable as long as the Unholy Champion is an Unholy Champion. If the Unholy Champion becomes immune to Handbook Curses (as per the table 3 post 8th ability), then he remains cursed and retains the A/C benefit. If however he becomes immune to non-handbook curses (for example via the table 10 immunity), then they lose the A/C benefit from their curse.

ability.unholy-champion-devotion.permane.Name: Permanent Beneficial Curse
ability.unholy-champion-devotion.permane.Effect: Take a permanent beneficial Curse, signed on the card, instead of gaining Repel Good. This grants +2 DAC from a Curse source while the character remains an Unholy Champion.

ability.repel-undead.Name: Repel Undead
ability.repel-undead.Effect:
This power will work on any Undead creature with a spirit within 20’. An Undead so affected is instantly repelled away from the Paladin up to 20’, or until a solid object is met.
Verbal: Undead spirit I repel thee!

ability.resistance-to-own-element.Name: Resistance to own element
ability.resistance-to-own-element.Effect: This skill means that the Power-Master cannot be harmed by natural occurrences of his element, including lightning for air Power-Masters and rock-falls for earth. Additionally they take only half-effect from supernatural attacks of that element.

ability.shield-the-master.Name: Shield the Master
ability.shield-the-master.Effect: Should a Circle member lay a hand upon the shoulder of this Valdstayn, then all ranged magical spells and effects which target the Circle member, instead target this Valdstayn. While using this ability the Valdstayn gains 2 additional MAC. Note that it is possible for two Valdstayn to use this power on each other! In which case each takes attacks destined for the other, and both gain the additional magical AC.

ability.stand-by-the-master.Name: Stand by the Master
ability.stand-by-the-master.Effect: Negates one listed magical domination effect and grants immunity to that effect for the following five minutes. There must be another member of the Circle on the adventure for this to work.

ability.telekinesis.Name: Telekinesis
ability.telekinesis.Effect:
This spell will move one object as directed by the caster. The force of the telekinesis equals the force the referee can exert with one hand. It cannot be used to wield a weapon effectively. It cannot pick up objects that contain a spirit. Only one Telekinesis may be cast upon one object or by a wizard at any one time.
Verbal: Sylphs of air I conjure thee telekinesise that... to there

ability.tell-animal-type.Name: Tell Animal Type
ability.tell-animal-type.Effect: With 10 seconds examination can tell the type of natural animal something is. This does not give level or additional information.

ability.tell-direction.Name: Tell Direction
ability.tell-direction.Effect: With 10 seconds looking at an open sky the druid can tell which way is North.

ability.tell-disease.Name: Tell Disease
ability.tell-disease.Effect: With 10 seconds examination can tell if an object/liquid is diseased or if a Flesh & Blood (as above) creature has been diseased. User will receive approximate information as to the potency/quantity/duration of the disease.

ability.tell-plant-type.Name: Tell Plant Type
ability.tell-plant-type.Effect: Recognises natural plants. User can identify the plant’s type and receive some general information about that plant from the adventure’s referee. This ability has a range of Line of Sight.

ability.tell-poison.Name: Tell Poison
ability.tell-poison.Effect: With 10 seconds examination can tell if an object/liquid is poisonous or if a Flesh & Blood creature has been poisoned. User will receive approximate information as to the potency/quantity/duration of the poison. Has a 1” range.

ability.tell-time.Name: Tell Time
ability.tell-time.Effect: With 10 seconds looking at an open sky the druid can tell the time, to within the nearest ¼ hour.

ability.trusty-and-old-armour.Name: Trusty & Old (armour)
ability.trusty-and-old-armour.Effect: The Armour the character begins the adventure with is immune to Shatter, Rust, Melt, Disintegrate and Warp until the end of the adventure. If this armour is somehow destroyed or lost before the end of the adventure, the character gains no achievement points for that day.

ability.undead-returner.Name: Undead Returner
ability.undead-returner.Effect:
Unholy Champions upon their death may choose to release an evil spirit to seek vengeance upon their slayer. This standardly takes the form of an undead. The more potent the Unholy Champion the more potent the Undead Returner. For the statistics of these undead please refer to the Handbook or Word from Above publications. Their hits are now calculated as though the Unholy Champion had raised them and are thus dependent upon his level [this does included published increases such as Undead Master]. It is possible to choose an undead lower than your current level (e.g. a 6th level Unholy Champion could return as a Ghoul). An Unholy Champion’s returner will seek to kill their slayer, anyone involved in their death, and may then act as it wishes until slain.
1: Zombie
2: Zombie
3: Skeleton
4: Ghoul
5: Ghoul
6: Mummy
7: Wraith
8: Wight

ability.use-spirit-items.Name: Use Spirit Items
ability.use-spirit-items.Effect: This skill allows you to make full use of spiritual items of their alignment.

ability.weapon-mastery-with-h-or-mp.Name: Weapon mastery with H or MP weapon
ability.weapon-mastery-with-h-or-mp.Effect: By means of training and practice the Halfling may become more skilled with one specific weapon e.g. Dagger, Broadsword, Hand Mace, Battle Axe, Bastard Sword, Spear etc. This Mastery means that one extra grade of damage is added to the normal base damage done by a weapon of this type. Any thrown or machine propelled weapon may be chosen.

ability.1-dac-in-darkness.Name: 1 DAC in Darkness
ability.1-dac-in-darkness.Effect: While in darkness your DAC is increased by 1.

ability.half-effect-magic.Name: 1/2 effect magic
ability.half-effect-magic.Effect: You are naturally magic resistant, so they take only half effect from all magic, resisting spells as if they were twice their level. As a result of this, any wizard loses half their mana.

ability.half-spirit.Name: Half-Spirit
ability.half-spirit.Effect: You have only half a spirit and take half effect from spiritual effects.

ability.spiritless.Name: Spiritless
ability.spiritless.Effect: You have no spirit. You take no damage from miracles unless the source is mantic, and no damage from pure spiritual effects.

ability.mindless.Name: Mindless
ability.mindless.Effect: Mindless creatures have infinite levels of resistance to neuronics and take no damage from neuronics. This does not prevent neuronic communications

ability.half-effect-paralysis.Name: 1/2 effect paralysis
ability.half-effect-paralysis.Effect: Half effect from all forms of paralysis (so 5 minutes would be reduced to 2 minutes 30 seconds, for example).

ability.half-effect-poison.Name: 1/2 effect poison
ability.half-effect-poison.Effect: Half effect from all forms of poison

ability.1st-backstab.Name: 1st Backstab
ability.1st-backstab.Effect: The Backstab skill grants +1 damage grade to blows stuck from behind by the user. It may also be applied to H or MP attacks from behind. It may also be applied to blows struck versus completely helpless targets.

ability.1st-grade-of-strength.Name: 1st Grade of Strength
ability.1st-grade-of-strength.Effect: Each grade of Strength allows the character to inflict one additional grade of damage [still limited by maximum damage]. It also allows the possessor to be able to ‘carry’ a single normal person / load by placing both of their hands on the target. If two grades of strength are possessed it is possible to carry a person in a single handgrip, or two people with one in each hand. Strength being used to carry things cannot at the same time be used to increase the damage grade called.

ability.2nd-grade-of-strength.Name: 2nd Grade of Strength
ability.2nd-grade-of-strength.Effect: Each grade of Strength allows the character to inflict one additional grade of damage [still limited by maximum damage]. It also allows the possessor to be able to ‘carry’ a single normal person / load by placing both of their hands on the target. If two grades of strength are possessed it is possible to carry a person in a single handgrip, or two people with one in each hand. Strength being used to carry things cannot at the same time be used to increase the damage grade called.

ability.three-quarter-effect-paralysis.Name: 3/4 effect paralysis
ability.three-quarter-effect-paralysis.Effect: Take only 1/4 the effect of paralysis (so 5 minutes would be reduced to 1 minute 15 seconds, for example).

ability.three-quarter-effect-poison.Name: 3/4 effect poison
ability.three-quarter-effect-poison.Effect: Take only 1/4 of the effects of poisons.

ability.beguile.Name: Beguile
ability.beguile.Effect: The Beguile ability influences one target within 20' in a similar manner to the Beguile Spirit miracle. It affects any target with a resistance level of up to the user's own level, and is considered to be from a magical and spiritual source. The Beguile lasts 5 minutes, during which time the target must role-play as if the user is their closest and most trusted friend, despite any evidence to the contrary, and will generally do anything they can to aid the user. Their alignment is not changed, so that they may still find some acts repugnant, for example, and they are unlikely to be willing to commit suicidal acts, but will otherwise act to the best of their ability to do as the user wants.

ability.conceal-lie.Name: Conceal Lie
ability.conceal-lie.Effect: The Conceal Lies ability enables the Blauz to lie to any ability which detects lies. It lasts for 5 minutes, and is considered to be both magical and spiritual in power - if the target is affected by either of these they are influenced by the ability, even if the Lie Detection power they are using is neuronic, for example.

ability.consume-primal-vitae.Name: Consume Primal Vitae
ability.consume-primal-vitae.Effect: Requires 30 seconds physical contact with a helpless or willing, living, fully flesh-and-blood target. The touch draws the strength from the victim and gives it to the Duidoin, leaving the victim suffering the first, five-minute stage of Disease for 15 minutes (i.e. they are unable to run, shout, cast, use DAC or fight. They may still walk and talk). Immunity to Disease grants immunity to the effect, as does Immunity to Flesh-and-Blood effects, even the limited immunity possessed by elves. If the target is affected, the Duidoin is cured 3 total body and 1 to the most injured location for each resistance level possessed by the victim-this resistance level is taken to be the lowest of their resistance to magic and spirits. Temporary power-ups or resistances such as the gold Hearten spell do not increase the curing received. No target may suffer the effects of a Consume Primal Vitae more than twice in a 24-hour period.

ability.immunity-to-darkness.Name: Darkness
ability.immunity-to-darkness.Effect: Can now see through supernatural darkness in all ways. This does not mean they can see in real-world darkness

ability.discern-edible.Name: Discern Edible
ability.discern-edible.Effect: Ogres can naturally tell if something is edible. The discern has 10ft range and will reveal if something is edible or not. It will not reveal if something has been poisoned (for example a chunk of beef would be edible even if poisoned) but would reveal if something naturally can’t be eaten (e.g. a creature with acidic blood).

ability.double-dac-while-fleeing.Name: Double DAC while Fleeing
ability.double-dac-while-fleeing.Effect: While in full retreat, doing nothing but fleeing, the user doubles their DAC value to their maximum AC.

ability.draw-on-earthpower.Name: Draw on Earthpower
ability.draw-on-earthpower.Effect: By spending one minute in inactive concentration drawing upon the natural force around them for assistance - this allows the Alfar to mimic any one Earthpower Evocation which is on the standard list (As detailed in The Druids Way) of their own level or below, using the appropriate gestures but without verbals.

ability.earthshift.Name: Earthshift
ability.earthshift.Effect:
This spell transports the wizard from a spot immersed in the appropriate element to another similar point that the caster can see or is within 20'. There is a 2 second period of disorientation on arrival.
In general, there must be a source of the appropriate element at each end of a size approximately equal to half the caster's size.

ability.evaluate-metal-stone-jewels.Name: Evaluate (metal, stone, jewels only)
ability.evaluate-metal-stone-jewels.Effect: This skill allows you to judge the intrinsic value of an metal, stone, or jewel. It will not tell the you whether an item has any special properties (i.e. magic, spirit, etc); simply the fiscal value of the item in grulls.

ability.immunity-to-tracking.Name: Immunity to Tracking
ability.immunity-to-tracking.Effect: You no longer leave tracks or make sounds when moving in your natural environment (immunity to tracking and acute hearing)

ability.light-sensitivity.Name: Light Sensitivity
ability.light-sensitivity.Effect: Drowe hate daylight and suffer a -2 reduction to their armour class in it

ability.meld-with-stone.Name: Meld with Stone
ability.meld-with-stone.Effect:
This spell draws the wizard into the earth upon which he is standing and, for the duration of the spell, the wizard is deemed not to exist except for any purpose bar observation. The wizard may perceive during this time but cannot prematurely end the spell, nor take any other actions. A Dispel Magic of the appropriate level from an external source will end the spell and eject the wizard from the earth, however, as the ground where the wizard vanished radiates magic. Whilst under the effects of this spell, no time passes for the caster; as such, any effects they were under when they enter the ground pause until they are released from it. This applies to both beneficial and disadvantageous effects.
Verbal: Gnomes of earth take me in your embrace and hide me from sight.

ability.neuromastery-innate.Name: Neuromastery
ability.neuromastery-innate.Effect:
Choose one of the below on use -
 # Neuro Mastery...
On Darkness: As long as the light is at most weak candlelight, the user may ‘fly’.
Through Darkness: Half effect from darkness-based attacks.
On Air: The user may ‘fly’.
Through Air: Half effect from air attacks, including electrical.
On Water: The caster may walk on water as if it were solid ground.
Through Water: The caster may breathe underwater.
Note: Either version of Neuro-Mastery Water grants the user ½ effect potions, poisons, and acid for the duration.
On Light: The user may ‘fly’, as long as the light is at least strong candlelight.
Through Light: Half effect from light-based attacks.
On Earth: The user may walk on walls, floors, ceilings, mud, quicksand, as if it were solid, level ground.
Through Earth: The user may walk through any stone or earth wall of not more than 10’ in thickness. Walls thicker than this cannot be entered.
Through Fire: Half effect fire-based attacks.
The Neuro Mastery Through abilities above will stack with resistances to such attacks acquired post-8th, though they will not stack with other temporary defences (e.g. Walk through Fire Spell, or the Resist Fire
evocation).
Only one Neuro-Mastery may be active at a time.

ability.passwall.Name: Passwall
ability.passwall.Effect:
This spell allows the caster to walk through any wall or stone object of not more than 10' in thickness. If the wall is more than 10' thick the spell fails to work but mana and life points are still expended. It does not apply to floors and the user can only walk in a straight line. You cannot cast multiple Passwall spells to allow more movement.
 Verbal: Gnomes of earth I conjure thee, grant me the power to passwall

ability.recognise-ep.Name: Recognise EP
ability.recognise-ep.Effect: This discern has a 1” range and will reveal whether something within that range has Earthpower or not. Yes/No answer

ability.regeneration.Name: Regeneration
ability.regeneration.Effect: You constantly and slowly regenerate. You gets one total body life point and one to the most injured location back every five minutes of ’time in’. It cannot regenerate fire or spiritual damage however and neither can it regenerate once it is dead. Limbs will also regenerate if severed, after 12 hours.

ability.terror-scream.Name: Terror Scream
ability.terror-scream.Effect: The Terror Scream causes fear in all creatures of the Blauz's level or below for one minute. This effect is “physical” and does not affect mindless creatures, such as zombies or elementals. It will however affect non-physical creatures capable of hearing the sound, as long as they are not mindless. This scream does not affect other Blauz.

ability.the-touch.Name: The Touch
ability.the-touch.Effect: Calabrim possess an ability they call 'The Touch' and it is this ability which paralyses a magic using creature. If the target possesses mana points, or magical innate powers it functions as a paralysis lasting 5 minutes. However the cost of using this ability is steep, the Calabrim is drained one level, which is recovered in the same fashion as a level lost to the touch of a wraith. However as it is a self-inflicted level loss immunity to level drain does not apply. If the ability fails in any fashion (e.g. the target is immune to paralysis, has no magical ability or uses a war cry to keep moving) no level is lost. In any event the touch cannot be used more than once for every two levels possessed in any given day regardless of success or failure.

ability.true-kin-with-reed.Name: True Kin With Reed
ability.true-kin-with-reed.Effect:
Members of the reed may:
• Use touch range discerns on each other up to line of sight
• all know of each other’s approximate location
• All know if others are alive or dead
• They may send messages (as below) between each other at the cost of 3 tblp per use
 Improved Message: One target known to the user or in sight of them receives a telepathic message of up to one sentence in length (at most 20 words, all one sentence only). This message will span any distance, even interplanar distances.

ability.vulnerability-to-cold.Name: Vulnerability to cold
ability.vulnerability-to-cold.Effect: Crol cannot acquire any form of immunity to cold and lose 4 DAC and 1 grade of strength (to a minimum of 0) in severe cold environments

ability.ward-pact-atwill.Name: Ward pact
ability.ward-pact-atwill.Effect:
An Ancient Folk gains certain ‘pacts’ with other-worldly creatures as they gain levels. These pacts are gained at second, fourth, six and eighth level. They are gained at no cost, and once a player has chosen a level’s pact it may never be changed.
For a pact to work against a specific creature the Ancient Folk must announce their pact clearly within hearing of that creature. They must loudly state their name, ancestry, and what they have a pact with.
If an Ancient Folk betrays a pact, by announcing it and then attacking that creature (except in purest self-defence), that pact is lost forever. The exact effect of a ward pact depends on the relative levels of the Ancient Folk and the creature. Pacts only fully affect creatures of the same or lower level than the user.
Creatures fully affected by an Ancient Folk’s ward pact may not choose to attack the Ancient Folk, except in purest self-defence. They may be forced to do so if controlled by another, such as a controlled undead or elemental, but will be reluctant and attempt to choose other targets where possible. In the situation where an affected creature strikes the Ancient Folk by mistake, it should be considered that at the last minute the creature realised the nature of his target, due to supernatural forces, and pulled back so inflicting no damage.
Creatures of too high a level to be fully affected by a pact will still be aware of the nature of the pact, and will generally act in a friendlier manner towards the Ancient Folk - the exact actions taken dependent on the creature in question. This is only a ‘role-play’ effect, but should usually make a noticeable difference in attitude.
The ward pacts standardly available to Ancient Folk are listed below. It is possible for individuals to seek to forge other pacts, though these are individual and handled with points requests. The exception to this is the Pact with Glass as detailed in the post 8th tables later on. 

• Undead- This works on all forms of undead. 
• Elemental - There are six different pacts, Salamanders, Shades, Sprites, Sylphs, Gnomes, and Undines. Each pact only affects elementals of that element. 
• Supernatural Power - The Ancient Folk may select a specific deity. The pact works against supernatural minions of that deity. If a pact is taken with a Magical Dragon or Drake this does not grant a pact with elves or elementals of that colour. For example, a pact with the Lady of the Stars would not influence priests of the Lady of the Stars, but would affect her angels.
• Elvenkind - May be any one of fire, air, earth, water, light, dark, drowe, winter, twilight or wood elves. 
• Faeries may not be pacted, nor may Seasonal, Onyx or Jade Elves

ability.daring-deed.Name: Daring Deed
ability.daring-deed.Effect:
This skill allows the warrior to perform a daring deed from the list below.
Salmon Leap, physical Neuro Balance [1minute], Combat Wary [only against the next blow suffered at 12 levels], or Arrow Cutting [1minute] as tables ability.
The use of any of these skills requires either 30seconds preparation, or costs 6tblp in effort to occur.
This skill although, useable at will, can be used at most 1/15 minutes.

ability.flick-of-the-wrist.Name: Flick of the Wrist
ability.flick-of-the-wrist.Effect:
This skill allows the warrior to strike a non-damaging blow such that the opponent struck takes one of the following effects: Knockback, Disarm [at normal weapon masteries], or Stunning Blow [affecting 8 levels and below].
This blow may be on any blow of combat after 30secs preparation, or at anytime but costing 6tblp in effort to perform. This skill, although useable at will, can be used at most 1/15 minutes.

ability.mc.acrobat.l1.Name: DAC +4
ability.mc.acrobat.l1.Effect: +4 DAC only vs. blows struck while Leaping, Back Flipping or Hand Springing, which may exceed the Acrobat's normal max AC (not above 12). No abilities in this class may be used when wearing armour heavier than studded leather

ability.mc.acrobat.l5.Name: Hand Spring
ability.mc.acrobat.l5.Effect: This allows the acrobat to spring ten feet in any direction, as per a Leap, at the end of any other Jump or Back Flip (not after a Hand Spring). Must have one hand free when this is used

ability.mc.acrobat.l6.Name: Leap Strike
ability.mc.acrobat.l6.Effect: May strike a blow x1/2 levels  during a Leap or Back Flip (not during a Hand Spring). This blow has a maximum of 24pt Quad. Only one blow may be struck during a single Leap using this ability. Lightning Reactions grants immunity to this blow

ability.mc.adept.l1.Name: May drink an additional two 6pt cure potions per day for each level of
ability.mc.adept.l1.Effect: This multi-class bought. Is no longer limited to a maximum drinkable per hour

ability.mc.adept.l2.Name: NAC +1
ability.mc.adept.l2.Effect: +1 NAC (Neuronic Armour Class) - this reduces incoming neuronic damage by 1pt to the head and 1pt tblp for each point of NAC possessed before any other reductions

ability.mc.adept.l3.Name: May now use neuronics 30 seconds after suffering an Emotion effect (as
ability.mc.adept.l3.Effect: Per Oraculum Insight, rather than five minutes*

ability.mc.adept.l5.Name: Now always rounds incoming neuronic damage down to the nearest whole

ability.mc.adept.l6.2.Name: Neural Foci Casting Reduction
ability.mc.adept.l6.2.Effect: May use Neural Foci to reduce casting damage from own neuronics to 1/6 original cost (rounded up), from 1/3. Psi-Drowe, Silver Folk neuronic classes and Awakeners who buy this class do not receive the level 3 ability, instead gaining 'half-damage from incoming neuronics' as per other neuronic classes.

ability.mc.adventurer.l3.Name: Contacts
ability.mc.adventurer.l3.Effect: Starts the dungeon with 6 ISP of standard items. These may clearly not benefit from once ever uses or similar reductions, and are personalised to the owner

ability.mc.adventurer.l4.Name: Seen it all before
ability.mc.adventurer.l4.Effect: Acts as a knowledge based major prayer about a ward/creature/similar that mercenaries may have chatted about in the tavern

ability.mc.adventurer.l5.Name: Word of Warning
ability.mc.adventurer.l5.Effect: A pre-dungeon lucky idea about what equipment would be useful to have

ability.mc.adventurer.l6.Name: Improved Contacts
ability.mc.adventurer.l6.Effect: Starts the dungeon with 12 ISP of standard items. These may clearly not benefit from once ever uses or similar reductions, and are personalised to the owner.

ability.mc.alchemist.l4.Effect: One potion of this glyph for each two levels of skill as above, per day, at a cost of 200 Grulls per dose

ability.mc.alchemist.l5.Name: May choose one glyph of grey or own colour of up to 6th level and make
ability.mc.alchemist.l5.Effect: One potion of this glyph for each two levels of skill as above, per day, at a cost of 300 Grulls per dose

ability.mc.alchemist.l6.Name: May choose one glyph of grey or own colour of up to 8th level and make
ability.mc.alchemist.l6.Effect: One potion of this glyph for each three levels of skill as above, per day, at a cost of 400 Grulls per day. Glyphs chosen as above must be recorded on the character card at the time of choice, and may not be changed. Potions may only be made of 'self' range glyphs, summonations, or touch-range glyphs, in which case they are considered salves in the manner of blade venom and must be applied to the target directly. The potions created by this class as above are all considered to be adventure-temporary only, and no cards are ever issued, unless 'Permanence' below is bought

ability.mc.arch-druid.l1.1.Name: Arch-Druid Earthpower Pool
ability.mc.arch-druid.l1.1.Effect: +6 EP, non-cumulative with other EP from multi-classes, or 8 EP of innates.

ability.mc.arch-druid.l1.2.Name: Recognise Arch-Druid
ability.mc.arch-druid.l1.2.Effect: Recognise Arch-Druid at will, line-of-sight range.

ability.mc.armour-master.l5.Name: Armoured Defence
ability.mc.armour-master.l5.Effect: Grants a five minute Rockskin style reduction to any weapon blow that the user's armour applies vs

ability.mc.artisan-of-the-mind.l1.Name: + 1% chance per level for crafting Neuronic items

ability.mc.artisan-of-the-mind.l2.Name: ½ level loss from crafting Neuronic items

ability.mc.artisan-of-the-mind.l3.Name: The cost of each roll is reduced by 10%

ability.mc.artisan-of-the-mind.l4.Name: Place of Power
ability.mc.artisan-of-the-mind.l4.Effect: The artisan has their own place of power. Reducing the number of successful rolls needed by 1 (to a minimum of 1). Does not stack with the CC benefit Place of Power

ability.mc.artisan-of-the-mind.l5.Name: The cost of each roll is now reduced by 20% total

ability.mc.artisan-of-the-mind.l6.Name: Reciprocates Binding no longer has a 5% penalty if making the item for self

ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l1.1.Name: B-Class Two-Hand Requirement
ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l1.1.Effect: No abilities are gained except when a 'B'-class weapon is being used in two hands.

ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l1.2.Name: Warrior's Eye
ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l1.2.Effect: At will, after 10 seconds of study within 20', may judge a target's physical hits only.

ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l2.Name: Blade-Fury
ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l2.Effect: Grants a 6pt damage reduction against all weapon blows for five minutes

ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l4.2.Name: Disarm Mastery +1
ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l4.2.Effect: +1 mastery for the purpose of Disarms only.

ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l5.Name: Opponent Study
ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l5.Effect: Enhances a Blade-Fury to a 9pt reduction versus one opponent only after 30 seconds of calm observation

ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l6.Name: Base damage with weapon is increased a further 3 pts to 15pts if a
ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l6.Effect: Bastard weapon or 18 pts if a full B class weapon

ability.mc.battlemaster-e.l2.Name: Blade-Fury

ability.mc.battlemaster-e.l4.Name: Weapon-Break

ability.mc.battlemaster-e.l5.Name: Opponent Study

ability.mc.battlemaster-e.l6.1.Effect: May now utilise Enhanced Distancing skill when using weapons as described at 1st level. Enhanced Distancing must still be purchased as normal.

ability.mc.battlemaster-e.l6.2.Name: Grand Weapon Break
ability.mc.battlemaster-e.l6.2.Effect: May enhance one innate Weapon Break such that it works as per a Grand Breaking Blow [Grand Tanashiwara] but only against weapons, shields or armour.

ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l1.1.Name: O-Class Weapon Requirement
ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l1.1.Effect: No abilities are gained except when a single 'O' class weapon is being used, with or without a shield.

ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l1.2.Name: Warrior's Eye
ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l1.2.Effect: At will, after 10 seconds of study within 20', may judge a target's physical hits only.

ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l2.Name: Blade-Fury

ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l3.Name: Opponent Study

ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l4.2.Name: Disarm Mastery +1
ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l4.2.Effect: +1 mastery for the purpose of Disarms only.

ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l5.Name: Enhanced Distancing Combat
ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l5.Effect: From Enhanced Distancing Combat, may use Enhanced Distancing (and later Defensive Combat) with an 'O' class weapon of at least 30", or if Enhanced Weapon Mastery Shield is possessed is no longer restricted to DAC 6

ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l6.Name: Max
ability.mc.battlemaster-o.l6.Effect: Damage is now Quin with one weapon in one hand, as above

ability.mc.berserker.l1.Name: Berserk Rage
ability.mc.berserker.l1.Effect: As per the Warrior Specialist skill 'Cold Rage', but gains a 50% reduction from damage suffered. However in this frenzy the Berserker is unable to differentiate friend from foe, and will attack any who look hostile or aggressive. It is not possible to use any non-weapon blow active skill whilst Berserking. i.e. An ability you need to will into effect - thus they could continue to use DAC, but not use Warrior's Eye. Obviously this does not apply to abilities mentioning the use of this skill. This is a permanent ability; as noted above the Berserker has no choice about the use of this ability and must engage whenever they are faced with combat or hostile situation

ability.mc.berserker.l6.Name: Berserker Specialist
ability.mc.berserker.l6.Effect: Stamina / Unarmed Combat / Enhanced Berserker Spirit *The above life scale is for Human Berserkers - other races follow the life scale of Warriors of their race. Stamina and Unarmed Combat are as per the Warrior Specialist Skills. Strength is as per the tables ability - this grade applies at all times, still max 2. Enhanced Berserker Spirit: This ability makes the Berserker, whilst raging, immune to the following physical and spiritual effects: Paralysis, Freeze and Fear. Berserkers are subject to certain restrictions from 1st level as listed below. 1. Berserkers must be Chaotic in alignment 2. Berserkers are very superstitious and afraid of magic, therefore if any noticeable magic, or visual seemingly supernatural effects are cast the Berserker must flee from them (Immunity to Fear does not apply) 3. Berserkers may not use any magical items of any sort. 4. Berserkers may not use shields or any armour above Studded Leather [bar Dwarves who may continue to wear any metal armour]. 5. Berserkers may not leave combat until it is over, baring rule 2 above. 6. Berserkers failing to fulfill their role will find the Berserking Spirit leave them in disgust resulting in them dying, with the only option available being Rebirth - i.e. no resurrection effect will work

ability.mc.berserker.specialist.enhanced.Name: Enhanced Berserker Spirit
ability.mc.berserker.specialist.enhanced.Effect: While raging, gain immunity to Paralysis, Freeze and Fear.

ability.mc.bounty-hunter.l1.Name: Discern Criminal at will, takes 3 seconds inspection, 20' range
ability.mc.bounty-hunter.l1.Effect: Discerns degree of outlawhood (e.g. racially outlawed, 'wolfshead'). This is a physical discern

ability.mc.bounty-hunter.l3.1.Name: Sniff Skill
ability.mc.bounty-hunter.l3.1.Effect: Gains Sniff skill and can always identify the smell of a racially outlawed race.

ability.mc.bounty-hunter.l3.2.Name: Double Reward vs Non-Racial Outlaws
ability.mc.bounty-hunter.l3.2.Effect: Now paid double the normal reward for non-racial Outlaws.

ability.mc.bounty-hunter.l5.Name: +1 cumulative Mastery in one weapon of choice

ability.mc.bounty-hunter.l6.Name: Enhanced Tracking skill whereby individual tracks can be
ability.mc.bounty-hunter.l6.Effect: Distinguished from others of same race - takes 'Zombie speed' inspection of area

ability.mc.chi-warrior.l1.2.Name: Chi-Warrior Item Restriction
ability.mc.chi-warrior.l1.2.Effect: May not use items (as Monk) except spirit-only items manufactured by self or another priest of the same church. Guild items for their church may still be used.

ability.mc.chi-warrior.l3.Name: B Skill as Monk (still may not use physical weapons however)

ability.mc.defender-of-nature.l6.Name: Warrior Specialist Skill (as Handbook)
ability.mc.defender-of-nature.l6.Effect: The above life scale is for Humans - other races use their own Warrior life scales

ability.mc.demon-slayer.l1.1.Name: Demon-Slayer Oath
ability.mc.demon-slayer.l1.1.Effect: Now gains only half points for the adventure if a Demonkind which could be harmed by the Demon-Slayer is left alive on adventure (this restriction doesn't apply if the Demonkind fled out of reach).

ability.mc.demon-slayer.l1.2.Name: Anti-Demon Damage Bonus
ability.mc.demon-slayer.l1.2.Effect: Gains +1 base damage increase with any weapons used when combating an enemy known to be Demonkind, due to greater inspiration.

ability.mc.demon-slayer.l1.3.Name: Discern Demonkind
ability.mc.demon-slayer.l1.3.Effect: Discern Demonkind at will, as tables.

ability.mc.demon-slayer.l2.Name: Slayer's Blow
ability.mc.demon-slayer.l2.Effect: May strike a single blow (or empower a single damaging spell/ miracle) such that it will harm any Demonkind which was capable of harming the Demon-Slayer, unless the Demonkind can only be harmed by a specific/unique weapon or technique - for example, the blow would inflict ranged, light-based damage, but would not inflict 'Laserbolt', nor count as 'The Runed Great Axe of King Sharmyn'

ability.mc.demon-slayer.l3.Name: Righteous Fury
ability.mc.demon-slayer.l3.Effect: May enter a 33% rage against Demonkind only, in which may continue to use any offensive abilities possessed against the Demonkind

ability.mc.demon-slayer.l4.Name: Banishment
ability.mc.demon-slayer.l4.Effect: Banishes one Demonkind to its original plane of existence, which it then cannot leave for 24 hours. Caster takes 8 TBLP per resistance level of the Demonkind, but if this damage kills him he is not dead perm - (the Demonkind is also not slain, and may apply Immunity to Involuntary Mystical Transportation or Immunity to Hand of Purity to be immune to the effect entirely). If the demon is not banished then the innate is used but no life is taken

ability.mc.demon-slayer.l5.Name: Shield of Purity
ability.mc.demon-slayer.l5.Effect: All 'demonic' damage, whether it comes from demon-bound weapons, or spells or miracles cast with demonic power, is reduced by ¼, lasts 5 minutes or the length of combat with a specific Demonkind (whichever is longer)

ability.mc.demon-slayer.l6.Name: Summon Weapon of Retribution
ability.mc.demon-slayer.l6.Effect: Summons a weapon of choice into the caster's hands which will inflict 'holy' (good spirit/white mana) damage versus one chosen Demonkind only; this weapon may be either pure or physical, as decided when summoned. It cannot harm creatures other than the chosen Demonkind, but against them has +1 maximum damage, and may only be wielded by the summoner

ability.mc.devout-believer.l1.Name: If not claiming a different guild then the Devout Believer may benefit
ability.mc.devout-believer.l1.Effect: From church guild items if any are present

ability.mc.devout-believer.l3.Name: Discern Own Priest Guild-member at will
ability.mc.devout-believer.l3.Effect: This is a spiritual discern, 20' range, and 'Own Guild' refers to the priest guild in which Lay Believer has been bought previously

ability.mc.devout-believer.l4.Name: Are now full members of the Church, including being able to claim guild
ability.mc.devout-believer.l4.Effect: Benefits (Providing the character could normally claim guild benefits)

ability.mc.devout-believer.l6.Name: Utilise Spirit Item of own alignment (Good/Neutral/Evil) ability
ability.mc.devout-believer.l6.Effect: Otherwise as per Spirit Warrior of same alignment

ability.mc.devout-druid.l2.Name: +4 (8 total) Earthpower, or 10 (total) EP worth of innates
