ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l1.Effect: Gesture but for 0 spirits, in this case costing 3 tblp, must first have the miracle on their list

ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l2.Name: Rune of Power may now be used to cause any 'other-affecting' miracle of
ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l2.Effect: 4th level or below on the priest's list, instead of its normal effect - e.g. a goodly Priest could cause the Rune to trigger a Bless, or an Evil one a Cause Disease. All non-damaging offensive effects are still level-based as normal for Rune of Power. Runes cast in this way last at most 24 hours. If used in this way the en-runed miracle ceases to be a standard miracle

ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l3.Name: Throwing the Runes
ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l3.Effect: May throw the runes. This requires an excellent phys rep of rune- inscribed stones. The priest may specify a question for which they seek guidance, or simply ask their allied spirits for advice. The runes will reveal a message in reply in a similar manner to a single Communication II question. The spirits will never lie, but the ref may choose to be cryptic or not, as desired - it is possible at the ref's discretion to foretell the future with these replies

ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l4.Name: Enruned Weapon
ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l4.Effect: May now inscribe a Rune of Power upon the shaft of a physical weapon. The next blow struck with that weapon will trigger the appropriate effect upon the target. The user of the weapon need not be able to use spiritual items, but if they are of the opposite alignment to the power bound into the weapon they also suffer the effect if disbeneficial. This ability cannot be used with Enhance Rune of Power, nor with Greater Rune of Power below. Enruned Weapons must be wielded as a weapon and be an actual weapon phys-rep, so are not usable by pure priests

ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l5.Name: Rune of Warding
ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l5.Effect: May now inscribe a Rune of Warding upon any piece of armour, or shield, or a weapon. On shields and weapons the inscription imbues the object with a warding spirit which allows the user to block purely spiritual blows (but not inflict spiritual damage themselves). On a piece of armour the rune will mean that the armour applies against purely spiritual weapon blows - additionally if the wearer can use neutral spiritual items additionally SAC up to ½ the PAC value (round down) of the armour. A separate rune is required for each armour location covered. Each such Rune of Warding costs the inscriber 1 spirit and associated casting damage and lasts 24 hours

ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l6.Name: Runes of Transgression
ability.mc.priest-of-the-runes.l6.Effect: May now inscribe Runes of Transgression in the air itself - in this case they last only 15 minutes. These runes are visible, glowing even in the darkness. May now inscribe Greater Runes of Power - these cost 8 spirits and may bind any 'other-affecting' miracle on the priest's list of 6th level or below. They are non-level based

Faster speech remains unintelligible.

ability.mc.focal-mage.l2.Effect: If the Primary Magical Focus is lost and not recovered by the end of the adventure a new Primary Magical Focus is gained before the next adventure

ability.mc.focal-mage.l3.Name: Magical Focus
ability.mc.focal-mage.l3.Effect: The Primary Magical Focus now grants an additional casting level which is cumulative with those normally granted when held in one or both hands when casting a spell. The magical focus and the casting levels granted by this class may now be used during the research of new spells

ability.mc.focal-mage.l4.Name: Magical Focus
ability.mc.focal-mage.l4.Effect: If the Primary Magical Focus is a safe combat weapon style phys rep (e.g. a Staff which would pass a weapon check) then it may be used to block weapon blows without disbenefit, even if the character could not normally use weapons - this does mean that a High Wizard can parry with the focus. If the Primary Magical Focus is not a safe phys rep for such, then a Secondary Magical Focus is acquired. This can either be a staff or rod as described above and used to block blows OR if used at the same time as the Primary Focus during the casting of spells grants no damage casting spells which cost mana points and would normally cost only 1 TBLP in casting damage. This choice must be made when the level is bought and written on the character card as level 4-Block if the parrying option is taken, or 4-Damage if the immunity to casting damage option is taken

ability.mc.focal-mage.l6.Name: Magical Focus
ability.mc.focal-mage.l6.Effect: The Primary Magical Focus now grants another additional casting level which is cumulative with those normally granted when held in one or both hands when casting a spell. This may be used during the research of new spells. This brings the number of casting levels granted by the Magical Focus up to +4 total

ability.mc.juggernaut.l4.Name: Determination

ability.mc.juggernaut.l5.Name: Determination

ability.merged.apprentice-bonding.Name: Apprentice Bonding
ability.merged.apprentice-bonding.Effect: Two wizards buy this simultaneously and name each other. The apprentice gains +3 mana of the master's colour; the master gains +1 casting level in that colour only. Both wizards must share the same primary colour.

ability.merged.elemental-squire.Name: Elemental Squire
ability.merged.elemental-squire.Effect: Gains +2 mana for own-colour offensive glyphs and +3/1 life. May not hold a second colour.

ability.merged.elemental-apprentice.Name: Elemental Apprentice
ability.merged.elemental-apprentice.Effect: Gains +3 mana for own-colour glyphs and +1 casting level for own-colour glyphs. May not hold a second colour.

ability.merged.elemental-knight.Name: Elemental Knight
ability.merged.elemental-knight.Effect: From Elemental Squire: +4 mana for own-colour offensive glyphs, +6/2 life, and +1 MAC against spells of own colour only. May not acquire additional specialist glyph slots beyond those owned at 1st level.

ability.merged.elemental-adept.Name: Elemental Adept
ability.merged.elemental-adept.Effect: From Elemental Apprentice: +6 mana for own-colour glyphs, +2 casting levels for own-colour glyphs, and +3% researching own-colour glyphs. May not acquire additional specialist glyph slots beyond those owned at 1st level.

ability.merged.elemental-warlord.Name: Elemental Warlord
ability.merged.elemental-warlord.Effect: From Elemental Knight: +8 mana for own-colour offensive glyphs, +9/3 life, and the first directly offensive own-colour spell costing 3 mana or below each 15 minutes costs no mana. May not use any glyph, even by item, of another colour.

ability.merged.elemental-master.Name: Elemental Master
ability.merged.elemental-master.Effect: From Elemental Adept: +12 mana and +3 casting levels for own-colour glyphs. May have no specialist glyphs and takes half damage from casting own-colour glyphs (minimum 1 unless no-damage abilities apply).

ability.merged.elemental-lord.Name: Elemental Lord
ability.merged.elemental-lord.Effect: From Elemental Master: gains +24 own-colour mana and +4 own-colour casting levels. May Ward Pact mana users and creatures of own colour; this is non-level-based. Grants immunity to beneficial mana not of own colour.

ability.merged.additional-level-of-mana-.Name: Additional Level of Mana and Casting
ability.merged.additional-level-of-mana-.Effect: Grants an additional level for mana and casting that is not cumulative with other base-level increases such as 9th level mana and casting.

ability.merged.more-spirits.Name: More Spirits
ability.merged.more-spirits.Effect: Base spirits per level increase to 4 from 3.

ability.merged.even-more-spirits.Name: Even More Spirits
ability.merged.even-more-spirits.Effect: From More Spirits: base spirits now 5 per level from 4.

ability.merged.witch-spirits.Name: Witch – Spirits
ability.merged.witch-spirits.Effect: The Witch gains a base of 4 spirits per level but may no longer use the Cudgel and becomes a non-weapon-using priest.

ability.merged.second-extra-level-of-spi.Name: Second Extra Level of Spirits
ability.merged.second-extra-level-of-spi.Effect: As the first extra level of spirits, requiring First Extra Level of Spirits first; grants a minimum of 8 spirits total.

ability.merged.third-extra-level-of-spir.Name: Third Extra Level of Spirits
ability.merged.third-extra-level-of-spir.Effect: As the second extra level of spirits, requiring Second Extra Level of Spirits first; grants a minimum of 12 spirits total.

ability.merged.fourth-extra-level-of-spi.Name: Fourth Extra Level of Spirits
ability.merged.fourth-extra-level-of-spi.Effect: Only acquirable by priests with Devotion, in which case the spirits may only be used with the devoted sphere, or by priests who have reached Level 6 Devout Priest, in which case they are freely usable.

ability.merged.fifth-extra-level-of-spir.Name: Fifth Extra Level of Spirits
ability.merged.fifth-extra-level-of-spir.Effect: Only acquirable by non-weapon-using priests with Devotion, in which case the spirits are only for the devoted sphere, or by priests who have reached Level 6 Devout Priest, where they are freely usable.

ability.merged.sixth-extra-level-of-spir.Name: Sixth Extra Level of Spirits
ability.merged.sixth-extra-level-of-spir.Effect: Only acquirable by non-weapon-using priests with Devotion, in which case the spirits are only for the devoted sphere, or by priests who have reached Level 6 Devout Priest, where they are freely usable.

ability.merged.dedicated-power.Name: Dedicated Power
ability.merged.dedicated-power.Effect: Base spirits per level increase by one, from 5 to 6 or 4 to 5. If the character is ever excommunicated they die permanently.

ability.merged.allied-angel.Name: Allied Angel
ability.merged.allied-angel.Effect: A constant angelic ally within the priest grants 10 additional spirits usable only on goodly miracles. The priest discerns as Angelkind; if struck by an effect that would banish or destroy Angelkind, they fall unconscious for 5 minutes and lose the additional spirits for the rest of the day.

ability.merged.abishai-minion.Name: Abishai Minion
ability.merged.abishai-minion.Effect: A bound abishai grants 10 additional spirits usable only on evil miracles. The priest discerns as Daemonkind; if struck by an effect that would banish or destroy Daemonkind, they fall unconscious for 5 minutes and lose the additional spirits for the rest of the day.

ability.merged.bound-spirit.Name: Bound Spirit
ability.merged.bound-spirit.Effect: Powerful bound spirits grant the priest 10 additional spirits usable only on neutral miracles, with no associated banishment penalty.

ability.merged.power-of-faith.Name: Power of Faith
ability.merged.power-of-faith.Effect: Gains +1 spirit per level. Stacks with Dedicated Power and Weapons Priest. The character may not leave the priest bracket.

ability.merged.specialists-i.Name: Specialists I
ability.merged.specialists-i.Effect: Gains +5 total non-grey, non-opposite specialist glyph slots.

ability.merged.specialists-ii.Name: Specialists II
ability.merged.specialists-ii.Effect: From Specialists I: gains +10 total non-opposite specialist slots.

ability.merged.specialists-iii.Name: Specialists III
ability.merged.specialists-iii.Effect: From Specialists II: gains +15 total non-opposite spells into capacity.

ability.merged.specialists-iv.Name: Specialists IV
ability.merged.specialists-iv.Effect: From Specialists III: gains +20 total non-opposite spells into capacity.

ability.merged.warlock-specialist-i.Name: Warlock Specialist I
ability.merged.warlock-specialist-i.Effect: Gains +2 total non-grey, non-opposite combat spells into capacity.

ability.merged.rainbow-specialist-slots.Name: Rainbow
ability.merged.rainbow-specialist-slots.Effect: Now gains 4 specialist slots per Elemental colour instead of 3.

ability.merged.a-new-rainbow-specialist-.Name: A New Rainbow
ability.merged.a-new-rainbow-specialist-.Effect: Now gains 1 specialist slot per New colour.

ability.merged.greater-rainbow-specialis.Name: Greater Rainbow
ability.merged.greater-rainbow-specialis.Effect: From Rainbow: now gains 5 specialist slots per Elemental colour instead of 4. May not learn Specialists II (+10 specialist slots).

ability.merged.elementalist-specialist-s.Name: Elementalist
ability.merged.elementalist-specialist-s.Effect: Gains one specialist slot in each Elemental colour to be filled by an Advanced Grimoire spell of the appropriate colour.

ability.merged.over-the-rainbow-speciali.Name: Over the Rainbow
ability.merged.over-the-rainbow-speciali.Effect: Gains one specialist slot in each New Colour to be filled by an Advanced Grimoire spell of the appropriate colour.

ability.merged.spiritual-scribe-scriptur.Name: Spiritual Scribe
ability.merged.spiritual-scribe-scriptur.Effect: 1st- to 3rd-level Scriptures of the Faith no longer count towards the scripture cap.

ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l3.1.Name: B-Class Base Damage +3
ability.mc.battlemaster-b.l3.1.Effect: Base damage with weapon is increased by 3 points, to 12 points if a bastard weapon, otherwise to 15 points. Normal max damage is exceeded by this increase and it works in combination with other published temporary increases.

ability.mc.war-dancer.l5.2.Name: Speed of Thought
ability.mc.war-dancer.l5.2.Effect: During another's Leap, may take 2 paces in addition to or instead of striking a blow; this can include turning round, etc.

ability.mc.telekinetic.l5.1.Name: Telekinesis Cost Reduction
ability.mc.telekinetic.l5.1.Effect: TBLP cost for Telekinesis is now 6 TBLP, from 9.

ability.mc.spiritual-celebrant.l6.1.Name: Hospitaller Bless Access
ability.mc.spiritual-celebrant.l6.1.Effect: Counts as a Hospitaller when casting Blesses, so may cast Permanent Blesses as detailed in Words from Above.

ability.mc.spiritual-celebrant.l6.2.Name: Benediction Sphere Cost Reduction Extension
ability.mc.spiritual-celebrant.l6.2.Effect: Level 3 spirit reduction now equally applies to any Benediction Sphere miracle, to a minimum of 1 spirit, non-cumulative with any other reduction in spirit cost.

ability.mc.spiritual-diviner.l6.1.Name: Communication Duration 60 Minutes

ability.mc.spiritual-diviner.l6.2.Name: Communication Sphere Cost Reduction Extension
ability.mc.spiritual-diviner.l6.2.Effect: Level 3 spirit reduction now equally applies to any Communication Tree or Sphere miracle, to a minimum of 1 spirit, non-cumulative with any other reduction in spirit cost.

ability.mc.spiritual-warden.l6.1.Name: Persistent First Spirit Shield
ability.mc.spiritual-warden.l6.1.Effect: 1st Spirit Shield of the day cast on self lasts until triggered, whereupon the duration starts as normal.

ability.mc.spiritual-warden.l6.2.Name: Warding Sphere Cost Reduction Extension
ability.mc.spiritual-warden.l6.2.Effect: Level 3 spirit reduction now equally applies to any Warding Tree or Sphere miracle, to a minimum of 1 spirit, non-cumulative with any other reduction in spirit cost.

ability.mc.spiritual-maelstrom.l6.1.Name: Expertise Spirit Bolt Chain Casting
ability.mc.spiritual-maelstrom.l6.1.Effect: Expertise Spirit Bolt at level 2 may now be continued as long as desired (and the caster has the power remaining). Casting is broken by a gap of more than 5 seconds or if the caster suffers any external damage.

ability.mc.spiritual-maelstrom.l6.2.Name: Force Sphere Cost Reduction Extension
ability.mc.spiritual-maelstrom.l6.2.Effect: Level 3 spirit reduction now equally applies to any Force Tree or Sphere miracle, to a minimum of 1 spirit, non-cumulative with any other reduction in spirit cost.

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l1.Name: Tree-like Makeup

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l1.2.Name: Treeborn Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l1.2.Effect: Immune to Flesh and Blood effects including potions and poisons, except Earthpower Flesh and Blood effects still apply where appropriate.

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l1.3.Name: No Red Mana Benefit
ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l1.3.Effect: May never use or benefit from red mana.

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l2.Name: Permanent Barkskin +1 PAC
ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l2.Effect: Permanent Barkskin grants +1 PAC (stacking with other Barkskins).

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l2.2.Name: Fertile Soil Healing
ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l2.2.Effect: After 5 minutes in continuous contact with fertile soil, heal 1 TBLP and 1 to worst location.

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l3.Name: Double Fire Damage
ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l3.Effect: Now takes double damage from fire after all other calculations; if immune to fire still takes half from normal fires.

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l3.2.Name: Meld with Trees

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l4.Name: Permanent Barkskin +2 PAC

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l4.2.Name: Double Axe Damage
ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l4.2.Effect: Now takes double damage from axe-blows after all other calculations.

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l4.3.Name: Healing Sap
ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l4.3.Effect: Draw sap by self-cutting 3 TBLP +1 loc: flesh-and-blood drinker heals 6 TBLP/2 loc; Child of Pines or Wood Elf balm heals 6 TBLP/3 to one location.

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l5.Name: Forest-Shift
ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l5.Effect: Forest-Shift as druidic evocation with no verbal required.

ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l6.Name: Woody Consistency
ability.mr.child-of-the-pines.l6.Effect: Now takes one-third less damage from blunt weapon blows due to woody consistency.

ability.mr.fire-daimon.l1.2.Name: Ignite by Touch
ability.mr.fire-daimon.l1.2.Effect: May Ignite by touch at will as per red cantrip.

ability.mr.fire-daimon.l1.3.Name: Fire Nature
ability.mr.fire-daimon.l1.3.Effect: Now gains half effect from supernatural fire and immunity to natural fire. Counts fully as Daemonkind.

ability.mr.fire-daimon.l2.Name: Mantic Shock

ability.mr.fire-daimon.l4.Effect: Invoke evil fires around the body so non-supernatural weapons striking are burnt/melted; lasts 5 minutes.

ability.mr.fire-daimon.l5.Name: Mantic Fire Bolt
ability.mr.fire-daimon.l5.Effect: Inflicts both magical and evil spirit damage.

ability.mr.fire-daimon.l6.Name: Mantic Disruption
ability.mr.fire-daimon.l6.Effect: Inflicts both magical and evil spirit damage.

ability.mr.frost-giant.l1.Name: Frost Giant Form
ability.mr.frost-giant.l1.Effect: Must incorporate white/frost motifs in makeup and roleplay as a large Northman.

ability.mr.frost-giant.l1.2.Name: Life Level Offset
ability.mr.frost-giant.l1.2.Effect: Base life is calculated as if one level higher for all purposes.

ability.mr.frost-giant.l2.Name: Darkness Sight
ability.mr.frost-giant.l2.Effect: Can see through all forms of supernatural darkness at all times.

ability.mr.frost-giant.l2.2.Name: Double Resistance Levels
ability.mr.frost-giant.l2.2.Effect: Resistance level to level-based magical spells is doubled.

ability.mr.frost-giant.l3.Name: Forged Armour Requirement
ability.mr.frost-giant.l3.Effect: May only wear armour forged by a character with the appropriate skill; costs double normal amount.

ability.mr.frost-giant.l3.2.Name: Locational Life from Permanent TBLP
ability.mr.frost-giant.l3.2.Effect: Locational life is half permanent TBLP allowance; if a location is severed, the Frost Giant dies.

ability.mr.frost-giant.l4.Name: Half Pure Magic Damage
ability.mr.frost-giant.l4.Effect: Suffers only half damage from purely magical damaging blows or effects.

ability.mr.frost-giant.l5.Name: Immunity to Cold Upgrade
ability.mr.frost-giant.l5.Effect: Gains Immunity to Cold as per post-8th tables; if already owned then gains complete Immunity to Cold.

ability.mr.frost-giant.l6.Name: Half Effect Magic
ability.mr.frost-giant.l6.Effect: Now takes half-effect magic in all ways, as per a Dwarf.

ability.mr.full-drowe.l1.Name: Full Drowe Makeup
ability.mr.full-drowe.l1.Effect: Now suffers full makeup requirements appropriate to Drowe.

ability.mr.full-drowe.l2.Name: Drowe Innates and Immunities
ability.mr.full-drowe.l2.Effect: Gains innates and immunities specific to Drowe equal to multi-race level.

ability.mr.full-drowe.l6.Name: Become Full Drowe
ability.mr.full-drowe.l6.Effect: Loses spirit and spiritual abilities; treated as a Drowe for abilities/restrictions while retaining human base life as before. Is now injured by Dispels.

ability.mr.full-elf.l1.Name: Full Elf Makeup
ability.mr.full-elf.l1.Effect: Now suffers full makeup requirements appropriate to the type of Elf.

ability.mr.full-elf.l2.Name: Elf Innates and Immunities
ability.mr.full-elf.l2.Effect: Gains innates and immunities specific to elf type equal to multi-race level.

ability.mr.full-elf.l6.Name: Become Full Elf
ability.mr.full-elf.l6.Effect: Loses spirit and spiritual abilities; now treated as Elf for abilities/restrictions while retaining human base TBLP/loc. Is now injured by Dispels.

ability.mr.golem.l1.Name: Select Construct Type
ability.mr.golem.l1.Effect: Choose one construct type (Iron, Stone, Ice, Bronze).

ability.mr.golem.l1.2.Name: Construct Form
ability.mr.golem.l1.2.Effect: Immune to all Flesh and Blood effects (including potions, poisons, and pain). Must wear construct-appropriate makeup.

ability.mr.golem.l1.3.Name: Golem Restrictions
ability.mr.golem.l1.3.Effect: May not exceed DAC 6 and may not use Sniff or Locational Sniff.

ability.mr.golem.l2.Name: Iron Minor Power
ability.mr.golem.l2.Effect: May bond a metal weapon so it cannot be removed and is immune to destruction; 30s concentration to bind/unbind.

ability.mr.golem.l2.2.Name: Stone Minor Power
ability.mr.golem.l2.2.Effect: Statue x1/day: become invulnerable and inactive for up to 15 minutes.

ability.mr.golem.l2.3.Name: Ice Minor Power
ability.mr.golem.l2.3.Effect: Refract Light x1/2 levels: negate one light-based attack.

ability.mr.golem.l2.5.Name: +1 PAC
ability.mr.golem.l2.5.Effect: +1 PAC innate due to dense form.

ability.mr.golem.l2.6.Name: Slow Heavy Movement
ability.mr.golem.l2.6.Effect: May not travel above 3/4 speed; roleplay as lumbering/heavy.

ability.mr.golem.l3.2.Name: Stone Medium Power
ability.mr.golem.l3.2.Effect: Now takes one-quarter less effect from sharp weapons (not purely supernatural weapons).

ability.mr.golem.l3.3.Name: Ice Medium Power
ability.mr.golem.l3.3.Effect: Complete Immunity to Cold as Winter Elf.

ability.mr.golem.l3.4.Name: Bronze Medium Power
ability.mr.golem.l3.4.Effect: Now takes one-quarter less effect from all solely physical damage.

ability.mr.golem.l5.Name: Iron Major Power
ability.mr.golem.l5.Effect: 66% Berserk Rage x1/3 levels when in presence of externally cast magic; caster is primary target.

ability.mr.golem.l5.2.Name: Stone Major Power
ability.mr.golem.l5.2.Effect: May inflict Knockback by weapon blow at will; costs 6 TBLP per blow if +2 Strength or greater, otherwise 9 TBLP.

ability.mr.golem.l5.3.Name: Ice Major Power
ability.mr.golem.l5.3.Effect: May inflict Snowball-equivalent touch damage (12/12 magical cold) at will for 6 TBLP per touch.

ability.mr.golem.l5.4.Name: Bronze Major Power
ability.mr.golem.l5.4.Effect: Immunity to Bruising and may round damage fractions down rather than up.

ability.mr.golem.l6.2.Name: Extreme Mass
ability.mr.golem.l6.2.Effect: Now requires 5 grades of strength to move physically when dead, unconscious, or helpless.

ability.mr.golem.l6.3.Name: No Physical Jump
ability.mr.golem.l6.3.Effect: May not use physical Jump abilities.

ability.mr.great-ogre.l1.Name: Food-Bound Loyalty
ability.mr.great-ogre.l1.Effect: Perceives those who provide food as friends unless they attack the Ogre or tribe members.

ability.mr.great-ogre.l1.2.Name: +6/2 Life
ability.mr.great-ogre.l1.2.Effect: +6 TBLP and +2 loc life (stacking with published life abilities unless otherwise specified).

ability.mr.great-ogre.l3.Name: Immunity to Domination
ability.mr.great-ogre.l3.Effect: Gains immunity to all domination effects.

ability.mr.high-elf.l1.Name: Half-Spirit Ascension
ability.mr.high-elf.l1.Effect: Now has a half-spirit as Half-Elf, is no longer injured by Dispels, and remains immune to Flesh and Blood effects as applicable to elves.

ability.mr.high-elf.l1.2.Name: Half-Elf Immunity Upgrade
ability.mr.high-elf.l1.2.Effect: Half Elves taking this option become immune to Flesh and Blood effects to elf extent.

ability.mr.high-elf.l3.Name: Rebirth at 8th
ability.mr.high-elf.l3.Effect: Gains Rebirth at 8th level (must already have bought Rebirth).

ability.mr.high-elf.l5.Name: Rebirth with One-Third Points
ability.mr.high-elf.l5.Effect: May Rebirth at 8th keeping one-third original points; must purchase High Elf first when rebirthing.

ability.mr.high-elf.l6.Name: Human Life for Full Elves
ability.mr.high-elf.l6.Effect: Characters who were full elves now have human life of same base class.

ability.mr.high-elf.l6.2.Name: Half-Elf Buy-as Upgrade
ability.mr.high-elf.l6.2.Effect: Those who were Half Elves may now buy as full elf of their type.

ability.mr.high-elf.l6.3.Name: Mantic Elven Innates
ability.mr.high-elf.l6.3.Effect: All elven handbook innates become mantic (e.g. affirms grant SAC additionally).

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l1.Name: Half-Orc Life Scale
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l1.Effect: Base life from this race equals that of a Half-Orc of equal multi-race level; if resulting base class life exceeds 48 this does increase base life for capping calculations.

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l2.Name: Human Armour Permissions
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l2.Effect: May wear any armour permitted for a Human of same class (no change for Shaman/Witch Doctor).

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l3.Name: +1 PAC and Weapon Access
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l3.Effect: +1 PAC, gains B skill, loses Goblin weapon restrictions; if E-skill acquired it may be used with any usable weapon.

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l4.Name: Backstab Conversion
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l4.Effect: Loses Goblin racial Backstab skill and now inflicts +6 base damage on blows where Backstab would normally be usable.

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l5.2.Name: Insensitive Skin
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l5.2.Effect: Now has Insensitive Skin as tables ability.

ability.mr.hobgoblin.l6.Name: Taunt
ability.mr.hobgoblin.l6.Effect: After 30s verbal taunt and while continuing to taunt, takes only 1 point per grade from target blows (Rockskin style) up to 5 minutes.

ability.mr.immortal.l1.Name: Scaling Physical Reduction
ability.mr.immortal.l1.Effect: Suffers one-sixth less damage from physical attacks per level of this race (at 6th is immune to physical damage).

ability.mr.immortal.l1.2.Name: Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.immortal.l1.2.Effect: Immunity to Flesh and Blood effects (including potions, poisons, and pain).

ability.mr.immortal.l2.Name: Immortal Defence
ability.mr.immortal.l2.Effect: Gains one-quarter off all damage with a physical component for five minutes.

ability.mr.immortal.l3.2.Name: Half Beneficial Physical Effect
ability.mr.immortal.l3.2.Effect: Now only receives half effect from beneficial physical effects.

ability.mr.immortal.l4.Name: Empowered Defence
ability.mr.immortal.l4.Effect: Upgrades an Immortal Defence so it grants one-third off damage.

ability.mr.immortal.l5.Name: Form of the Immortal
ability.mr.immortal.l5.Effect: Grants complete immunity to physical effects for 5 minutes.

ability.mr.immortal.l6.Name: Immortal Armour
ability.mr.immortal.l6.Effect: Upgrades an Empowered Defence to a Rockskin-style reduction vs all damage with a physical component.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.Name: Scaling Non-Physical/Non-Neuronic Reduction
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.Effect: Gains one-sixth off all damage except Physical and Neuronic per level.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.2.Name: Neuronic Bracket Lock
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.2.Effect: May never leave or buy-as outside the neuronic bracket.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.3.Name: No Mind-Bar/Neuronic Immunity
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.3.Effect: May never Mind-Bar or become immune to neuronics.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.4.Name: Neural Foci Requirement (2 per level)
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l1.4.Effect: Must have at least 2 permanent neural foci per level of this race.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l2.Name: Reality Controlled
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l2.Effect: Gain complete immunity to Magic or Spirit for 5 minutes.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.Name: Kill/Sever Restriction
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.Effect: Can only be killed or have a location severed by Physical or Neuronic means.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.2.Name: Neural Foci Requirement (3 per level)
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.2.Effect: Now requires at least 3 permanent neural foci per level of this race.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.3.Name: Beneficial Effect Immunity
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l3.3.Effect: Gains immunity to beneficial effects that are not Neuronic or Physical in nature.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l4.Name: Disperse Mind
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l4.Effect: Acts as gaseous form except the user is only harmed by neuronics rather than miracles.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l5.Name: Forced Reality
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l5.Effect: First time needed each day gains a stacking Live to Minus 6 that is neuronic-only.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l6.Name: Alter Reality
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l6.Effect: Counts as Purity of Mind vs one just-suffered effect (declare within 2 seconds); costs a level to use.

ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l6.2.Name: Neural Foci Requirement (4 per level)
ability.mr.mind-over-reality.l6.2.Effect: Must now have 4 permanent neural foci per level of this race.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.Name: Greater Cunning
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.Effect: General intelligence rises to roughly Half-Orc warrior level.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.2.Name: Recognise Mana and Verbal Adaptation
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.2.Effect: Gains Recognise Mana at will and may adapt spell verbals like a shaman/witch-doctor as appropriate.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.3.Name: Blue Woad Markings
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l1.3.Effect: Must incorporate blue woad-like markings in makeup.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l2.Name: Puff of Air
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l2.Effect: Puff of Air at will for 1 TBLP per use.

ability.mr.ogre-magi.l6.2.Name: Immunity to Electrical Attacks
ability.mr.ogre-magi.l6.2.Effect: Now completely immune to all electrical attacks.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l1.Name: Select Primal Tree
ability.mr.primal-soul.l1.Effect: Choose Primal Bound, Predator, or Prey as the character’s primal tree.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l1.2.Name: Primal Markings
ability.mr.primal-soul.l1.2.Effect: For any choice other than Primal Bound, makeup/costume must be reminiscent of the chosen creature type.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.Name: Primal Bound Minor Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.Effect: Choose one Minor talent from Primal Bound.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.2.Name: Predator Minor Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.2.Effect: Choose one Minor talent from Predator.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.3.Name: Prey Minor Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l2.3.Effect: Choose one Minor talent from Prey.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.Name: Primal Bound Medium Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.Effect: Choose one Medium talent from Primal Bound.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.2.Name: Predator Medium Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.2.Effect: Choose one Medium talent from Predator.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.3.Name: Prey Medium Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l4.3.Effect: Choose one Medium talent from Prey.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l5.Name: Discern Own Kind
ability.mr.primal-soul.l5.Effect: At will by sight, physically discern creatures of the exact chosen race (yes/no with ref-discretion detail).

ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.Name: Primal Bound Major Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.Effect: Choose one Major talent from Primal Bound.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.2.Name: Predator Major Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.2.Effect: Choose one Major talent from Predator.

ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.3.Name: Prey Major Talent
ability.mr.primal-soul.l6.3.Effect: Choose one Major talent from Prey.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l1.Name: Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.rock-troll.l1.Effect: Now immune to Flesh and Blood effects including ingestion (no potion effects).

ability.mr.rock-troll.l1.2.Name: Rocky Makeup
ability.mr.rock-troll.l1.2.Effect: Must incorporate stone and rocky complexion into makeup.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l2.2.Name: Live to Minus Scaling
ability.mr.rock-troll.l2.2.Effect: Gains additional Live to Minus 3 per level of this multi-race, stacking with all other published live-to-minus.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l2.3.Name: Regeneration Base Boost
ability.mr.rock-troll.l2.3.Effect: Regeneration now heals base 1 TBLP and 1 to every injured location per 5 minutes.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l4.2.Name: Regeneration Rate Increase
ability.mr.rock-troll.l4.2.Effect: Regeneration now heals base 2 TBLP and 2 to each injured location per 5 minutes (a +1x rate increase).

ability.mr.rock-troll.l5.2.Name: Rockskin vs Stone Weapons
ability.mr.rock-troll.l5.2.Effect: Stone weapons inflict damage as if user were under Rockskin at all times; innate PAC may always apply to physical-component weapon blows.

ability.mr.rock-troll.l6.2.Name: Regeneration Class Enhancements
ability.mr.rock-troll.l6.2.Effect: Warriors may heal permanent damage by natural regen except fire/spirit; shamans may heal spirit damage by regen; witches may heal fire damage by regen.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.Name: Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.Effect: Now immune to all Flesh and Blood effects (including potions and pain).

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.2.Name: Neutral Supernatural Creature
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.2.Effect: Counts as a Supernatural Neutral Creature From Another Plane.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.3.Name: Runic Markings
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l1.3.Effect: Requires silvery/grey swirls and/or runic markings over exposed skin.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l2.Name: Touch Psi-Scan
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l2.Effect: Touch reads surface thoughts as spiritual Psi-Scan at will for 1 TBLP.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l2.2.Name: Detect Spirits Nature
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l2.2.Effect: Detect Spirits Nature at will using full verbals as normal.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l3.Name: Detect Lie
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l3.Effect: Detect Lie at will for 3 TBLP using full handbook verbals.

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l4.Name: Insight of the Spirits
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l4.Effect: After 30s concentration, gain ability to cast one published neutral miracle for the rest of dungeon (must be normally learnable).

ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l6.Name: Permanent Active Spirit Sight
ability.mr.servant-of-the-spirits.l6.Effect: Gains permanent fully active Spirit Sight, revealing spirit size and alignment.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.Name: Dark Makeup Requirement
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.Effect: Must wear dark/black makeup covering at least half exposed skin.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.2.Name: Extinguish (10ft)
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.2.Effect: May Extinguish lights within 10ft at will with full cantrip verbal.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.3.Name: Permanent Mantic Ally Darkness
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l1.3.Effect: Permanent mantic Ally Darkness (without granting ability to see through darkness). Counts as Daemonkind.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l2.Name: Shadowmeld
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l2.Effect: Shadowmeld as per Chameleon(s) when not within 5ft of light source and not in direct daylight/supernatural light.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l2.2.Name: Supernatural Darkness Sight Prerequisite
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l2.2.Effect: Must purchase “See Through Supernatural Darkness at all times” before this level.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l4.Name: Mantic Shadowblade
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l4.Effect: Mantic Shadowblade x1/3 levels; mantic damage as specified by wielder eligibility.

ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l5.Name: Cloak of Darkness
ability.mr.shadow-daimon.l5.Effect: As Invisibility but cannot be used under Shadowmeld-light restrictions; ends within 5ft of any light source.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.Name: Mobile Ally Darkness
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.Effect: Always counts as benefiting from black Ally Darkness; Darkness(r) targeted on user moves with them.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.2.Name: Supernatural Darkness Sight
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.2.Effect: May now see through all forms of supernatural darkness.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.3.Name: Shadow Woad Makeup
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l1.3.Effect: Must incorporate black shadow/woad into makeup.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l3.Name: Unassisted Climb
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l3.Effect: Assisted climbs require only two points of contact, can continue while climbing and at full climbing speed.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l3.2.Name: +1 Stacking Backstab
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l3.2.Effect: +1 stacking Backstab skill (stacks only with published Backstab).

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l5.Name: Bladelick
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l5.Effect: After licking a physical edged weapon, next blow within 5 minutes inflicts physical Disease as Cause Disease.

ability.mr.snaga-hai.l6.Name: Sense Motion
ability.mr.snaga-hai.l6.Effect: Now has Sense Motion except in direct daylight or magical light; requires Perception and Supernatural Perception to use.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.Name: Scaling Non-Spirit Reduction
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.Effect: One-sixth off all damage except Spirit per level.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.2.Name: Flesh and Blood Immunity
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.2.Effect: Immunity to Flesh and Blood effects (including potions and poison).

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.3.Name: Priest Bracket Lock
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l1.3.Effect: May never leave the priest bracket.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.Name: Kill/Sever Restriction
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.Effect: Can only be killed or have a location severed by spiritual means.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.2.Name: Beneficial Non-Spiritual Immunity
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.2.Effect: Gains immunity to beneficial effects that are not spiritual.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.3.Name: No Spiritual Invisibility Immunity
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l3.3.Effect: May no longer cast Spiritual Invisibility or otherwise become immune to Spirit.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l4.Name: Non-Damaging Non-Spiritual Immunity
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l4.Effect: Immune to non-damaging effects that are not spiritual in nature.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l5.Name: Unconscious/Location Stop Restriction
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l5.Effect: Can only be knocked unconscious or have locations stop through spiritual means.

ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l6.Name: Immune to All but Spirit
ability.mr.spiritual-vessel.l6.Effect: Now completely immune to all except spirits.

ability.mr.titan.l1.Name: Immunity to Pain
ability.mr.titan.l1.Effect: Immunity to pain in all forms.

ability.mr.titan.l2.2.Name: Form of the Titan
ability.mr.titan.l2.2.Effect: Grants +36/12 temporary life for 5 minutes; does not stack with supernatural temp life but does with physical temp life.

ability.mr.titan.l3.Name: 1/6 off Weapon Blows
ability.mr.titan.l3.Effect: One-sixth off weapon blows; stacks with Battle-Master interactions as listed.

ability.mr.titan.l4.2.Name: Titan’s Strength
ability.mr.titan.l4.2.Effect: May remain conscious in live to minus while in combat for 5 minutes (if live-to-minus is owned).

ability.mr.titan.l5.Name: Immunity to Supernatural Ageing
ability.mr.titan.l5.Effect: Gains immunity to supernatural ageing effects.

ability.mr.titan.l5.2.Name: 1/4 off Weapon Blows
ability.mr.titan.l5.2.Effect: Now one-quarter off weapon blows (from one-sixth), with Greater Blade Fury and Eye for an Opponent interactions as listed.

ability.mr.titan.l6.2.Name: Titan’s Endurance
ability.mr.titan.l6.2.Effect: Locations continue to function until severed while in combat; lasts 5 minutes.

ability.mr.undead.l1.Name: Select Undead Type
ability.mr.undead.l1.Effect: Select undead type: Ghoul, Mummy, Wight, Wraith, or Vampire.

ability.mr.undead.l1.2.Name: L1 Lesser Type Unknown
ability.mr.undead.l1.2.Effect: Discerns as level 1 Type Unknown undead (dismiss name Lesser XXX).

ability.mr.undead.l1.3.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L1)
ability.mr.undead.l1.3.Effect: Immune to Repel/Attract Life, Restore/Animate Life, and Discern Nature of Wounds.

ability.mr.undead.l2.2.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L2)
ability.mr.undead.l2.2.Effect: Immune to Ebony Pain, Words of Pain, all forms of Disease, and Adrenal Surge.

ability.mr.undead.l2.3.Name: Tree Purchase Access (Tier 1)
ability.mr.undead.l2.3.Effect: May buy 1st innate from chosen undead tree and the appropriate curing ability.

ability.mr.undead.l3.2.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L3)
ability.mr.undead.l3.2.Effect: Immune to Stunning Blow, Vicious Strike, Ageing, and Flesh and Blood effects.

ability.mr.undead.l3.3.Name: Tree Purchase Access (Tier 2)
ability.mr.undead.l3.3.Effect: May buy 2nd innate from chosen undead tree.

ability.mr.undead.l4.2.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L4)
ability.mr.undead.l4.2.Effect: Immune to Repel/Attract Edible and Empathic Healing.

ability.mr.undead.l4.3.Name: Tree Purchase Access (Tier 3)
ability.mr.undead.l4.3.Effect: May buy 3rd innate from chosen undead tree.

ability.mr.undead.l5.2.Name: Undead Immunity Package (L5)
ability.mr.undead.l5.2.Effect: Immune to Neuronics and physical Sleep.

ability.mr.undead.l5.3.Name: Tree Purchase Access (Tier 4)
ability.mr.undead.l5.3.Effect: May buy 4th innate from chosen undead tree if available.

ability.guild.18th-imperial-legion.toget.Name: Together
