ability.guild.arcanum.elemental-awarenes.Effect: Whilst using Recognise Mana at 1” range it may after 10 secs concentration reveal the colour of magic. ADVANCE TIER

ability.guild.arcanum.greater-awareness.Name: Greater Awareness
ability.guild.arcanum.greater-awareness.Effect: Elemental Awareness now reveals the broad type of magic present (Warding, Offensive, Defensive etc.). It will also reveal if another powerbase is combined with the magic but not what it is ( e.g. a mantic effect would reveal as magical and something else).

ability.guild.arcanum.greater-understand.Name: Greater Understanding of Magic
ability.guild.arcanum.greater-understand.Effect: Understanding of Magic now applies to dispels up to 10th level.

ability.guild.arcanum.learned-knowledge.Name: Learned Knowledge
ability.guild.arcanum.learned-knowledge.Effect: Gains 3 extra Specialist Slots. These may be filled with any glyph that could normally be learnt as a handbook specialist by that character, chosen at the start of the day.

ability.guild.arcanum.meta-magic.Name: Meta Magic:
ability.guild.arcanum.meta-magic.Effect:
Any member who would not normally be able to do so (e.g. if pathed or cannot cast grey) is now capable of casting the Dispel 1, 2, and 3 glyphs.
Members who can cast these glyphs may spend 30 seconds in calm, quiet observation before casting a Detect Magic, at which point it functions as per the advanced grey g lyph Improved Detect Magic instead.

ability.guild.arcanum.scholarly-interest.Name: Scholarly Interest
ability.guild.arcanum.scholarly-interest.Effect: 1/Day a member may examine a source of magic identified by Rec Mana, at 1” range. For every 30 seconds they examine the source of mana they gain a Magical Major Prayer about this source i.e. may use a Major Prayer about the source, examine it for another 30 seconds and then use another and so on. During the 30 seconds concentration conversation may be held as long as it is about the source in question.

ability.guild.arcanum.scholarly-interest.Name: Scholarly Interest
ability.guild.arcanum.scholarly-interest.Effect: Additional use of the innate as above.

ability.guild.arcanum.the-towers-trainin.Name: The Towers Training
ability.guild.arcanum.the-towers-trainin.Effect: Members gain + 1 level of casting and + 3 mana of their own colour. If they hold multiple colours they must choose which colour this applies too. Student of the Towers - Guild status Initiate of the Towers - Stage One: Cost: 50 Table: 1

ability.guild.arcanum.understanding-of-m.Name: Understanding of Magic
ability.guild.arcanum.understanding-of-m.Effect: May cast touch -range Dispels of up to 5th level for one mana less than their standard cost, to a minimum of 1 mana -point. Non -cumulative with any other cost reduction.

ability.guild.bildteve.gains-an-addition.Name: Gains an additional Destroy innate
ability.guild.bildteve.gains-an-addition.Effect: Gains an additional Destroy innate. These innates may now be used to destroy undead up to 6th level or demons up to 8th level (still costing 6 TBLP per dismiss/resistance level).

ability.guild.bildteve.gains-discern-nat.Name: Gains Discern Nature of Undead as per priest and Discern Demonkind
ability.guild.bildteve.gains-discern-nat.Effect: Gains Discern Nature of Undead as per priest and Discern Demonkind.

ability.guild.buggledexters.inspiration.Name: Inspiration
ability.guild.buggledexters.inspiration.Effect: Guild member may grant one non -evil person an additional live to minus 6, which will stack with their own live to minus (but not guild abilities). This may be the guild member themselves if desired. If it not self, requires 30 seconds of friendly or inspiring conversation with the benefi ciary.

ability.guild.buggledexters.shield-of-th.Name: Shield of the Meek
ability.guild.buggledexters.shield-of-th.Effect: No normal non -evil peon will attack the guild member, as they are supernaturally guided away from doing so by the forces of Light. Guild members are aware of these peons, and should they strike or injure one they are immediately cast ou t from the guild.

ability.guild.buggledexters.turn-away-th.Name: Turn Away the Evil
ability.guild.buggledexters.turn-away-th.Effect: 1st Innate of a mantic Repel Supernatural Evil – as per the paladinic ability to repel evil – but will only work on evil supernatural creatures such as demons and Undead

ability.guild.buggledexters.wisdom-in-th.Name: Wisdom in the Words of Light
ability.guild.buggledexters.wisdom-in-th.Effect: Until the next dawn any person that has been affected by at least 60 seconds of “Words of Harmony” gains benefits as per Inspiriation (basic tier) unless evil. If that person is a non -evil peon, then the live to minus is doubled. The user of this innate also gains death link to all those affected – revealing the location, time and nature of their death (is a mantic information effect).

ability.guild.buggledexters.words-of-com.Name: Words of Comfort
ability.guild.buggledexters.words-of-com.Effect: 1/day May touch a single target and act as a Mantic Hearten and Pacification on the target for as long as the guild member remains touching them and focussing on them. This ends if the recipient or the guild member take any damage or use any powers.

ability.guild.buggledexters.words-of-har.Name: Words of Harmony
ability.guild.buggledexters.words-of-har.Effect: 1/day Acts as per the Hospitaller ability Voice of Reason.

ability.guild.bulaslavia.can-sense-weakn.Name: Can sense weaknesses in Primus
ability.guild.bulaslavia.can-sense-weakn.Effect: Can sense weaknesses in Primus: takes 30 seconds concentration and reveals if there are rifts/portals/convergences/similar within 1/4 of a mile, and provides a rough direction.

ability.guild.bulaslavia.gains-enhanced-.Name: Gains Enhanced Evaluate, as if all recs are owned, on rifts/portals
ability.guild.bulaslavia.gains-enhanced-.Effect: Gains Enhanced Evaluate, as if all recs are owned, on rifts/portals. For every 30 seconds study gains an additional major prayer of information.

ability.guild.bulaslavia.gains-ley-of-th.Name: Gains Ley of the Land as druid ability
ability.guild.bulaslavia.gains-ley-of-th.Effect: Gains Ley of the Land as druid ability.

ability.guild.bulaslavia.sense-weakness-.Name: Sense weakness now functions up to 1 mile
ability.guild.bulaslavia.sense-weakness-.Effect: Sense weakness now functions up to 1 mile. If within 1/4 of a mile then gains a rough idea of the nature of the weakness.

ability.guild.children-of-the-dusk.draw-.Name: Draw on Magic
ability.guild.children-of-the-dusk.draw-.Effect: 2/day ~ May expend “X” mana of racial innates ( max 12) to cure a guild member (not self) X TBLP/Loc damage.

ability.guild.children-of-the-dusk.evade.Name: Evade Death
ability.guild.children-of-the-dusk.evade.Effect: 1/day ~ First time the guild member would die on TBLP they may instead fall unconscious and gain a stacking live to minus 12 TBLP. To use this costs them 6 mana of racial innates.

ability.guild.children-of-the-dusk.explo.Name: Explosive Death
ability.guild.children-of-the-dusk.explo.Effect: 1/day Upon death can expend X mana of racial innates (these are used) and cause their slayer to suffer TBLP damage equal to three times the mana expended (1 hit to monsters per 3 TBLP). MAC applies at 1 for 1 and the damage is of the colour of innates used. This is a dying effect.

ability.guild.children-of-the-dusk.magic.Name: Magic is magic init?
ability.guild.children-of-the-dusk.magic.Effect: may expend up to 6 mana of racial innates to regain a racial innate of up to 6 mana.

ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Name: Embraced by Evil
ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Effect: Grants immunity to all evil spiritual effects; used as warcry, can't benefit from Goodly spirits for 30 seconds.

ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Name: Embraced by Evil
ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Effect: Grants immunity to goodly spirits for 5 minutes or against 1 effect if used retroactively

ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Name: Feed on Evil
ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Effect: +1 Spirit per evil member of the party

ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Name: Shroud of Evil
ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Effect: Grants immunity to goodly spirits for 30 seconds

ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Name: Shroud of Evil
ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Effect: Grants immunity to goodly spirits for 30 seconds, can be used as retroactive against 1 effect

ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Name: Shroud of Evil
ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Effect: Grants immunity to all evil spiritual effects for five minutes; can be retroactive

ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Name: Words of Certizal
ability.guild.church-of-certizal-shadow-.Effect: Upgrades a `conceal lie` miracle so it grants spiritual Deception at will for 5 minutes

ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.a.Name: Armour of Waste
ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.a.Effect: Grants immunity to baneful causing (anything resistance to causing would apply to or is a miracle in the causing sphere) - lasts 5 minutes.

ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Name: Deny Healing
ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Effect: Adds a 6th level miracle to base list that acts as deny power, but only functions vs healing miracles.  Verbal is `Waste denies thy gift!`

ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Name: Deny Healing
ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Effect: Adds a 4th level miracle that acts as deny power, but only functions vs healing miracles. Verbal: `Waste denies thy gift!`

ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Name: Drain Soul
ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Effect:
Gains Slayer (as tables). If already owned, then 1/day can use a slayer to gain one of the following: 
• 12/12 evil spiritual cure serious wounds
• 2 spirits back
• regain a level lost for casting an evil miracle

ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Name: Drain Soul
ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Effect:
Gains Slayer (as tables). 1/3 hours can use a slayer to gain one of the following: 
• 12/12 evil spiritual cure serious wounds
• 2 spirits back
• regain a level lost for casting an evil miracle.
 If Slayer is already owned, can use this 1/hour

ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Name: Draw on the Suffering
ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.d.Effect: with 30 seconds preperation, can reverse the effects of a causing miracle cast on the user by a Condesecration member, so that it heals the base amount of damage it would cause. Suspend Life heals 72/72 for these purposes.

ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.t.Name: Take this, Elf
ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.t.Effect: Can cast a handbook causing miracle 'mantic (black mana) vs an elf or similar (not an elemental or mana formed human, for example).

ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.t.Name: Take this, Elf
ability.guild.church-of-condesecration.t.Effect:
Can cast a handbook causing miracle 'mantic (black mana) vs an elf or similar (not an elemental or mana formed human, for example).
 Can spend both innates to enhance a published causing miracle to be mantic (black mana)

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.aggr.Name: Aggressive Champion
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.aggr.Effect: If casting a Handbook Force Tree miracle within 30 seconds of a previous casting the spirit cost of the miracle is reduced by 1 (non -cumulative with itself or other spirit cost reductions). Minimum 1 spirit.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.aid-.Name: Aid of Heroes Past
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.aid-.Effect: The Intermediate Tier innate chosen above is now upgraded to ‘at will', provided that the Priest has purchased the relevant Major Sphere

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.alli.Name: Allied Hero
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.alli.Effect: One Undead summoned by the Priest will be helpful and act in a friendly or respectful manner towards the Priest and their allies.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.ance.Name: Ancestral Aid
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.ance.Effect: A Bless or Beneficial Curse may be cast on any Church Member and will benefit them regardless of their alignment so long as they adhere to the tenets of the faith.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.call.Name: Call on Heroes Past [Beginning]
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.call.Effect: After 30 seconds appropriate prayer may cast any one handbook miracle of own alignment (Good / Neutral / Evil) of up to 4th level.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.call.Name: Call on Heroes Past [End]
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.call.Effect: After 2 minutes appropriate prayer may cast any one handbook miracle of own alignment (Good / Neutral / Evil) of up to 8th level, if not on own miracle list then this costs tblp/spirits as normal.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.call.Name: Call on Heroes Past [Middle]
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.call.Effect: After 60 seconds of appropriate prayer may cast any one handbook miracle of own alignment (Good / Neutral / Evil) of up to 6th level.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.embo.Name: Embody Milo
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.embo.Effect: Grants full Undead immunities for 5 minutes. However for the duration the Priest's left arm ceases to exist for any purpose as if it had been cut off (no damage is taken for this and no other disadvantages associated with losing a limb, such as a dwarf dying, are suffered). This means that whilst embodied miracles / abilities that require both hands to be able to cast / activate cannot be used.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.enli.Name: Enlightened
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.enli.Effect: Gains free 8th level miracle on Miracle list as per Hermit Priest.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.know.Name: Knowledgeable Guidance
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.know.Effect: One Comm I will yield 1 word answers, not just Yes / No answers.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.peac.Name: Peaceful Departure
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.peac.Effect: One Undead dismissed leaves no taint on the body (as it had been purified).

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.pers.Name: Personal Faith
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.pers.Effect: Each Priest of the Dead Heroes has a Personal Faith, and may design their own miracle list following the rules for a Hermit Priest. The Priest uses the miracle list even if not battle-boarding the Church's basic benefits.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.revi.Name: Reviving Strength
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.revi.Effect: One Handbook healing tree miracle cast upon a Member of the Church grants +25% effect

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.stal.Name: Stalwart Warding
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.stal.Effect: May cast a Handbook Warding Miracle as to allow any member of the church to be able to cross freely.

ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.will.Name: Willing spirits of Carnage
ability.guild.church-of-dead-heroes.will.Effect: If a handbook Causing tree miracle is not discharged after being cast the priest regains ½ the spirits round ed down minimum of 1. This has no effect on miracles cast using innates, scrolls or items.

ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.dark.Name: Dark Feast Claimed
ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.dark.Effect: Can cast a Souls Hunger onto a causing miracle that is cast with Lesser Wings of darkness.

ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.gain.Name: Gains Spiritual Discern Outlaw
ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.gain.Effect: Reveals individuals Ostracised by the Empire.

ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.loya.Name: Loyalist's Feast
ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.loya.Effect: If using a Souls Hunger on an Outlaw, Wolfshead or individual ostracised by the Empire then the healing gained is doubled.

ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.mast.Name: Mastery of the Dead
ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.mast.Effect: When using Talk to Spirit on intelligent Undead the Undead cannot lie to it.

ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.powe.Name: Power of the Zombie
ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.powe.Effect: Counts as one level higher (stacks with published increases) for the purposes of Raising/Controlling Undead .

ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.puri.Name: Purity in Death
ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.puri.Effect: If raised as Undead then gains Depraved Cunning and retains own personality.

ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.soul.Name: Soul of Death
ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.soul.Effect: Gains a Fortified Spirit, and if raised as Undead by a member of the Iron and Empire the members body is not tainted, so can still be returned to life (or animated again).

ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.stre.Name: Strength of the Isle
ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.stre.Effect: When raising a published Undead they gain Depraved Cunning, Darkened Potence, Utilise strength with pure and Undead Alacrity. If the priest already has Depraved Cunning or Darkened Potence then the Undead instead gains an extra 5 Hits. The Undead summoned in this way is also controlled by the caster until they (the Undead) are slain (this included Vampires) .

ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.thre.Name: Threat to the Empire
ability.guild.church-of-iron-empire.thre.Effect: For 5 minutes vs one Target that is an Outlaw/Ostracised by the Empire all causing used by the priest inflict s permanent damage. Alternatively , the priest gains + 1 max damage (max quin) vs them. Chosen when used. Forged in Iron - Stage Two: Cost: +75 Table: 5

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.after-.Name: After casting Identify Spirit sucessfully on something, gains a follow up major prayer.
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.after-.Effect: After casting Identify Spirit sucessfully on something, gains a follow up major prayer.

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.ask-th.Name: Ask the correct God
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.ask-th.Effect: When casting a Comm sphere miracle that asks the spirits of Knowledge (eg Comm 2, Major Prayer etc) can choose to seek guidance from a specific patron (eg St Michael) and the answer should be shaped by this.

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.i-give.Name: I give you my Knowledge
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.i-give.Effect: with 30 seconds prep time, can grant another priest (of any faith), knowledge of a miracle on the user's list.  Must be of an alignment the user can cast, but can break sphere restrictions (not devotion, however).  Lasts 5 minutes and after this time, the user loses knowledge of the miracle.

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.i-give.Name: I give you my Knowledge
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.i-give.Effect: with 30 seconds prep time, can grant another priest (of any faith), knowledge of a miracle on the user's list.  Must be of an alignment the user can cast, but can break sphere restrictions (not devotion, however).  Lasts 15 minutes and during this time, the user loses knowledge of the miracle.

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.i-seek.Name: I seek Knowledge and Understanding
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.i-seek.Effect: acts as a knowledge of the arcane and then a single yes/no question around the inital answer.

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.improv.Name: Improved Detect Spirits
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.improv.Effect:
With 30 seconds prep, Rec spirit and Milly's Detect Spirits now reveal the alignment of spirits present.
 with 30 seconds additional prep, Detect Spirits provides Guage Spirit details too (if guage spirit is owned)

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.improv.Name: Improved Spirit of seeing & hearing
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.improv.Effect: With 30 seconds prep, Spirit of Seeing and Spirit of Seeing and Hearing now reveal the alignment of spirits present.

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.rec-sp.Name: Rec spirit reveals Y/N: living, undead, inanimate
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.rec-sp.Effect: Rec Spirit reveals if a spirit is living, undead, or inanimate (item, ward, scroll etc, doesn't reveal which of these it is)

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.study-.Name: Study of the book
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.study-.Effect: At the start of the day gains an adventure temp Scripture of the Faith tied to the faith of Knowledge.  Before the dungeon these can be read by any member of the faith on dungeon.

ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.study-.Name: Study of the book
ability.guild.church-of-knowledge.study-.Effect: Scruptures can be any faith but that faith must be chosen at the start of the day.

ability.guild.church-of-mortai.fortified.Name: Fortified Spirit
ability.guild.church-of-mortai.fortified.Effect: as per the tables ability, If already possessed then gains Immunity to Slayer and similar effects.

ability.guild.church-of-mortai.guild-mir.Name: Guild Miracle
ability.guild.church-of-mortai.guild-mir.Effect: Reveal Undead Name added to own miracle list. If desired may instead battle -board this miracle as a 1/day innate.

ability.guild.church-of-mortai.righteous.Name: Righteous Aura
ability.guild.church-of-mortai.righteous.Effect: The priest's spirit is concentrated more fully in opposition of Undead spirits. For the duration, the priest may not cast any miracle unless directly against Undead . However, any Undead creature of level 5 or below which touches or is touched by the priest is destroyed instantly, costing the priest 3 TBLP per level of the Undead . Undead of level 6 take 12 TBLP (4 hits) of goodly spiritual damage for each touch. This is a releasable miracle, and does affect the Undead.

ability.guild.church-of-mortai.sanctifie.Name: Sanctified Ground
ability.guild.church-of-mortai.sanctifie.Effect: may cast a Protection from Spirits [Evil] solely against Undead, in which case it does not require a line/circle to be drawn but is created around the caster in a radius of up to 6' or in a line up to 15' across up to 3' distance from the caster.

ability.guild.church-of-mortai.sanctifie.Name: Sanctified Ground
ability.guild.church-of-mortai.sanctifie.Effect:
may cast a Protection from Spirits [Evil] solely against Undead, in which case it does not require a line/circle to be drawn but is created around the caster in a radius of up to 6' or in a line up to 15' across up to 3' distance from the caster.
May use a second innate of the Basic Tier ability or use it to act as per a n innate of ‘The Light of Faith', but with only a 15 minute duration.

ability.guild.church-of-mortai.stalwart-.Name: Stalwart Against Undeath
ability.guild.church-of-mortai.stalwart-.Effect: Gains +18tblp casting stamina for the purposes of Dismissal Tree and Sphere miracles, Righteous Aura, and Hand of Purity.

ability.guild.church-of-mortai.the-enemy.Name: The Enemy Predictable
ability.guild.church-of-mortai.the-enemy.Effect: Gains Combat Wary against Undead. The skill level is equal to the highest dismiss miracle known. [Max 10pts].

ability.guild.church-of-mortai.the-shiel.Name: The Shield of Mortai
ability.guild.church-of-mortai.the-shiel.Effect: Spirit Shield but only against Undead Touch Effects, the user may choose whether to apply it or not against the attacks suffered. This innate only works on members of the Church of Mortai.

ability.guild.church-of-mortai.undead-se.Name: Undead Sense
ability.guild.church-of-mortai.undead-se.Effect: As per the tables ability Spirit Sense but only applies against Undead. If Spirit Sense is already owned, then this ability is enhanced to grant Spiritual Vigilance against Undead.

ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.discern-.Name: Discern Associated Spirits
ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.discern-.Effect: If already possessed then gains Discern Nature of wounds to 20 feet.

ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.extra-mi.Name: Extra Miracle
ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.extra-mi.Effect: If battle boarding the Church as a Professional Guild gains the miracle Spirit Shift: As Words From Above but is a 4sp goodly miracle. Verbal: “Shaehan, Take me hence!”

ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.haven.Name: Haven
ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.haven.Effect: The Shaehan priest must audibly and clearly speak the Prayer of Haven immediately before meditating, the priest then speaks no further words before going into the meditative trance (Max. 3 seconds later). As the meditation starts the priest disappears from the point of meditation and appears at Shaehan's side where he/she is totally safe and gains +x1 meditation rate [max 5]. However the meditation ends after the pre -set time or when on full spirits which ever happens first, and cannot end before. The priest re -appears at the point where he/she started, unless the party have moved on in which case the priest will reappear at the safest place within 20' of the party.

ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.no-place.Name: No place like Primus
ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.no-place.Effect: Should any person within the party which the priest left call the name of the priest three times while they are in Haven, the priest becomes aware that they are being called and may elect to end the meditation early and return at that time. The meditation is not broken if they do not choose to do so. Oh Mistress Shaehan, Lady of Light Listen I plea to the prayer of Haven Oh Lady of Mercy Grant me sanctuary In which to meditate Protect and watch over me As I pray for the power To continue your work Shelter me under the wings Of the sacred dove Bathe me in your Holy Light Oh Lady Shaehan Goddess of Forgiveness and Mercy Let thy love shine over the lands Let me spread the word of your love As I preach your message of peace Grant me the power with which to heal And cure the wounds This mortal life doth caus e Show kindness to me thy priest And mercy to the persecuted Grant me thy servant The shelter of thy sacred abode I beseech thee Show your humble servant The tender mercies that this Mortal world doth lack Defend me from those who Would strike the defencel ess Protect me from those Who would show no mercy. NOTE: As Haven exists within the very essence of the goddess, entrance to it is barred to all except Priests of Shaehan. It is not possible to use means of interplanar transport to enter Haven.

ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.passive-.Name: Passive Heal
ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.passive-.Effect: Member is aided by the Lady Shaehan such that they are considered to have a ‘Passive Heal' miracle active on them at all times. This means that should a Heal miracle be cast specifically into this ‘receptacle' it will be held in abeyance, and only activate on the priest should they be down more than 36 life, or have a location fall to zero or below. In all respects this functions like the Words from Above miracle, except that it has no duration, and may be replenished if desired whenever it is used. Defender of the Innocent - Stage Two: Cost: +90 Table: 7

ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.temple-a.Name: Temple Altars
ability.guild.church-of-shaehan.temple-a.Effect: The altars of the three main temples of Shaehan, in Scarlene, Sellville and the Halgar, are empowered to allow transport between them. A Shaehan member may spend 30 seconds in prayer before one, name one of the other two and touch the altar to be transported to it instantly. This may be done once per day from each altar for each Shaehan member, and may be repeated at will with the addition of casting the Spirit shift miracle after the prayer. This only transports guild members to one of the other two altars.

ability.guild.church-of-the-destroyer.fe.Name: Feed on Suffering
ability.guild.church-of-the-destroyer.fe.Effect: With 30 seconds prep can cast a causing miracle on self and instead be healed half the amount it would normally inflict (before resistances). Only works with damaging miracles.

ability.guild.church-of-the-destroyer.ob.Name: Obliterate the spirit
ability.guild.church-of-the-destroyer.ob.Effect: Vs a non -animate spirit (so not an Undead , but could be an active miracle, line etc.) with 30 seconds clear prayer to the destroyer can destroy the spirit (in a similar manner to a dispel). This is a non-published dispelling effect for immunity purposes and costs the user 3 TBLP per spirit of the miracle destroye d (or 60 TBLP if it does not have a level). Range 10ft, and can only target one spirit (if a line has more than one spirit in it this destroys one of them).

ability.guild.church-of-the-destroyer.pr.Name: Prayer of Destruction
ability.guild.church-of-the-destroyer.pr.Effect: Takes 30 seconds prayer over a dead body that had a spirit. Acts as per a slayer, but if successful also heals the user 3/3 per level of resistance the victim had. 1/2 a spirit and similar does not increase the healing gained, instead it actually halves it. A dead person can only be affected by this once.

ability.guild.church-of-the-destroyer.wo.Name: Word of Destruction
ability.guild.church-of-the-destroyer.wo.Effect: As per the published Unholy Word for causing, except does not affect Destroyer worshippers.

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Empresses Force
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect:
May choose to benefit from one of the following:
i: Pure Force is now considered a Universal Sphere miracles, but costs a level to cast.
ii: Pure Force remains a Major force sphere miracle, but now only costs 6 spirits to cast.
iii: Gains an innate pure force.

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Fire of the Empress
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect: May turn a standard miracle mantic (red mana/flaming).

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Fires of the Empress
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect: May turn a standard offensive miracle mantic (red mana/flaming).

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Force of Glass
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect: One use of a pure force grants immunity to the effect for 10 seconds.

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Force of Glass
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect: One use of a pure force grants immunity to the effect for 30 seconds.

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Mistress of the Throne
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect: At the start of each day may add up to 10 spirits of standard miracles to the priest's miracle list. These may be changed dungeon to dungeon (or day to day on extended lengths). They CANNOT be used for making items/writing scrolls or similar.

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Mistress of the Throne
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect: At the start of each day may add up to 10 spirits of published miracles to the priest's miracle list. These may be changed dungeon to dungeon (or day to day on extended lengths). They CANNOT be used for making items/writing scrolls or similar.

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Strength of the Realm
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect: Members gain +1 Spirit per member of the Church or Noble of the Blood on dungeon (a person can only count once), to a maximum of their table. Non-spirit using classes (EG spirit warriors) may battle board these spirits as innates of miracles on their list.

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Will of the Empress
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect: One word minor prayer but the answer is from the broad opinion of the Empress (religiously).

ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Name: Will of the Empress
ability.guild.church-of-the-empress-godd.Effect: Major prayer but the answer is from the broad opinion of the Empress (religiously)

ability.guild.church-of-the-lady-of-the-.Name: Immunity to Befriend Spirit and Spiritual Mastery
Looks Familiar
ability.guild.church-of-the-lady-of-the-.Effect: after 10 seconds of inspecting an Undead creature that responds as “unknown” can recall the name and level (as per Reveal Undead Name)

ability.guild.church-of-the-lady-of-the-.Name: Sight of the Stars
ability.guild.church-of-the-lady-of-the-.Effect: See Through Supernatural Darkness and Fully Active Spirit sight for 5 minutes. Verbal: “By her grace is darkness banished!”

ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Name: Blessings of the Forge
ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Effect: 1/day, enhances a normal bless in one of the following ways chosen when used: 1. To act as a Shield Blessing 2. To turn a normal suit of armour, shield or weapon apprentice crafted for the day. 3. To turn a normal weapon +0 goodly spirit for 5 mins 4. To enhance an object from “The Master Forge provides” to become journeyman status for the day.

ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Name: Bonds of the Soul
ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Effect: Gains +1 spirit (max 4) for every member of the Soul Forger church on dungeon (includes ley believers).

ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Name: Forges Light
ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Effect: Enhances a single casting of Passive Heal so that it lasts until triggered.

ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Name: The Master Forge continues to provide
ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Effect: One of the objects from The Master Forge Provides (basic tier) is now journeyman status. If Blessing of the Forge is used on it then it becomes master status.

ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Name: The Master Forge provides
ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Effect: Members are well equipped with a suit of apprentice crafted armour, an apprentice crafted weapon, and an apprentice crafted shield – these are for themselves only.

ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Name: The Masters Forge
ability.guild.church-of-the-soul-forger..Effect: Two of the objects gained are now journeyman status objects as intermediate tier. Alternatively can take a single object from the list as master status.

ability.guild.church-of-the-tryst.invoke.Name: Invoke the abysmal power
ability.guild.church-of-the-tryst.invoke.Effect: Can turn a published evil miracle demonic (black/red/evil spirit) taking 10 seconds ritual/calling on the Imbaiu per spirit of the miracle. If used for a TOD/animate life/similar miracle that requires a prot this also allows the prot to be cast mantically (taking an extra 30 seconds prep).

ability.guild.church-of-the-tryst.shadow.Name: Shadow of the Imbaiu
ability.guild.church-of-the-tryst.shadow.Effect: allows the priest to invoke the shadow of an Imbaiu to share their form. This takes 30 seconds and grants them 1/2 effect all bar spirit for 5 minutes. While active discerns as a demon kind and if banished the power ends.

ability.guild.church-of-the-tryst.the-da.Name: The dark bargains
ability.guild.church-of-the-tryst.the-da.Effect: takes 1 minute to open a link to the Imbaiu costing 24 TBLP of the casters blood/essence in sacrifice. Acts as a mantic comm 2 but each question asked costs the user a level (c.f. casting a TOD, but reductions in level loss from casting miracles do not apply).

ability.guild.church-of-the-tryst.the-wa.Name: The ways of Mephastofolies
ability.guild.church-of-the-tryst.the-wa.Effect: gains bar spirit on base list while battle boarding the church.

ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.counte.Name: Counter Rite
ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.counte.Effect: Mantic Deny Power in all ways except with the verbal: “The Circle denies thy power!” but only applies against effects targeting self or another Circle member.

ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.counte.Name: Counter Rite
ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.counte.Effect: may be used to counter multiple simultaneous attacks from the same source (e.g. 5 Shadow Strikes at the same time).

ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.discer.Name: Discern Supernatural Power User
ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.discer.Effect: This is the character's primary powerbase or physical if they have none.

ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.discer.Name: Discern Supernatural Power User
ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.discer.Effect: Reveals the type of power owned for 3 TBLP per use.

ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.discer.Name: Discern Supernatural Power User
ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.discer.Effect: will now reveal if an individual is a member of the Circle, a Hedge, or other power user.

ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.elemen.Name: Elemental Rite of Defence
ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.elemen.Effect: +1 MAC applicable versus attacks from Hedge Wizards, Demonkind or Fey. Rises to +2 MAC if 2 additional Claws of the circle members are on adventure.

ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.spirit.Name: Spiritual Rite of Defence
ability.guild.claws-of-the-circle.spirit.Effect: +1 SAC applicable versus attacks from Hedge Wizards, Demonkind or Fey. Rises to +2 SAC if 2 additional Claws of the circle members are on adventure.

ability.guild.deci.deci-s-swarm.Name: Deci's Swarm
ability.guild.deci.deci-s-swarm.Effect: Deci's Swarm: May call on Primal Force of the Swarm 1/day. Declared as per a warcry with the user taking the form of a swarm of insects, making them immune to weapon blows for 30 seconds. May not be ended early. Whilst in this form may not cast/fight as per gaseous form but can travel at a slow walk.

ability.guild.deci.faith-in-the-city-1-d.Name: Faith in the City 1/day
ability.guild.deci.faith-in-the-city-1-d.Effect: Faith in the City 1/day: Acts as per a True Believer but may be any faith in Deci that has a score of 20 or more. Can never be used to cast a goodly miracle.

ability.guild.deci.faith-in-the-city-may.Name: Faith in the City may be used to cast a published black spell of a level up to the Kallahs table
ability.guild.deci.faith-in-the-city-may.Effect: Faith in the City may be used to cast a published black spell of a level up to the Kallahs table.

ability.guild.deci.faith-in-the-city-may.Name: Faith in the City may now instead be used to cast a standard black spell
ability.guild.deci.faith-in-the-city-may.Effect: Faith in the City may now instead be used to cast a standard black spell.

ability.guild.deci.if-killed-may-ooc-cho.Name: If killed may OOC choose for body to vanish 2 minutes later and be mantically Animate Life'd by Tangle; this takes 15 minutes
ability.guild.deci.if-killed-may-ooc-cho.Effect: If killed may OOC choose for body to vanish 2 minutes later and be mantically Animate Life'd by Tangle; this takes 15 minutes. May return to adventure but must have the means/be able to.

ability.guild.deci.if-killed-tangle-may-.Name: If killed, Tangle may be informed of this
ability.guild.deci.if-killed-tangle-may-.Effect: If killed, Tangle may be informed of this. Gains Fated Hero if returned to life by Tangle.

ability.guild.deci.if-using-intermediate.Name: If using intermediate tier animate life, may choose to be mantically plane shifted back to the adventure (safe place within 20ft of party)
ability.guild.deci.if-using-intermediate.Effect: If using intermediate tier animate life, may choose to be mantically plane shifted back to the adventure (safe place within 20ft of party). Once completed, suffers a freeze on arrival.

ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Name: An Eye for the Unusual
ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Effect: Acts as a one use enhanced evaluate vs an object/relic (e.g. a treasure Indiana jones might want to grab).

ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Name: Eye for the Unusual.
ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Effect: An Eye for the Unusual may now also be used on active rituals, altars or similar.

ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Name: Eye for the Unusual.
ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Effect: Now counts as having the relevant “Rec” for an Eye for the Unusual if effected by the relevant powerbase (e.g. Elves cannot count as having rec spirit, but can have rec mana).

ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Name: Eye for the Unusual
ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Effect: Can use all three innate an Eye for the Unusual's on an object and it will act as an Investigation (as the Silver spell) of the relevant power bases.

ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Name: Tagged and bagged
ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Effect: If returning a "dangerous artefact" to the inquisition that had an ISP value gains 500 grulls per ISP as payment. This must be done at the debrief and the ISP are used in doing this. The guild must have been battle boarded that day to use this.

ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Name: Watch Out
ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Effect: Danger sense with regards to approaching/touching/using relics/artefacts based on the object (e.g. anyone touching this suffers a touch of death would trigger danger sense, the unconnected trap that happens to be under it would not).

ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Name: You might need this
ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Effect: Gains a dungeon temp item of a single use standard spell to 6th level or handbook miracle to 4th.

ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Name: You might need this
ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Effect: Also Gains 10 power (mana or spirits) of useful scrolls chosen by the ref at the start of the day.

ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Name: You might need this
ability.guild.department-of-recoveries-a.Effect: item from basic tier can now be any standard spell or miracle.

ability.guild.earthen-conclave.alliance-.Name: Alliance of Earth
ability.guild.earthen-conclave.alliance-.Effect: 1/ day: Remove a Brown spell currently on them for 1 TBLP per MP (Max 12 TBLP) or negate it as it happens, for 2 TBLP per MP (to a max cost of 18 TBLP). Verbal: “The Earth is my ally!”

ability.guild.earthen-conclave.armour-of.Name: Armour of Earth
ability.guild.earthen-conclave.armour-of.Effect: Plate (O) cast on self grants MAC 6 / PAC 6.

ability.guild.earthen-conclave.conductin.Name: Conducting
ability.guild.earthen-conclave.conductin.Effect: Grounding can be used on electric or blue mana attacks within 20' of an Earthern Conclave member.

ability.guild.earthen-conclave.earthen-w.Name: Earthen Window
ability.guild.earthen-conclave.earthen-w.Effect: 1/ day for 5 minutes member can see through a Wall of Stone they cast if they remain in contact with the wall.

ability.guild.earthen-conclave.grounding.Name: Grounding 1/ day
ability.guild.earthen-conclave.grounding.Effect: Whilst in contact with Earth or stone grants complete immunity to one blue mana or electric attack.

ability.guild.earthen-conclave.might-of-.Name: Might of Rock
ability.guild.earthen-conclave.might-of-.Effect: The Wizard's Grimoire Rock Skin spell also grants a resistance to Sever/loc to zero.

ability.guild.earthen-conclave.passage.Name: Passage
ability.guild.earthen-conclave.passage.Effect: As a cantrip may release a Wall of Stone that the Talthar member has previously cast. Range 20'. Verbal: “Gnomes of Earth I release thee”.

ability.guild.earthen-conclave.sure-foot.Name: Sure Footed
ability.guild.earthen-conclave.sure-foot.Effect: grants Stability whilst in contact with Earth or Stone.

ability.guild.eartholme.counts-as-an-ivo.Name: Counts as an Ivory mana user for the purposes of Honour Prevails
ability.guild.eartholme.counts-as-an-ivo.Effect: Counts as an Ivory mana user for the purposes of Honour Prevails.

ability.guild.eartholme.gains-innates-as.Name: Gains innates as per Earth Elf calculated at Kallah level
ability.guild.eartholme.gains-innates-as.Effect: Gains innates as per Earth Elf calculated at Kallah level.

ability.guild.eartholme.gains-innates-as.Name: Gains innates as per Earth Elf calculated at Kallah level -1
ability.guild.eartholme.gains-innates-as.Effect: Gains innates as per Earth Elf calculated at Kallah level -1.

ability.guild.eartholme.gains-innates-as.Name: Gains innates as per Earth Elf calculated at Kallah level -2
ability.guild.eartholme.gains-innates-as.Effect: Gains innates as per Earth Elf calculated at Kallah level -2.

ability.guild.eartholme.is-now-bound-by-.Name: Is now bound by the Ivory code
ability.guild.eartholme.is-now-bound-by-.Effect: Is now bound by the Ivory code. If they break the code they lose all city spirit benefits for the dungeon.

ability.guild.eartholme.may-now-read-bro.Name: May now read Brown or Ivory mana Teaching Scrolls as normal scrolls, not gaining any other benefit
ability.guild.eartholme.may-now-read-bro.Effect: May now read Brown or Ivory mana Teaching Scrolls as normal scrolls, not gaining any other benefit. This does mean advanced spells can be cast.

ability.guild.eartholme.now-gains-2-leve.Name: Now gains +2 levels for casting Brown or Ivory scrolls (or 2nd level casting)
ability.guild.eartholme.now-gains-2-leve.Effect: Now gains +2 levels for casting Brown or Ivory scrolls (or 2nd level casting).

ability.guild.eartholme.now-gains-4-leve.Name: Now gains +4 levels (or 4th level casting) total for casting Brown or Ivory magical scrolls
ability.guild.eartholme.now-gains-4-leve.Effect: Now gains +4 levels (or 4th level casting) total for casting Brown or Ivory magical scrolls.

ability.guild.eartholme.when-reading-bro.Name: When reading Brown or Ivory magical scrolls gains +1 level for calculating casting damage
ability.guild.eartholme.when-reading-bro.Effect: When reading Brown or Ivory magical scrolls gains +1 level for calculating casting damage. If the Kallah cannot already read such then they gain the ability to do so with 1st level casting.

ability.guild.earthsunder.a-strange-sens.Name: A Strange Sense
ability.guild.earthsunder.a-strange-sens.Effect: When using the racial evaluate members gain an instinct if there are supernatural qualities to an object, or something more than its grull value. They do not gain exact details just a sense that there is something there.

ability.guild.earthsunder.denounce-the-m.Name: Denounce the Magic
ability.guild.earthsunder.denounce-the-m.Effect: 1/day for 5 minutes enhance the dwarves racial ½ effect magic to grant complete immunity to magic. This cannot be ended early.

ability.guild.earthsunder.eyes-of-the-de.Name: Eyes of the Deep
ability.guild.earthsunder.eyes-of-the-de.Effect: 1/day for 5 minutes upgrades the Dwarves natural ability to see in the dark to act as per Senseless Vision.

ability.guild.earthsunder.well-armoured.Name: Well Armoured
ability.guild.earthsunder.well-armoured.Effect: When wearing Master crafter metal armour gains + 1 Max A/C and the armour grants an additional point of PAC.

ability.guild.enclave.discern-own-mana-u.Name: Discern Own Mana-User
ability.guild.enclave.discern-own-mana-u.Effect: Identifies someone who shares a colour of mana with the user

ability.guild.enclave.elemental-bonding.Name: Elemental Bonding
ability.guild.enclave.elemental-bonding.Effect: Magical Befriend, only usable on a mana-user of own colour

ability.guild.enclave.elemental-bonding..Name: Elemental Bonding
ability.guild.enclave.elemental-bonding..Effect: Mass Magical Befriend, only usable on mana-users of own colour

ability.guild.enclave.library-access.Name: Library Access
ability.guild.enclave.library-access.Effect: after 10 seconds meditative thought an Enclave member may confirm or deny a question regarding magical issues, as magical Minor Prayer

ability.guild.enclave.library-access.2.Name: Library Access
ability.guild.enclave.library-access.2.Effect: after 10 seconds meditative thought an Enclave member may confirm or deny a question regarding magical issues, as magical Minor Prayer

ability.guild.enclave.library-access.3.Name: Library Access
ability.guild.enclave.library-access.3.Effect: after 10 seconds meditative thought an Enclave member may confirm or deny a question regarding magical issues, as magical Minor Prayer

ability.guild.enclave.library-study.Name: Library Study
ability.guild.enclave.library-study.Effect: after 30 seconds meditative thought a Enclave member may remember an important piece of information, relevant to magical matters only, as magical Major Prayer.

ability.guild.enclave.library-study.2.Name: Library Study
ability.guild.enclave.library-study.2.Effect: after 30 seconds meditative thought an Enclave member may remember an important piece of information, relevant to magical matters only, as magical Major Prayer.

ability.guild.enclave.practised-scribing.Name: Practised Scribing
ability.guild.enclave.practised-scribing.Effect: the character may write out a scroll of any handbook spell they can cast

ability.guild.enclave.scholarly-leanings.Name: Scholarly Leanings
ability.guild.enclave.scholarly-leanings.Effect: Gains the ability to Recognise Mana and Read Mana Glyphs (not use scrolls), If these skills are already both owned then may choose to be well equipped with any one standard scroll

ability.guild.enclave.vague-reality.Name: Vague Reality
ability.guild.enclave.vague-reality.Effect: acts in all ways as a Passive Illusion, except - no verbal required, instead takes 10 seconds preparation. It is not magical, but (effectively) physical in nature.

ability.guild.frontline.bulking-up.Name: Bulking Up
ability.guild.frontline.bulking-up.Effect: +12/4 temp life for the next 5 minutes, does not stack with supernaturally generated temp life.

ability.guild.frontline.roll-with-it.Name: Roll With It
ability.guild.frontline.roll-with-it.Effect: 1/ day may roll with a weapon blow such that only takes rockskin style damage of 1pt per damage grade , must be fully aware of and able to see blow coming.

ability.guild.frontline.strength-in-numb.Name: Strength in Numbers
ability.guild.frontline.strength-in-numb.Effect: Gains +3/1 status life per member of the Front line on dungeon (including self) to a max of 12/4.

ability.guild.ghalabhad.gain-1-stacking-.Name: Gain +1 stacking backstab vs Athfanal or citizens of Khaniabhad
ability.guild.ghalabhad.gain-1-stacking-.Effect: Gain +1 stacking backstab vs Athfanal or citizens of Khaniabhad.

ability.guild.ghalabhad.gain-4-mana-per-.Name: Gain 4 mana per tier that can be used to cast handbook dispels, no casting damage is suffered
ability.guild.ghalabhad.gain-4-mana-per-.Effect: Gain 4 mana per tier that can be used to cast handbook dispels, no casting damage is suffered.

ability.guild.ghalabhad.gain-discern-Ath.Name: Gain Discern Athfanal at will; this is a 20ft range magical and physical info FX
ability.guild.ghalabhad.gain-discern-Ath.Effect: Gain Discern Athfanal at will; this is a 20ft range magical and physical info FX.

ability.guild.ghalabhad.gain-discern-cit.Name: Gain Discern Citizen of Khaniabhad, again a magical and physical info effect
ability.guild.ghalabhad.gain-discern-cit.Effect: Gain Discern Citizen of Khaniabhad, again a magical and physical info effect.

ability.guild.ghalabhad.the-spirit-remai.Name: The spirit remains weak after being attacked at a prior Final Dawn but is recovering
ability.guild.ghalabhad.the-spirit-remai.Effect: The spirit remains weak after being attacked at a prior Final Dawn but is recovering.

ability.guild.ghulston.call-upon-the-spi.Name: Call upon the Spirit
ability.guild.ghulston.call-upon-the-spi.Effect: Call upon the Spirit: acts as a True Believer but for a standard comms or necromancy miracle up to 4th level.

ability.guild.ghulston.call-upon-the-spi.Name: Call upon the Spirit is now any standard comms or necromancy miracle
ability.guild.ghulston.call-upon-the-spi.Effect: Call upon the Spirit is now any standard comms or necromancy miracle.

ability.guild.ghulston.fenton-s-taint-1-.Name: Fenton's Taint 1/day
ability.guild.ghulston.fenton-s-taint-1-.Effect: Fenton's Taint 1/day: with 30 seconds prep acts as a dismiss ghoul (goodly spirit in nature).

ability.guild.ghulston.fenton-s-taint-ca.Name: Fenton's Taint can instead be used as a Hand of Purity
ability.guild.ghulston.fenton-s-taint-ca.Effect: Fenton's Taint can instead be used as a Hand of Purity.

ability.guild.ghulston.fenton-s-taint-no.Name: Fenton's Taint now acts as a dismiss vampire
ability.guild.ghulston.fenton-s-taint-no.Effect: Fenton's Taint now acts as a dismiss vampire.

ability.guild.ghulston.invoke-the-ghouls.Name: Invoke the Ghoulstone 1/day
ability.guild.ghulston.invoke-the-ghouls.Effect: Invoke the Ghoulstone 1/day: lasts 5 minutes and acts as a cloak of fear but vs ghouls, ghasts and ghoul-related beings (shouls/drouls etc).

ability.guild.ghulston.invoke-the-wraith.Name: Invoke the Wraithtree
ability.guild.ghulston.invoke-the-wraith.Effect: Invoke the Wraithtree: acts as either Cause Fear or Level Drain (both as undead touch FX), and if successful cures the user 12/12.

ability.guild.gothiel.angels-voice-1-day.Name: Angels Voice 1/day
ability.guild.gothiel.angels-voice-1-day.Effect: Angels Voice 1/day: before casting a dismiss miracle, or using a holy word dismiss from Gothiel benefits, may drink a dose of holy water and increase the level of effect of the dismiss by 1. The dismiss must be used within 30 seconds or this benefit is wasted.

ability.guild.gothiel.combat-wary-now-ap.Name: Combat wary now applies vs the first two blows from undead or demonkind
ability.guild.gothiel.combat-wary-now-ap.Effect: Combat wary now applies vs the first two blows from undead or demonkind.

ability.guild.gothiel.gains-discern-demo.Name: Gains Discern Demonkind and Discern Nature of Undead
ability.guild.gothiel.gains-discern-demo.Effect: Gains Discern Demonkind and Discern Nature of Undead.

ability.guild.gothiel.gains-holy-word-di.Name: Gains Holy Word dismissal as paladin 1/day
ability.guild.gothiel.gains-holy-word-di.Effect: Gains Holy Word dismissal as paladin 1/day.

ability.guild.gothiel.gains-well-equippe.Name: Gains Well Equipped with 1 dose of adventure temp holy water
ability.guild.gothiel.gains-well-equippe.Effect: Gains Well Equipped with 1 dose of adventure temp holy water.

ability.guild.gothiel.holy-water-gained-.Name: Holy water gained from above also works against evil demonkind
ability.guild.gothiel.holy-water-gained-.Effect: Holy water gained from above also works against evil demonkind.

ability.guild.gothiel.if-using-holy-wate.Name: If using holy water to coat own weapons then one dose will last for two blows vs undead

ability.guild.gothiel.is-now-well-equipp.Name: Is now well equipped with 3 total doses of adventure temp holy water

ability.guild.gothiel.is-well-equipped-w.Name: Is well equipped with 2 total doses of adventure temp holy water

ability.guild.gothiel.unless-goodly-kall.Name: Unless Goodly, Kallah do not gain 2nd or 3rd tier benefits

ability.guild.halgar.2nd-tier-mend-abili.Name: 2nd tier mend ability can now act as reform, reshape, fix a rust, repair a melt, or reforge a burn wood
ability.guild.halgar.2nd-tier-mend-abili.Effect: 2nd tier mend ability can now act as reform, reshape, fix a rust, repair a melt, or reforge a burn wood. Broadly it can counter any weapon-destruction style effect.

ability.guild.halgar.can-choose-to-be-th.Name: Can choose to be the alignment of any noble present on dungeon
ability.guild.halgar.can-choose-to-be-th.Effect: Can choose to be the alignment of any noble present on dungeon.

ability.guild.halgar.can-mend-weapons-sh.Name: Can mend weapons, shields, armour, or buildings at will
ability.guild.halgar.can-mend-weapons-sh.Effect: Can mend weapons, shields, armour, or buildings at will. Takes 1 minute for weapons, shields, or armour. Buildings take time at ref discretion. This requires calling on the Nagrech/similar.

ability.guild.halgar.evading-giants.Name: Evading Giants
ability.guild.halgar.evading-giants.Effect: Evading Giants: Gains immunity to damage based on being stepped on, or buildings/ceilings/similar falling on them.

ability.guild.halgar.evading-giants-can-.Name: Evading Giants can now protect one other individual within 5ft
ability.guild.halgar.evading-giants-can-.Effect: Evading Giants can now protect one other individual within 5ft.

ability.guild.halgar.evading-giants-now-.Name: Evading Giants now protects all individuals within 5ft
ability.guild.halgar.evading-giants-now-.Effect: Evading Giants now protects all individuals within 5ft.

ability.guild.halgar.gains-absorb-empath.Name: Gains absorb empathic alignment based on nobles present on dungeon (immunity to alignment change applies)
ability.guild.halgar.gains-absorb-empath.Effect: Gains absorb empathic alignment based on nobles present on dungeon (immunity to alignment change applies).

ability.guild.halgar.if-on-dungeon-with-.Name: If on dungeon with a Noble of the Empire gains retainer to that House
ability.guild.halgar.if-on-dungeon-with-.Effect: If on dungeon with a Noble of the Empire gains retainer to that House. If multiple nobles are present then can only choose one house. If already a retainer then this ability does not work if a member of their house is present. Cannot gain retainer to self.

ability.guild.halgar.nobles-gain-a-1-poi.Name: Nobles gain a 1 point power reduction on all beneficial effects cast on a Kallah (can include self)
ability.guild.halgar.nobles-gain-a-1-poi.Effect: Nobles gain a 1 point power reduction on all beneficial effects cast on a Kallah (can include self). Stacks with published reductions to a minimum of half (rounded up) or 1 (whichever is more).

ability.guild.halgar.now-gains-retainer-.Name: Now gains retainer to all Nobles of the Empire on dungeon if desired, still not self
ability.guild.halgar.now-gains-retainer-.Effect: Now gains retainer to all Nobles of the Empire on dungeon if desired, still not self.

ability.guild.hell-company.demon-bane.Name: Demon bane
ability.guild.hell-company.demon-bane.Effect: may call forth ‘holy fire' to cover any one normal weapon, whatever it may be. Whilst wielded by a goodly target it inflict s +0 light-based white mana damage for the next 5 minutes versus Demons only with the verbal “Powers of light imbue this weapon of vengeance with thy strength, to spell the downfall of Demonkind”.

ability.guild.hell-company.demon-shield.Name: Demon shield
ability.guild.hell-company.demon-shield.Effect: This grants +1 MAC and +1 SAC versus attacks from Demons.

ability.guild.hell-company.hand-of-truth.Name: Hand of Truth
ability.guild.hell-company.hand-of-truth.Effect: Hand of purity vs Demonkind. Death from casting is not permanent.

ability.guild.hell-company.heavens-shiel.Name: Heavens Shield
ability.guild.hell-company.heavens-shiel.Effect: 36 point mantic `Shield against the Dark` vs attacks from Demons.

ability.guild.hell-company.sight-through.Name: Sight Through Shadow
ability.guild.hell-company.sight-through.Effect: User can see through magical and spiritual darkness for 5 minutes, with the verbal “I call upon the powers of light and truth, let me walk unhindered through midnight's shadow”.

ability.guild.house-d-treal.ancient-fami.Name: Ancient Family Pacts
ability.guild.house-d-treal.ancient-fami.Effect: Once per day member of House D'treal can call on the House's extensive catalogue of pacts to announce a published ancient folk pact. They gain this pact for 5 minutes and if they do not have a level for pacts it is gained at 8 levels.

ability.guild.house-d-treal.pact-with-th.Name: Pact with the Dragons
ability.guild.house-d-treal.pact-with-th.Effect: The House has Pacts with all the Dragons and Drakes ; this grants the house member one rune of a pact with a Dragon or Drake (4 Levels) of their choice (chosen at the start of the day) as per the published spell. To cast the rune requires 30 seconds invoking the dragons power.

ability.guild.house-d-treal.power-behind.Name: Power behind the Throne
ability.guild.house-d-treal.power-behind.Effect: The D'treals have a great deal of clout in the Empire due to their elevated status and large numbers of Nobles, 1/ day acts as a Befriend versus any NPC Imperial Official as they realise that getting in with House D'treal may help their career.

ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.blessing.Name: Blessing of the Spring Dragon
ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.blessing.Effect: Blessed of the Spring Dragon now grants 6th level Spring Elf innates.

ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.draw-on-.Name: Draw on the Aurora Lights 1/day
ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.draw-on-.Effect: 1/day, takes 30 seconds preparation and acts as a standard 1st to 4th level spell of any elemental colour or a 1st to 3rd handbook miracle of own alignment.

ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.guided-b.Name: Guided by the Lights
ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.guided-b.Effect: Can always find home regardless of being lost (including in the Nacht or similar), and can take one other person with them. There must still be a way home.

ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.written-.Name: Written in the Stars
ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.written-.Effect: Gains a pre-dungeon lucky idea that may be prophetic in nature.

ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.written-.Name: Written in the Stars
ability.guild.ice-touched-souls.written-.Effect: Written in the Stars can now be used on dungeon (in addition to pre-dungeon) if a real world or ref-described star-lit sky appears, 1/day.

ability.guild.in-purity.blessing-of-puri.Name: Blessing of purity 1/day
ability.guild.in-purity.blessing-of-puri.Effect: Takes a 30 second prayer and works on either a living goodly individual (including self) or a dead body (of any alignment) and grants a fortified spirit as tables except the individual cannot choose to be raised as Undead even if they wish. If used on the living this lasts until the end of the dungeon. If used on a dead body it lasts until they are restored to life. Immunity to slayer may be applied by an unwilling dead body.

ability.guild.in-purity.infused-with-lig.Name: Infused with light
ability.guild.in-purity.infused-with-lig.Effect: Covers one weapon in a dose of holy water vs Undead for the next blow, does not need to be the users weapon.

ability.guild.in-purity.infused-with-lig.Name: Infused with Light
ability.guild.in-purity.infused-with-lig.Effect:
i: Covers one weapon in a dose of holy water vs Undead for the next blow, does not need to be the users weapon. 
ii: May use both innates at the same time to turn a weapon +0 spirit (goodly) vs Undead for 5 minutes.

ability.guild.in-purity.know-your-foe.Name: Know your Foe
ability.guild.in-purity.know-your-foe.Effect: Discern nature of Undead (as priestly discern). If this is already owned they gain a single use of a “know your foe” (as privileged ability) but only vs Undead.

ability.guild.in-purity.know-your-foe.2.Name: Know your Foe
ability.guild.in-purity.know-your-foe.2.Effect: If the basic tier “Know your foe” has been used vs a single Undead then gains contra mastery vs that Undead for the first 5 minutes of combat.

ability.guild.in-purity.know-your-foe.3.Name: Know your Foe
ability.guild.in-purity.know-your-foe.3.Effect: If the basic tier “Know your foe” has been used vs a single specific Undead gains the benefits of a know foe vs them, this also grants immunity to any Undead touch effects they may have.

ability.guild.in-purity.purity.Name: “Purity”
ability.guild.in-purity.purity.Effect: Holy Word 60ft radius halt Undead (as the miracle).

ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Name: Are you sure this is a good idea? 1/day
ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Effect: Gains a ref triggered lucky idea if a fellow guild member is about to do something that could have bad consequences.

ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Name: Knowledge of the Cults
ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Effect: If in Khannibad gains a major prayers worth of broad info if meets a new Cult, Sect, or group. This is public knowledge about their aims, and it might be nothing, and it is likely all guild members will gain the same information.

ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Name: Look Reast Trusts Me 1/day
ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Effect: For 5 minutes counts as being Neutral rather than evil for effects that target the guild member based on alignment (EG immune to repel evil, answers neutral to auric colour, is effected by soul lance).

ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Name: There's a short cut in this ward 1/day
ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Effect: Acts as a mantic evasion vs one warding. If already has similar (EG Ghost and the relevant immunities) then can use this innate on a fellow guild member at touch range.

ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Name: What did we all bring to the party
ability.guild.khaniabad-archaeologist-an.Effect: At the start of the day gains an item of a 1st to 3rd level handbook miracle, or 1st to 4th level standard spell. These are chosen by the ref and should be useful on the dungeon. The items can only be used a member of t he guild, who requires the relevant utilise skill. Additionally the item cannot be used by the person that arrives on dungeon with it .

ability.guild.khaniabhad.assess-rift.Name: Assess Rift
ability.guild.khaniabhad.assess-rift.Effect: Assess Rift: reveals where a rift/portal goes to, the rough consequences (if any) of using it, and other information at ref discretion.

ability.guild.khaniabhad.blood-sacrifice.Name: Blood Sacrifice 1/day
ability.guild.khaniabhad.blood-sacrifice.Effect: Blood Sacrifice 1/day: with 30 seconds ritual prep can cast one standard evil miracle to 4th, evocation to 4th, or elemental colour (not white) spell to 6th. Costs 12 TBLP in blood sacrifice.

ability.guild.khaniabhad.discern-cultist.Name: Discern Cultist
ability.guild.khaniabhad.discern-cultist.Effect: Discern Cultist: can recognise the signs of cult membership (physical info effect, 20ft range) and the general nature of the cult to which they belong.

ability.guild.khaniabhad.discern-cultist.Name: Discern Cultist now reveals the name of and general information about the cult if they have a presence in the city
ability.guild.khaniabhad.discern-cultist.Effect: Discern Cultist now reveals the name of and general information about the cult if they have a presence in the city.

ability.guild.khaniabhad.gains-basic-tie.Name: Gains basic tier Khaniabhad Archaeologist and Cartographers Society benefits
ability.guild.khaniabhad.gains-basic-tie.Effect: Gains basic tier Khaniabhad Archaeologist and Cartographers Society benefits.

ability.guild.khaniabhad.gains-hanger-on.Name: Gains Hanger On to Khaniabhad Archaeologist and Cartographers Society
ability.guild.khaniabhad.gains-hanger-on.Effect: Gains Hanger On to Khaniabhad Archaeologist and Cartographers Society.

ability.guild.khaniabhad.gains-immunity-.Name: Gains immunity to anything that seeks to compel or reveal the location of, or methods of finding, the city of Khaniabhad (including info effects)
ability.guild.khaniabhad.gains-immunity-.Effect: Gains immunity to anything that seeks to compel or reveal the location of, or methods of finding, the city of Khaniabhad (including info effects).

ability.guild.khaniabhad.is-now-demon-to.Name: Is now demon touched if not already
ability.guild.khaniabhad.is-now-demon-to.Effect: Is now demon touched if not already.

ability.guild.khaniabhad.knowledge-of-th.Name: Knowledge of the Cults 1/day
ability.guild.khaniabhad.knowledge-of-th.Effect: Knowledge of the Cults 1/day: physical major prayer about any cult-related activity.

ability.guild.khaniabhad.now-gains-inter.Name: Now gains intermediate tier Khaniabhad Archaeologist and Cartographers Society benefits
ability.guild.khaniabhad.now-gains-inter.Effect: Now gains intermediate tier Khaniabhad Archaeologist and Cartographers Society benefits.

ability.guild.khaniabhad.ritual-sacrific.Name: Ritual Sacrifice 1/hour
ability.guild.khaniabhad.ritual-sacrific.Effect: Ritual Sacrifice 1/hour: may ritually sacrifice a helpless flesh-and-blood target over 2 minutes. Acts as Strike Death Blow and grants immunity to dying effects; additionally cures 12/12 from the sacrifice.

ability.guild.knights-errant.empowered-b.Name: Empowered by the Forgotten knights ~ Allows the user to empower one weapon so it inflicts either magic (Red, Green, Blue, and brown at the same time) or spirit (Goodly) damage for 5 minutes. While active the weapon also inflicts Flaming, Electrical, Water, and Earth based damage (of the chosen power base). ~

ability.guild.knights-errant.never-act-w.Name: Never act without reason
ability.guild.knights-errant.never-act-w.Effect: Acts as per a discipline innate, but only lasts for 30 seconds.

ability.guild.knights-errant.shield-agai.Name: Shield against the Enemy
ability.guild.knights-errant.shield-agai.Effect: 1/day ~ Acts as a mantic Shield against the dark but only applies vs damage from Red, Blue, Green, Brown or evil spirit damage. ~

ability.guild.knights-errant.ward-agains.Name: Ward against the darks
ability.guild.knights-errant.ward-agains.Effect: 1/day ~ Grants the user ½ effect one of: fire, Electricity, green mana, or brown mana for 5 minutes .

ability.guild.knights-of-legend.chosen-o.Name: Chosen of Imrazil
ability.guild.knights-of-legend.chosen-o.Effect: Chosen of the Faithful [+2 DAC], but will affect any Knight of Legend, including elves etc. The DAC from this watching will not stack with any other chosen/watching/blessing. If this ability or similar blessing is already possessed then this ability instead grants +1 DAC, stacking with other KOTL guilds but no other.

ability.guild.knights-of-legend.for-the-.Name: ‘For the Land'
ability.guild.knights-of-legend.for-the-.Effect: Determination (taking 6 TBLP from any stopping effect suffered but not the stopping effect)

ability.guild.knights-of-legend.for-the-.Name: ‘For the Land'
ability.guild.knights-of-legend.for-the-.Effect:
Choose one on use: 
i: Determination (taking 6 TBLP from any stopping effect suffered but not the stopping effect)
ii: Mobility, if used in this way costs 12tblp per use.

ability.guild.knights-of-legend.for-the-.Name: ‘For the Land'
ability.guild.knights-of-legend.for-the-.Effect:
Choose one on use: 
i: Determination (taking 6 TBLP from any stopping effect suffered but not the stopping effect)
ii: Mobility, if used in this way costs 12tblp per use.
 iii: Resist listed Domination effects, however user suffers 18tblp per use

ability.guild.knights-of-legend.inspirat.Name: Inspiration
ability.guild.knights-of-legend.inspirat.Effect: Seek Inspiration as per a Lucky Idea. This takes 10 seconds to activate.

ability.guild.knights-of-legend.resistan.Name: Resistance to Avenging Spirit
ability.guild.knights-of-legend.resistan.Effect: As per the tables resistance – should this already be possessed it can used to grant Immunity to Dying Effects 1/day as per the tables resistance.

ability.guild.knights-of-legend.resolute.Name: Resolute
ability.guild.knights-of-legend.resolute.Effect: Grants +1 level of resistance to all effects

ability.guild.knights-of-the-land.fearle.Name: Fearless
ability.guild.knights-of-the-land.fearle.Effect: Grants Immunity to fear as per tables.

ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Name: Fire of the phoenix
ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Effect:
Choose one:
i: Mantic Summon Salamander Child 
ii: Mantic Talk to Salamander
iii: Mantic sword of power (gaining utilise goodly spirit item for this ability). 
If unused then upon death can be triggered acting as a Mantic (flaming) Avenging spirit on the Knights of the risen Phoenix members' slayer.

ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Name: Fires of the Phoenix
ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Effect: Mantic (Red/Goodly) fire blade, Knights of the risen Phoenix that are not evil gain utilise good spirit item for this.

ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Name: Fires of the Phoenix
ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Effect:
Choose one:
i: Mantic Summon Salamander Child 
ii: Mantic Talk to Salamander
iii: Mantic sword of power (gaining utilise goodly spirit item for this ability).

ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Name: Heart of the Fire
ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Effect: 1st time a day needed gains live to minus 6 TBLP that cannot be inflicted by fire and while in this live to minus regens 1/1 to the most injured location per 30 seconds, or until out of the live to.

ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Name: Heart of the Fire
ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Effect: When triggered the live to minus is empowered so that for the first minute of it it can only be inflicted by evil spirits, cold, or water based attacks.

ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Name: Life of the phoenix
ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Effect: With 30 seconds meditation benefits as per a regeneration Elixir on self, but is not a flesh and blood effect, rather mantic (Gold/Red/Good spirit).

ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Name: Life of the Phoenix
ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Effect:
Choose one: 
i: With 30 seconds meditation benefits as per a regeneration Elixir on self or other, but is mantic (Gold/Red/Good spirit), not flesh and blood. 
ii: Alternatively if 2 minutes of calm meditation is used it instead cures 36/36.

ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Name: Life of the phoenix
ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Effect:
Choose one:
i: Mantic Summon Salamander Child 
ii: Mantic Talk to Salamander
iii: Mantic sword of power (gaining utilise goodly spirit item for this ability)
iii: Mantic Life Overwhelms (as Jade spell) but is red/gold/good spirit in nature. Verbal: `The Phoenix overwhelms!`

ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Name: Shield of fire
ability.guild.knights-of-the-risen-phoen.Effect:
1st time a day needed gains live to minus 6 TBLP that cannot be inflicted by fire and while in this live to minus regens 1/1 to the most injured location per 30 seconds, or until out of the live to. 
If the user already has table 3 Immunity to Fire then when used it grants either: 
i: Complete immunity to fire for 5 minutes
ii: Resilience (as per Pasha status) equal to the users table vs fire.

ability.guild.lo-thi.bear-s-skill.Name: Bear's Skill
ability.guild.lo-thi.bear-s-skill.Effect: Gains either Tracking, Perception or Survival as per Ranger

ability.guild.lo-thi.owl-s-wisdom.2.Name: Owl's Wisdom
ability.guild.lo-thi.owl-s-wisdom.2.Effect: Owl's Wisdom is now a full major prayer.

ability.guild.lo-thi.totemic-boon.Name: Totemic Boon
ability.guild.lo-thi.totemic-boon.Effect: Choose a Primal Soul Predator/Prey minor talent.

ability.guild.lo-thi.totemic-boon.2.Name: Totemic Boon
ability.guild.lo-thi.totemic-boon.2.Effect: Totemic Boon can now either grant a Minor and Medium talent, or just a Major talent.

ability.guild.lo-thi.totemic-markings.Name: Totemic Markings
ability.guild.lo-thi.totemic-markings.Effect: If wearing tribal markings (white, red and black makeup), gains +1 MAC and +1 SAC.

ability.guild.lo-thi.totemic-markings.2.Name: Totemic Markings
ability.guild.lo-thi.totemic-markings.2.Effect: Totemic Markings now also grant +6/2 guild life.

ability.guild.lost-and-found.found-1-day.Name: Found 1/day
ability.guild.lost-and-found.found-1-day.Effect: 1/day may find a single use item of a standard spell up to 4th level or standard miracle up to 3rd level. They can give this item to anyone with the appropriate utilise, so it is not restricted by the finder's alignment or colours.

ability.guild.lost-and-found.found-2.Name: Found
ability.guild.lost-and-found.found-2.Effect: Gains a second Found innate, and Found can now be standard spells up to 6th level, and miracles up to 4th level.

ability.guild.lost-and-found.kin.Name: Kin
ability.guild.lost-and-found.kin.Effect: All guild members gain Kin with each other on adventure.

ability.guild.lost-and-found.kin-true-ki.Name: Kin
ability.guild.lost-and-found.kin-true-ki.Effect: Kin from basic tier becomes True Kin.

ability.guild.lost-and-found.lost.Name: Lost
ability.guild.lost-and-found.lost.Effect: If out of real world sight for 5 minutes, is considered to have safely left the adventure and returned to Sweethaven (cf Loner).

ability.guild.lost-and-found.lost-2.Name: Lost
ability.guild.lost-and-found.lost-2.Effect: Gains a second Lost innate, and Lost can now be used as a Pass Unknown.

ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.brothers-to.Name: Brothers Together
ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.brothers-to.Effect: Brothers Together: Gains +3/1 status life per KOTL (not self) on dungeon, to a max of 6/2 life.

ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.brothers-to.Name: Brothers Together can now grant up to 12/4 life
ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.brothers-to.Effect: Brothers Together can now grant up to 12/4 life.

ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.can-join-kn.Name: Can join Knights of the Land and gain benefits from the guild
ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.can-join-kn.Effect: Can join Knights of the Land and gain benefits from the guild. Cannot buy knight status/similar.

ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.defend-the-.Name: Defend the Land 1/day
ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.defend-the-.Effect: Defend the Land 1/day: gains Stand and Die (as Soldier tradition) but locations continue to function until severed. Ends if the Kallah leaves combat.

ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.while-using.Name: While using Defend the Land gains Determination and immunity to domination effects
ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.while-using.Effect: While using Defend the Land gains Determination and immunity to domination effects.

ability.guild.natural-trust.chosen-famil.Name: Chosen Familiar
ability.guild.natural-trust.chosen-famil.Effect:
Attune to an animal, requires a symbol of the creature, a piece of the creature, or incorporate that type of creatures appearance into a worn makeup design. Gain one of: 
Jump 1/day, 
Assisted Climb 1/day, 
Sniff skill, 
+1 DAC 
+1 innate PAC 
 choice should be relevant to the creature chosen.

ability.guild.natural-trust.circle-of-dr.Name: Circle of Druids
ability.guild.natural-trust.circle-of-dr.Effect: For each guild member on the adventure, gains +1EP

ability.guild.natural-trust.hand-of-bani.Name: Hand of Banishment
ability.guild.natural-trust.hand-of-bani.Effect: as post 8th druid tables). When using this innate can reduce the life suffered by sacrificing levels of resistance for 1 hour. Each level reduces the life by 5.

ability.guild.natural-trust.master-of-me.Name: Master of Memories
ability.guild.natural-trust.master-of-me.Effect: Objects under Life's Memories from basic tier (or Toughened Hide if intermediate tier upgrade is used) are now considered master status.

ability.guild.obsidian-cabal.draw-on-the.Name: Draw on the Inner Evil
ability.guild.obsidian-cabal.draw-on-the.Effect:
Acts as a True Believer for any Evil religion, but can only be used for evil miracles.
Alternatively it may be used to cast a standard Black or Onyx spell with 30 seconds prep.

ability.guild.obsidian-cabal.heart-of-ev.Name: Heart of Evil
ability.guild.obsidian-cabal.heart-of-ev.Effect:
Members cannot be forced to attack Obsidian Cabal members, e.g. spiritually mastered with orders to kill someone. Additionally when raging they are able to identify fellow Obsidian Cabal members and do not have to attack them. None of this means they can't attack them, just they don't have to.
 If Obsidian Cabal members have a restriction that would require them to attack other members it does not apply ( e.g. a Silverfolk and a non -silverfolk neuronicist).

ability.guild.obsidian-cabal.kin-with-ot.Name: Kin with Obsidian Cabal members on dungeon
Kin with other Obsidian Cabal members on dungeon
ability.guild.obsidian-cabal.kin-with-ot.Effect: True Kin with other Obsidian Cabal members on dungeon

ability.guild.obsidian-cabal.strength-of.Name: Strength of Evil
ability.guild.obsidian-cabal.strength-of.Effect: Gains +3/1 life if on dungeon with another Obsidian Cabal member.

ability.guild.obsidian-cabal.strength-of.Name: Strength of Evil
