ability.guild.the-hovel.dreams-of-tomorr.Name: Dreams of tomorrow
ability.guild.the-hovel.dreams-of-tomorr.Effect: Gains a pre -dungeon lucky idea about the day ahead in a visionary style. If multiple members of the guild are on dungeon they all gain the same dream but more information is gained.

ability.guild.the-hovel.familiar.Effect: May select a suitable witches familiar and gains neutrality to natural animals of that type. Once chosen cannot be changed, so should be noted on the card .

ability.guild.the-hovel.familiar-speech.Name: Familiar Speech
ability.guild.the-hovel.familiar-speech.Effect: May now talk to animals of their familiar type as per Talk to Animal evocation.

ability.guild.the-hovel.familiars-knowle.Effect: Acts as a spiritual major prayer about witchcraft or something relevant to your familiar ( so a familiar of a Cobra could be about poison).

ability.guild.the-hovel.hovels-strength.Name: Hovels Strength
ability.guild.the-hovel.hovels-strength.Effect: Gains + 1 Spirit per member of the hovel on dungeon.

ability.guild.the-hovel.power-meld-of-th.Effect: If casting power meld on a fellow member of the hovel the caster/recipient levels and alignment no longer matter. Additionally the number of spirits taken can be determined at the time of casting.

ability.guild.the-hovel.witch-s-alignmen.Name: Witch's Alignment
ability.guild.the-hovel.witch-s-alignmen.Effect: When casting a bless or curse can choose to count as being goodly, neutral, or evil.

ability.guild.the-hovel.witches-broom.Effect: 1/day if has a suitable Witches Broom phys rep gains a spiritual Walk on Air, and can carry up to one person. Cannot engage in melee combat while using this or it ends (probably with the witch falling off, falling only to be saved by the broom just before hitting the ground). Lasts 5 minutes or this can also be cast for 3 spirits.

ability.guild.the-hovel.wonderous-talent.Name: Wonderous Talent

They do not require set up components, and take 2 of the relevant make slot per dose made.

ability.guild.the-order-of-mercenaries.m.Effect: If has used mercenary problems then for every minute still trying to solve the problem gains an extra major prayer until the problem is solved, or it’s tavern time.

ability.guild.the-order-of-mercenaries.s.Name: Strength in numbers
ability.guild.the-order-of-mercenaries.s.Effect: Gains + 1 DAC if on dungeon with another guild member who is claiming guild benefits.

ability.guild.the-order-of-mercenaries.s.Name: Strength in Numbers
ability.guild.the-order-of-mercenaries.s.Effect: Gains One of the following per other guild member claiming guild benefits on dungeon. Can only take each option once: +1 DAC, + 1 PAC, + 1 MAC, + 1 SAC. The Mercenary Way – Guild Status Junior Mercenary - Stage one: Cost 50 Table 1

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.adver.Name: Adversity
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.adver.Effect: Gains +3/1 temp life every time an ally flees (i.e. leaves the dungeon) or is incapacitated in combat. Once an ally has fled from combat the character cannot then gain any additional life from them through use of this ability, for the remainder of the day. This life lasts until end of combat.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.adver.Name: Adversity
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.adver.Effect: When fighting an opponent who is inflicting a greater damage grade than the Talthar worshiper, they gain +1 Damage Grade and +1 Max Damage versus that opponent.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.bless.Name: Blessed of Talthar
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.bless.Effect: If a Paladin able to enter the Priest Bracket then their Paladinic Bless increases by 1.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.diplo.Name: Diplomacy
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.diplo.Effect: Requires the user to speak in a peaceful and calming manner for 30 seconds. Acts in a manner similar to the miracle Befriend Spirit, except that all those present when used, who hear the casting, are affected. Targets remain befriended for 5 minutes or until any violence occurs, whichever comes first. This will only affect targets with 8th level resistance to spirits or lower, and even then Immunity to Befriend applies.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.diplo.Name: Diplomacy
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.diplo.Effect: Mass Pacification (as Pacification), but is Spiritual in nature and effects all within 20’ of the caster.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.diplo.Name: Diplomacy
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.diplo.Effect: Requires the user to speak in a peaceful and calming manner for 30 seconds (additional 1 level, cumulative for every 10 seconds spent speaking). Acts in a manner similar to the miracle Befriend Spirit, except that all those present when used, who hear the casting, are affected. Targets remain befriended for 5 minutes or until any violence occurs, whichever comes first. This will only affect targets with 8th level resistance to spirits or lower, and even then Immunity to Befriend applies.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.hope-.Name: Hope Eternal
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.hope-.Effect: Grants complete immunity to any emotional effect or attack that would cause the Talthar member to despair or lose hope in any fashion.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.justi.Name: Justice
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.justi.Effect: 20ft range. May be used upon anyone who has just cast an evil miracle {within the last 30 seconds}. Target suffers 3 TBLP (1 HTK) for each spirit point of the evil miracle (e.g. someone who has just cast a Touch of Death would suffer 30 TBLP). Imm. to Holy Words applies. SAC applies to this damage at 1 for 1.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.justi.Name: Justice
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.justi.Effect: Touch range. May be used upon a goodly target, who is suffering from a published evil spiritual effect, provided the caster of that effect is within 20’ of their victim. The effect is removed from the target and instead affects the person who cast it. If the caster of the evil effect is immune to it, or immune to Holy words, this ability has no effect and the original victim still suffers from the effect.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.justi.Name: Justice
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.justi.Effect: When using a Justice holy word, the victim is now freed of the evil spiritual effect even if the caster is immune to it but not if the caster is immune to Holy Words. Gains an additional Holy Word “Justice!” innate.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.renew.Name: Renewal
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.renew.Effect:
Choose one:
i: if Restored to life instead of coming back on last 7/1 will come back totally healed of all wounds.
ii: if casting a Restore to life using their own power, not from scrolls or items (unless made by self) target will come back Totally Healed

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.renew.Name: Renewal
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.renew.Effect: 1 in every 6pts of spiritual healing received from a Talthar Priest / Paladin will heal damage that is otherwise incurable or permanent. (But only damage suffered on that event).

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.seren.Name: Serenity
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.seren.Effect: +1 Meditation Rate, abilities post triple rate can use this as a pre-requisite

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.seren.Name: Serenity
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.seren.Effect: For 1 TBLP, touch acts to calm a ravaged spirit for as long as the priest remains in contact with the target: Reduces the severity of a Spasm (or similar effect) to the stage where a victim may lay still or prevents the effects of an insanity which would cause disruptive behaviour, e.g. not a cataleptic state

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.seren.Name: Serenity
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.seren.Effect: Regains 1 spirit every 15 minutes the character remains “serene” regardless of meditation rate. This is broken if the character suffers harm, casts, attacks, moves faster than a slow walk, or uses any other ability that requires concentration.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.subtl.Name: Subtlety
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.subtl.Effect: White Spell Invisibility but only hides the user from Spirit Sight (Active & Passive) and goes down under the same conditions

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.subtl.Name: Subtlety
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.subtl.Effect: now grants Immunity to Info Spirits / spiritual discerns that do not originate from a Worshipper of Talthar (Priest / Paladin / Devout Believer).

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.subtl.Name: Subtlety
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.subtl.Effect: Immunity to Informational Spells now grants Immunity to info Magic that does not originate from a Worshipper of Talthar (Priest / Paladin / Devout Believer). Gains an additional Hidden From Sight innate.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.unity.Name: Unity
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.unity.Effect: Those touching this character gain `Hope Eternal`

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.unity.Name: Unity
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.unity.Effect: Requires 30 seconds audible and appropriate prayer (must be heard by all allies who are to be affected). For every 3 allies within 20’, all allies within 20’ gain +3/1 (max +9/3) life for the duration of the next combat that occurs. This ability counts & benefits only those allies who spend the entire 30 seconds of casting time within the 20’ radius.

ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.unity.Name: Unity
ability.guild.the-rings-of-talthar.unity.Effect: Anyone meditating within 20’ of the point of casting does so at +1 additional meditation rate. This ability lasts as long as the caster meditates and remains within the area of effect.

ability.guild.the-rosarian-faith.legionn.Name: Legionnaire
ability.guild.the-rosarian-faith.legionn.Effect: Any Rosarian (Lay Believer / True Believer / Priest) may gain the Legionnaire warrior tendency on T1 for 20 points. New Rosarian characters may battleboard this from 1st level, but it must be the first post-8th ability bought. Rosarians buying this lose their political guild slot.

ability.guild.the-rosarian-faith.morning.Name: Morning Mass
ability.guild.the-rosarian-faith.morning.Effect: Any Rosarian starts the day with an 18 point spirit shield, whose duration does not start until the first time it is needed (cf Spiritual Warden).

ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.a-big.Name: A Big to your Little
ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.a-big.Effect: If another guild member takes part in the Sorcerer's Ritual Arts, then the time is reduced by 50%.

ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.a-lit.Name: A Little to your Big
ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.a-lit.Effect: Basic Tier A Big to your Little now works if alone.

ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.i-can.Name: I can rock and roll from, like, one to three
ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.i-can.Effect: Can now use Ritual Arts on any published sorcorial spell.

ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.let-u.Name: Let us gingerly touch our tips
ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.let-u.Effect: Can now channel dispels through a magical focus or magical weapon, counting as touch range.

ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.lets-.Name: Let's Do This, We Shall 1/day
ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.lets-.Effect: 1/day may cast a published sorcorial glyph as any published colour.

ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.rock-.Name: Rock and Roll all night, and part of every day
ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.rock-.Effect: When using Sorcorial Arts, may benefit from both the mana reduction and the life reduction.

ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.rock-.Name: Rock and Roll all night, and Party every day
ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.rock-.Effect: Can now use Ritual Arts on any spell known (doesn't stack with expertise).

ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.rub-1.Name: Rub 1/day
ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.rub-1.Effect: Gains Empower Rune 1/day: a single published blade rune lasts until triggered or when Apollo lifts his skirt (sunrise). The mana spent can be regained.

ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.to-sl.Name: To sleep, perchance to dream
ability.guild.the-sorcerers-circle.to-sl.Effect: May choose the tables ability Master or Apprentice to a NPC Xanthian (in a cloak made by their mum), or choose neither and gain 6 casting stamina.

ability.guild.the-swarm.feed-on-the-plag.Name: Feed on the Plague 1/day
ability.guild.the-swarm.feed-on-the-plag.Effect: If struck by a disease then can feed on it acting as a 12/12 cure of the same power base as the disease.

ability.guild.the-swarm.feed-on-the-plag.Name: Feed on the Plague
ability.guild.the-swarm.feed-on-the-plag.Effect: Gains a second Feed on the Plague innate, and may instead use it to cure a disease on another target.

ability.guild.the-swarm.feed-on-the-plag.Name: Feed on the Plague
ability.guild.the-swarm.feed-on-the-plag.Effect: Gains a third Feed on the Plague innate.

ability.guild.the-swarm.rat-kings-enrune.Name: Rat King's Enrunement 1/day
ability.guild.the-swarm.rat-kings-enrune.Effect: Requires a visible rune drawn on skin. 1/day can be used to gain either +2 MAC, +2 SAC, or 3 points off weapons for 5 minutes.

ability.guild.the-swarm.rat-kings-enrune.Name: Rat King's Enrunement
ability.guild.the-swarm.rat-kings-enrune.Effect: Rat King's Enrunement now grants +2 MAC, +2 SAC, and 3 points off weapons for 5 minutes when triggered.

ability.guild.the-swarm.scurry-1-day.Name: Scurry 1/day
ability.guild.the-swarm.scurry-1-day.Effect: Acts as per a physical lightstep.

ability.guild.the-swarm.scurry-and-sneak.Name: Scurry and Sneaky Rat
ability.guild.the-swarm.scurry-and-sneak.Effect: Can now use Scurry and Sneaky Rat at the same time.

ability.guild.the-swarm.sneaky-rat-1-day.Name: Sneaky rat 1/day
ability.guild.the-swarm.sneaky-rat-1-day.Effect: Acts in a similar manner to Evasion, but works regardless of the wards power base.

ability.guild.the-swarm.trap-wary-for-sc.Name: Trap Wary for Scurry Innates
ability.guild.the-swarm.trap-wary-for-sc.Effect: Gains Trap Wary (as scout) for the purposes of guild Scurry innates. If already owned, this becomes Enhanced Trap Wary for guild Scurry innates.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.ed.Name: Educated individual
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.ed.Effect: Gains Read Languages for Arcadd, if already owned gains a major prayer about Arcadd, poetry, or relevant Amlesian writings.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.pe.Name: Petals of Life
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.pe.Effect: Gains live to minus 1 per member of the guild on dungeon

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.pe.Name: Petals of Life
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.pe.Effect: will always grant a minimum of 6 points of live to minus, and now grants 2 points of live to minus per White Lotus member.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.pe.Name: Petals of Life
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.pe.Effect: will always grant a minimum of 6 points of live to minus, and now grants 2 points of live to minus per White Lotus member and live to minus applies to locations

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.so.Name: Song for the dead
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.so.Effect: If spends the ritual time for a resurrection in silent prayer then the person being restored to life returns fully healed, rather than having to wait for 5 minutes. Does not need to be the one casting the resurrection, just “participating”.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.so.Name: Song for the dead
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.so.Effect:
Choose one:
i: If spends the ritual time for a resurrection in silent prayer then the person being restored to life returns fully healed, rather than having to wait for 5 minutes. Does not need to be the one casting the resurrection, just “participating”
ii: Remove a slayer effect and/or the taint of undeath from the person being returned to life.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.so.Name: Song for the dead
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.so.Effect:
Choose one:
i: If spends the ritual time for a resurrection in silent prayer then the person being restored to life returns fully healed, rather than having to wait for 5 minutes. Does not need to be the one casting the resurrection, just “participating”
ii: Remove a slayer effect and/or the taint of undeath from the person being returned to life
iii:  can instead be used to reduce the ritual prep of the restore life to 1 minute, but the individual being restored to life will not gain the benefits a total heal until after resting for 5 minutes.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.th.Name: The Fates decide
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.th.Effect: is immune to any random acts of misfortune or similar. This could include “one person in the party is randomly ritual struck ” - it would never be a White Lotus member unless there are only White Lotus members present. This is refs discretion and the spirit should be followed. This also grants fated hero, and if already owned undecided destiny.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.to.Name: To defend with honour
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.to.Effect: If a fellow Amlesian or White Lotus member has been incapacitated/rendered helpless this innate may be used granting +12/4 temp life and one of (chosen when the innate is used): A War Cry, a discipline or a cold rage. The benefits last for 5 minutes and if the innate is not used it is lost.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.to.Name: To Defend with honour
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.to.Effect: +12/4 temp life and one of (chosen when the innate is used): A War Cry, a discipline or a cold rage. The benefits last for 5 minutes and if the innate is not used it is lost.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.un.Name: Unity of the Empire
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.un.Effect: with the guild masters permission gains “Hanger On” to any one Amlesian Clan for the duration of a dungeon, allowing them to count as a member of the guild for calculating guild numbers.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.wi.Name: Will of the Empire
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.wi.Effect: Retroactive, grants +1 level of resistance; does not stack with levels of resistance gained from other guild benefits.

ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.wi.Name: Will of the Empire
ability.guild.the-white-lotus-society.wi.Effect: Applies all day: Retroactive, grants +1 level of resistance; does not stack with levels of resistance gained from other guild benefits.

ability.guild.the-white-wind.the-white-r.Name: The White Ribbon
ability.guild.the-white-wind.the-white-r.Effect: Requires a white ribbon with the guild motto on it in red spirit runes to use. 1/day with 30 seconds prep acts as either a mantic slayer or a mantic fire blade .

ability.guild.the-white-wind.white-ribbo.Name: White Ribbon: Final Disruption
ability.guild.the-white-wind.white-ribbo.Effect: If a person has a White Ribbon innate left and is slain they can choose to unleash one (max) as a mantic disruption dying effect (goodly spirit, red mana). This uses the innate.

ability.guild.the-white-wind.white-ribbo.Name: White Ribbon: Mantic Heal
ability.guild.the-white-wind.white-ribbo.Effect: Can use 2 White Ribbon innates (taking one minute prep total) to act as a mantic heal (white/red/good spirit).

ability.guild.the-white-wind.white-ribbo.Name: White Ribbon: Protection vs Evil
ability.guild.the-white-wind.white-ribbo.Effect: Can use a White Ribbon innate to turn a Protection vs Evil mantic at the point it is cast.

ability.guild.the-white-wind.white-ribbo.Name: White Ribbon: Redemption
ability.guild.the-white-wind.white-ribbo.Effect: If a White Ribbon is used to slayer an evil person on dungeon then the target can choose to have their alignment changed to goodly instead of being slayered. A person redeemed in this way will permanently die if they ever cease to be goodly.

ability.guild.thimon.absorb-disease-1-da.Name: Absorb Disease 1/day
ability.guild.thimon.absorb-disease-1-da.Effect: Absorb Disease 1/day: Allows the Kallah to draw a disease from an individual, acting as per a druidic Cure Disease. This grants the Kallah +6/2 life for the next hour.

ability.guild.thimon.gain-immunity-to-ba.Name: Gain immunity to baneful diseases, as per a ratfolk
ability.guild.thimon.gain-immunity-to-ba.Effect: Gain immunity to baneful diseases, as per a ratfolk.

ability.guild.thimon.gains-tell-disease-.Name: Gains Tell Disease, as druid
ability.guild.thimon.gains-tell-disease-.Effect: Gains Tell Disease, as druid. Also gains a lucky idea about the disease if it is not a published disease.

ability.guild.thimon.instead-of-gaining-.Name: Instead of gaining life from an absorb disease the Kallah can gain an innate of the disease absorbed that can be used within the next hour
ability.guild.thimon.instead-of-gaining-.Effect: Instead of gaining life from an absorb disease the Kallah can gain an innate of the disease absorbed that can be used within the next hour.

ability.guild.thimon.instead-of-gaining-.Name: Instead of gaining life, or an innate disease, from using an absorb disease can choose to gain regen as Troll (heals spirit and fire) for the next hour
ability.guild.thimon.instead-of-gaining-.Effect: Instead of gaining life, or an innate disease, from using an absorb disease can choose to gain regen as Troll (heals spirit and fire) for the next hour. This does not stack with other regen.

ability.guild.thimon.regains-an-innate-a.Name: Regains an innate Absorb Disease every hour
ability.guild.thimon.regains-an-innate-a.Effect: Regains an innate Absorb Disease every hour.

ability.guild.top-secret.concealed-1-day.Name: Concealed
ability.guild.top-secret.concealed-1-day.Effect: Enhance a stealth so that it grants immunity to all forms of sights. Does not work with Greater stealth.

ability.guild.top-secret.ear-to-the-grou.Name: Ear to the ground
ability.guild.top-secret.ear-to-the-grou.Effect: Acts a pre -dungeon major prayer about useful things to know, this could be equipment to have, skills to know, or anything else relevant.

ability.guild.top-secret.evade-2-day.Name: Evade 2/day
ability.guild.top-secret.evade-2-day.Effect: Grants combat wary (which must be owned) vs one blow (even if used in the last 5 minutes), must be declared within 2 seconds of the blow.

ability.guild.top-secret.last-nights-les.Name: Last nights lessons
ability.guild.top-secret.last-nights-les.Effect: Gains a standard scout skill not owned already, or + 1 level in a skill owned (on dungeon only) to a max of 12.

ability.guild.top-secret.retreat.Name: Retreat
ability.guild.top-secret.retreat.Effect: 1/day acts as a Jump away from a foe. Combat wary applies to all blows taken during the jump.

ability.guild.totemic-guardians.a-tribe-.Name: A Tribe's a Tribe
ability.guild.totemic-guardians.a-tribe-.Effect:
If a Totemic Guardians' Shaman is not on dungeon may choose to give another Shaman that is present spirits as if a member of their tribe.
 If a guild members own Witchdoctor is not on dungeon may choose to give another Witchdoctor that is present mana as if a member of their tribe.

ability.guild.totemic-guardians.not-goin.Name: Not going down
ability.guild.totemic-guardians.not-goin.Effect: If a member of the Totemic Guardians is killed can choose to gain the benefits of a stand and die vs the person that killed them.

ability.guild.totemic-guardians.strength.Name: Strength of the Totems
ability.guild.totemic-guardians.strength.Effect: Physical mark of the totems, but with all members of Totemic Guardians counting as members of the tribe for the benefits. Requires 30 seconds “Bigging Up” the person getting it.

ability.guild.totemic-guardians.totems-w.Name: Totems Watching
ability.guild.totemic-guardians.totems-w.Effect: Choose a Primal Soul Predator/Prey minor talent (as per Primal Soul choice sets).

ability.guild.totemic-guardians.totems-w.Name: Totems Watching
ability.guild.totemic-guardians.totems-w.Effect: Choose a Primal Soul Predator/Prey medium talent (as per Primal Soul choice sets).

ability.guild.totemic-guardians.tribal-i.Name: Tribal Influence
ability.guild.totemic-guardians.tribal-i.Effect: When a Shaman or Witch Doctor casts a published Miracle or Spell that normally effects their own tribe it may instead be cast to benefit their own tribe and all members of the Totemic Guardians, with all members of the Totemic Guardians counting towards its effect.

ability.guild.wahadamune.aid-of-the-clan.Name: Aid of the Clan
ability.guild.wahadamune.aid-of-the-clan.Effect:
At the start of the day can choose to gain the aid of one of the Ishmaic Clans as follows: 
o Galahbhad – Armour is tinkered by the clans armourers, granting immunity to accuracy.
o Buladajn – Venoms Whisper Gains Immunity to poison for 5 minutes. 
o Benhai – Gains an innate Jump that also grants the benefits of Trap wary 
o Salahmen – 1/day gains double level of resistance vs magic for 5 minutes 
o Harazaen – Consume the Curse 1/day – Grants immunity to one Curse, must be used within 2 seconds of the curse being suffered 
o Rain – Draw on the winds 1/day Takes 30 seconds prep and can act as a standard Elemental spell up to 4th level.

ability.guild.wahadamune.discern-enemy-o.Name: Discern Enemy of the Confederacy
ability.guild.wahadamune.discern-enemy-o.Effect: 20ft range physical/magical info FX that discerns if a member is an enemy of the Confederacy and a 3 word reason why.

ability.guild.wahadamune.invoke-the-wind.Name: Invoke the Winds Protection
ability.guild.wahadamune.invoke-the-wind.Effect: Grants the user the next level of the “Winds”. If the 1st Wind is owned then this grants immunity to magic for 5 minutes.

ability.guild.wahadamune.legend-of-the-s.Name: Legend of the Sands
ability.guild.wahadamune.legend-of-the-s.Effect: Grants stacking Live to Minus 6 the first time it is needed. Whilst in this LTM, gains Recuperate and can trigger One Last Effort (both as the Survivor multiclass).

ability.guild.who-knows.knowledge-of-the.Name: Knowledge of the Masses
ability.guild.who-knows.knowledge-of-the.Effect: Gains 6 power of innates chosen at the start of the day. These can be standard silver spells or standard communications miracles.

ability.guild.who-knows.knowledge-of-the.Name: Knowledge of the Masses
ability.guild.who-knows.knowledge-of-the.Effect: Knowledge of the Masses now grants 12 power of innates, but to a maximum of 6th level.

ability.guild.who-knows.scholars-insight.Name: Scholar's Insight
ability.guild.who-knows.scholars-insight.Effect: If already had Read Languages (not from this guild), gains a lucky idea on each piece of text studied in another language they can actually read (crib sheet is fine) after 5 minutes translating.

ability.guild.who-knows.seeking-knowledg.Name: Seeking Knowledge
ability.guild.who-knows.seeking-knowledg.Effect: Gains one of Rec Spirit, Rec Mana, Rec Neuronics or Rec Earthpower.

ability.guild.who-knows.seeking-knowledg.Name: Seeking Knowledge
ability.guild.who-knows.seeking-knowledg.Effect: Seeking Knowledge now grants a second choice.

ability.guild.yeomen-of-the-empire.kin.Name: Kin
ability.guild.yeomen-of-the-empire.kin.Effect: to all other Yeoman on dungeon.

ability.guild.yeomen-of-the-empire.memor.Name: Memories of the Yeoman
ability.guild.yeomen-of-the-empire.memor.Effect: With 30 seconds concentration acts as a major prayer about matters previous Yeoman may have known. This includes rituals, ancient foes, lost treasures etc. It should be a broad interpretation of what can be covered, but it could be slightly cryptic or incomplete.

ability.guild.yeomen-of-the-empire.stren.Name: Strength of the yeoman
ability.guild.yeomen-of-the-empire.stren.Effect: Gain +3/1 life per yeoman on dungeon, to a max of +6/2.

ability.guild.council-of-jade.councils-h.Name: The Councils Honour
ability.guild.council-of-jade.councils-h.Effect: Members cannot be supernatural forced to attack each other. Additionally while raging/similar they can identify fellow Council members and do not need to attack them.

ability.guild.council-of-jade.families-p.Name: The families provide
ability.guild.council-of-jade.families-p.Effect: Members are well equipped with either a suit of armour (this may be master crafted) of their choosing or a single apprentice crafted weapon. If lost a new one can be regained for the next dungeon.

ability.guild.council-of-jade.blessing-o.Name: Blessing of the Fates
ability.guild.council-of-jade.blessing-o.Effect: The first time a day it is needed the members gain a kick in live to minus 12 that stacks with other live to minus.

ability.guild.council-of-jade.teachings-.Name: The Teachings of the Crane
ability.guild.council-of-jade.teachings-.Effect: Members may call upon the family craftsmen and start with one of the following items: +6/2 item life, MAC 1, SAC 1. These require a phys rep and act as normal dungeon temp items. When higher tiers are gained an individual may choose this benefit multiple times for different items.

ability.guild.council-of-jade.honour-of-.Name: The Honour of Jade
ability.guild.council-of-jade.honour-of-.Effect: The member cannot be supernaturally forced to break the laws and codes of the Jade Empire or the council.

ability.guild.council-of-jade.lion-s-roa.Name: The Lions Roar
ability.guild.council-of-jade.lion-s-roa.Effect: Acts as per the Wolfs Howl evocation, but is physical not in EP in source.

ability.guild.council-of-jade.the-family.Name: The Family Honours
ability.guild.council-of-jade.the-family.Effect: The member may now chose to be well equipped with armour and an apprentice crafted weapon as the basic tier, or a suit of apprentice crafted armour, or a journeyman crafted weapon.

ability.guild.council-of-jade.discern-di.Name: Dishonoured reveal themselves
ability.guild.council-of-jade.discern-di.Effect: Acts as a Mantic discern that reveals individuals that are Ostracised/enemies of the Jade Empire. Members of the Guild cannot be immune to this discern.

ability.guild.knights-errant.Standing-ag.Name: Standing against the darks
ability.guild.knights-errant.Standing-ag.Effect: Members gain either + 1 MAC vs Red/Blue/Green/Brown magic or + 1 SAC vs Evil.

ability.guild.knights-errant.Standing-ag.Name: Standing against the darks
ability.guild.knights-errant.Standing-ag.Effect: Standing against the darks can now grants MAC and SAC still as above.

ability.guild.bildteve.reveal-undead-nam.Name: Reveal Undead name
ability.guild.bildteve.reveal-undead-nam.Effect: 1/day after 10 secs observation, may discern a target Undead’s dismiss name (cf. reveal unknown Undead), or vs a demon gains a lucky idea about their nature.

ability.guild.bildteve.destroy.Name: Destroy
ability.guild.bildteve.destroy.Effect: 1/day may destroy (as per hand of purity, but death from casting damage is not permanent) an Undead or Demonkind of up to 4th level by touch. This will cost the Kallah 6 TBLP per dismiss/resistance level.

ability.guild.bildteve.shield-of-purity.Name: Shield of Purity
ability.guild.bildteve.shield-of-purity.Effect: Gains an innate Shield of Purity (as demon slayer) 1/day, but the reduction also applies vs Undead.

ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.gains-o-ski.Name: O skill for broad sword
ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.gains-o-ski.Effect: Gains O skill for broad sword and utilise shield skill.

ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.gains-u-ski.Name: Utilise shield skill
ability.guild.mordred-s-rest.gains-u-ski.Effect: Gains O skill for broad sword and utilise shield skill.

ability.guild.sellaville.fortified-spiri.Name: Fortified Spirit
ability.guild.sellaville.fortified-spiri.Effect: Gains fortified spirit, and the Kallah can never allow themselves to be raised as Undead.

ability.guild.sellaville.discern-nature-.Name: Discern Nature of Undead
ability.guild.sellaville.discern-nature-.Effect: Gains discern uature of Undead and remember unknown Undead name.

ability.guild.sellaville.remember-unknow.Name: Remember Unknown Undead Name
ability.guild.sellaville.remember-unknow.Effect: Gains discern uature of Undead and remember unknown Undead name.

ability.guild.sellaville.sellaville-indo.Name: Sellaville Indomnitability
ability.guild.sellaville.sellaville-indo.Effect: Gain immunity to domination effects that would cause the Kallah to act against the City of Sellaville, the Kallah, its people, or the council.

ability.guild.sellaville.flat-of-the-bla.Name: Flat of the Blade
ability.guild.sellaville.flat-of-the-bla.Effect: Gains flat of the blade (as tables)

ability.guild.the-brood.mark-ally-protec.Name: Mark Ally protection
ability.guild.the-brood.mark-ally-protec.Effect: Members cannot be forced to break a mark ally cast by a fellow member (they can still choose to).

ability.guild.sirac.flexible-spell-study.Name: Flexible Gold or Ivory spell study
ability.guild.sirac.flexible-spell-study.Effect: The basic tier benefits to learn a Gold or Ivory spell at the start of the day can instead be used at any time, but take 1 minute of prep to use.

ability.guild.sirac.flexible-power.Name: Flexible Gold or Ivory power
ability.guild.sirac.flexible-power.Effect: The mana and casting levels gained as a basic tier benefit can now be used on Gold or Ivory mana, not just a specific colour.

ability.mc.awoken-mind.l1.Name: Neuronic Reserves I
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l1.Effect:
Can no longer meditate/regain neuronics except through this class and supreme sacrifice. Gains an empty pool of 2 “Neuronic Reserves” per level. This regens at a rate of 1 per hour.
The pool can be used to regain innates of a characters base class neuronics. This takes 30 seconds concentration per innate being regains and costs 1 NR per 3 TBLP (base cost) of the Neuronic.
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l1.Source: Collated Almanac, printed p. 81, New Neuronic Abilities (published)

ability.mc.awoken-mind.l2.Name: Neuronic Reserves II
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l2.Effect: Pool now regenerates at 1 per 30 minutes
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l2.Source: Collated Almanac, printed p. 81, New Neuronic Abilities (published)

ability.mc.awoken-mind.l3.Name: Neuronic Reserves III
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l3.Effect:
The pool can now be used to regain innates of any published neuronic owned.
The time taken to regain an innate is reduced to 15 seconds
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l3.Source: Collated Almanac, printed p. 81, New Neuronic Abilities (published)

ability.mc.awoken-mind.l4.Name: Neuronic Reserves IV
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l4.Effect: Pool now regenerates at 1 per 15 minutes
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l4.Source: Collated Almanac, printed p. 81, New Neuronic Abilities (published)

ability.mc.awoken-mind.l5.Name: Neuronic Reserves V
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l5.Effect:
Pool now regenerates at 1 per 10 minutes
The time taken to regain an innate is reduced to 10 seconds
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l5.Source: Collated Almanac, printed p. 81, New Neuronic Abilities (published)

ability.mc.awoken-mind.l6.Name: Neuronic Reserves VI
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l6.Effect: Pool now regenerates at 1 per 5 minutes
ability.mc.awoken-mind.l6.Source: Collated Almanac, printed p. 81, New Neuronic Abilities (published)
